content: Fact check: Fake news getting viral on charging no interest rate under KCC A news is getting viral on social media. Pradeep Sharma posted a piece of newspaper where it is written mentioned that 4% interest were charged on loan of 3 Lakh under Kisan Credit Card Loan Scheme up until now. KCC loan scheme was introduced for farmers seeking access on short-term loan in 1998 and linked with Pradhan Mantri Yojna.As per the claim, KCC will provide interest free loan up to 3 Lakhs from April 2022.Fact checkAfter digging further, we went on the official site of State Bank of India and found that no such amends have been made neither any such news have come across. It is clearly mentioned that under the terms and conditions that 3% interest will be charged for prompt borrowers.Hence proving that the viral picture is photoshopped and no such mark down on interest percentage were provided. Adding further under the benefits of the scheme it is mentioned that interest can go low up to only 2% p.a. and high to 4% p.a.Conclusion: The claim is fake.Claim review: Fake news getting viral on charging no interest rate under KCCClaim by: Pradeep SharmaFact check: fake
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did the Ukrainian Investigative Bureau had arrested a Ukrainian diplomat for smuggling amid Russia-Ukraine crisis? Amid the Russia-Ukraine crisis, another news is going viral. The news claims that the Ukrainian Investigative Bureau has arrested a Ukrainian diplomat for smuggling. Further, sharing the video, @Patriot73507011 wrote the caption that, “the Ukrainian Investigative Bureau has arrested a Ukrainian diplomat while he was trying to smuggle $140,000, 68,000 euros, 12 kilograms of gold bars and 13.8 kilograms of gold jewelry. That $14 billion congress just sent Ukraine is going to end up EXACTLY like this.”https://twitter.com/Patriot73507011/status/1504301260509437953Similarly, many other users have shared this post on the handles.Fact CheckOn google reverse image search, we found a report of https://fakty.com.ua/. In the report, it was written that the investigators of the State Bureau of investigation about $1 million worth of gold and foreign currency valuables from one of the employees of the Ukrainian embassy in the EU. Further, it also claims that an embassy official tried to smuggle it across border under the guise of diplomatic mail. The report mentions that at the Yahodyn checkpoint on February 28, 2021, during a search of a diplomatic minibus, DBR investigators found and seized almost € 68,000, more than $ 140,000, more than 12 kg of gold bars, gold jewelry weighing 13.8 kg.Moreover, we also found a video on YouTube. The caption of the video which can be nearly translated into English, “SBU counterintelligence blocks EU smuggling channel organized by Ukrainian Foreign Ministry officials (video). ” Above all, this is a year old video which was uploaded on March 1, 2021.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6uKZFNxj6jQHence, it is an old incident.ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check analysis it is clear that the Ukrainian Investigative Bureau had not arrested a Ukrainian diplomat amid the ongoing crisis. But, some users are spreading fake news by sharing old pictures.

content: Fact Check: Is Pakistan crossing ranked 67th in the world happiness Report 2022? Finland has been named the world’s happiest country for the fifth year running, and Afghanistan is ranked as the unhappiest, closely followed by Lebanon.Meanwhile, social media is covered with the claims that Pakistan is ranked 67 whereas India is ranked 120 in the world happiness report.Many tweets like these were shared:Global Happiness Index ranking released for the year 2022: Pakistan: 67Bhutan: 95Nepal: 100Bangladesh: 125Sri Lanka: 130India: 140 — South Asia Index (@SouthAsiaIndex) March 18, 2022Fact Check:While analyzing the World Happiness Report DFRAC found that India is ranked at a lowly 136, even below Pakistan, which is at 121, on the list.The screenshot is attached below:Many NEWS websites like “ THE NEW INDIAN EXPRESS ” and PAKISTAN TIMES covered this too under world happiness report 2022.Conclusion:This is true that India is listed below Pakistan in the world happiness report 2022. But Pakistan is not ranked 67th.Claim review: Pakistan ranked 67th in the world happiness report 2022.Claimed by: @SouthAsiaIndexFact check: misleading.

content: Fact Check: Are Minor beaten up in UP for raising Pro-Pakistani slogans? A Video of police personnel thrashing some minors is getting viral on social media. Claiming, minors are getting thrashed for raising Pro-Pakistani Slogans.Many Facebook users s have shared this video with the caption, “UP police is teaching them a lesson for shouting slogans in favor of Pakistan” (translates Hindi)Twitter too is filled up with this post under the caption, “See how Uttar Pradesh police are taking out the heat of Pakistan by entering the house of the person who speaks Pakistan Zindabad, see in the same way that whoever speaks Pakistan Zindabad in the whole of India, its heat should go out, this is amazing of Baba. (Translates Hindi)पाकिस्तान जिंदाबाद बोलने वाले को उत्तर प्रदेश पुलिस कैसे घर के अंदर घुस के पाकिस्तान का गर्मी निकाल रहे हैं देखिए ऐसे ही पूरे हिंदुस्तान में जो भी पाकिस्तान जिंदाबाद बोलेगा उसका गर्मी निकल जाना चाहिए यह बाबा का कमाल है pic.twitter.com/UoRKP31QiU — DARJAN SINGH JAGAT (@DarajansinghJa) March 20, 2022Fact Check:To prove this as misleading news chaundali police have tweeted on their official Twitter account. Stating, “The case is more than a year old in which departmental action has been taken by suspending both the policemen at the time due to the inhuman treatment done to the child. Please refrain from circulating anything without full facts and clear information.”(Translates Hindi)The video was of the year 2021 , and Amar Ujala too covered it at that time.Conclusion:The video is not of recent times but of the year 2021, where the minor was beaten up because of a charge of stealing and not of raising Pro –Pakistani slogans.Claim Review: Minors beaten up in UP for raising Pro-Pakistani slogans.Claimed by: social media usersFact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Fake video of American paratroopers landing in Ukraine under Ukraine-Russia Conflict is going viral Ukraine President Zelenskyy has asked US for more medical aid and forces after seeing the war situation in Ukraine. A video is going viral on social media about American soldiers landing in Ukraine.Sabrina posted a video where soldiers were landing with the help of a parachute. She claimed that it was American soldiers who landed in Ukraine. She posted the video on 11th March 2022.American soldiers in ukraine Sky https://t.co/GRwRLLUgbY a través de @FacebookWatch — sabrina (@sabrina9191) March 11, 2022Many other users posted the video with the claim.Cuando tienes un presidente imbécil, esto pasa! https://t.co/U5jhTDkEPC — alan 347 (@347_alan) March 12, 2022Fact checkAfter cross-checking we found that the video is from 2016. The article of Daily Mail.com, says that the sky in North California was filled with paratroopers as a part of the exercise. Thus the video was of North California and not Ukraine. Furthermore, on the edited video, the heading was ‘American soldier landing to Ukraine’ while in the original video no such headlines are made.Another proofAiirSource Military also posted the video of hundreds of paratroopers landing in Fort Bragg, North California on 28th May 2016.Conclusion: Hence proving that video is a claim is misleading.Claim review: Fake video of American paratroopers landing in Ukraine under the Conflict is going viralClaim by: SabrinaFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Election Commission has announced not to hold elections again in UP. A post is becoming very viral on social media. It was claimed that the Election Commission of India (ECI) has announced the re-election of those seats in Uttar Pradesh. Where EVM machines were replaced.Fact Check:On verifying the viral claim, we found a fact check of PIB. In which it was said that the claim of replacement of EVMs is fake. Also, re-polling in 142 seats has not been announced by the Election Commission of India (ECI).Therefore, the claim of re-election in UP is fake.Conclusion:The claim is fake.Claim review: Election Commission announces re-election in UPClaim by: Social Media UserFact check: Fake
