content: Fact Check: Truth behind Zelensky viral video with a woman who died on Feb 26th. Social media is all covered with news of war between Russia-Ukraine. In between the war President of Ukraine Zelensky visited the hospital to check on the wounded Ukrainian Army.It is being claimed that the woman seen in that picture is Inna Derusova, a physician, who is claimed to be dead in the month of February.Hence, the viral video is referred to as an old video and not a recent one.Many users on Twitter posted the picture with similar claims. As shown beneath.Claim: “Zelensky walked to a hospital today to visit wounded Ukrainian soldiers and award them with state honors for their sacrifices.” Umm… The woman to Zelenskyy’s left, is a physician named Inna Derusova. She was reported to have died on Feb. 26https://t.co/DZGkor3QbT pic.twitter.com/NW8pVgtzHM — Caroline Mueller (@PnutMueller) March 14, 2022#Zelenskyy video #FAKE in which he allegedly visited a hospital with wounded soldiers of #Ukraine army today includes physician Inna Derusova who died on Feb 26 & awarded posthumously a medal by Zelenskyy. The video is from February but before her death confirmed by her relatives pic.twitter.com/8ylFq0xW8l — davie ewan macdonald (@escalatorover) March 14, 2022Fact check:We reversed searched the image and found out that the woman on the left is the first woman army brigadier of Ukraine Colonel Tetiana Ostashchenko.An article about her was given in a Ukrainian multimedia platform JKRINFORMWhereas the women she was being misunderstood was Inna Derusova, the first woman of his country for the title of ‘Hero of Ukraine’ posthumously, for displaying exemplary courage and bravery in the ongoing conflict with Russia.Which was given to her by president zelensky.A Facebook page too conformed her death and shared the picture of Inna Derusova, Along with a long paragraph explaining her and her achievements.Conclusion:As you can see in the collage both the woman are different from each. Therefore the woman seem with zelensky is Colonel Tetiana Ostashchenko and not Inna Derosova. Hence making the claims of people false.Claim Review: Truth behind Zelensky viral video with a woman who died on Feb 26th.Claimed by: many social mediaFact Check: fake.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Have women got tricked at voting booth during Election 2022? After BJP’s remarkable win in Assembly Election. Social Media was flooded with opinions and posts regarding the result. Meanwhile a video is getting viral where people are suspecting cheating at Election booth.Santosh Diwate, posted a video of NDTV news coverage regarding election. Time duration of the video was 45 minutes and in the video reporter was taking the byte of 3 women who got tricked while voting. The women claimed that the polling agent who were sitting at the booth pressed ‘kamal’ (BJP’s Symbol) in the electoral machine. In short, the women wanted to press ‘Hathi’ but workers at the booth pressed ‘Kamal’ in place of it and try to influence them as if it was mistakenly done. The user criticized the Modi govt and questioned its win in the election 2022.https://twitter.com/diwate_santosh/status/1502123229774704645?s=20&t=ZHMxHWiluRILe57H8ZLMYQDarryl also accused the BJP of winning election unfairly. He posted the video on 12 March, 2022.Sir, This is what u are talking about, #BOOTH capturing Dear PM Modi, This is how u win your electionAnd the EC knows this& deliberately sitting silent & giving winning certificate to BJP@realumeshsingh@RoopeshSinghINC@RobbieK014 @ashharwarsi_inc @IYCLegalCell @MaryDenniz pic.twitter.com/WoRYNrASd1 — Darryl (@Trendsetting123) March 12, 2022Fact checkAfter cross-checking we got the whole video of NDTV and initially found out that the news is of Election 2019. As per the original news, the fraud at voting booth took place in Faridabad. NDTV itself posted the video on its official YouTube page.Hindustan Times also covered the news of poll agent being arrested for influencing the voters in the Lok Sabha election 2019 at Faridabad.Thus the viral video was taken from NDTV’s news coverage of the Lok Sabha election 2019.Conclusion: Hence proving that the claim is misleadingClaim review: women got tricked at voting booth during Election 2022Claim by: DarrylFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Yogi Adityanath silence Owaisi during his speech in The Parliament? A video is going massively viral on the internet. Social media users are claiming that the viral video is of Lok Sabha. Further, in the video, Yogi Adityanath is delivering a speech. Users are saying that Yogi Adityanath silenced Asaduddin Owaisi during his speech.https://twitter.com/hind_k_veer01/status/1502902317074432004Similarly, many other users are sharing this video with similar claims.Also Read: A Fake Picture Of New York Stock Exchange Got Viral After BJP’s Victory.Fact Check:To investigate the viral video we used the InVid tool and converted the video into different keyframes. After doing the google reverse image search of each keyframe, we have found a video on YouTube. The YouTube channel of Bharatiya Janata Party had uploaded the video on 13 August 2014. Furthermore, in the video, the then BJP MP from Gorakhpur (Uttar Pradesh) Yogi Aditya Nath gave a complete speech in the Lok Sabha on the issue of communal violence.In this video of the speech which was posted on YouTube, at 10:24 minutes, a woman of the opposition party interrupts Yogi’s speech. Then, he demanded her to sit and said that her allegations are baseless. However, Asaduddin Owaisi was not seen creating any kind of disturbance throughout the speech.Therefore, it is clear that the viral video is edited. So, the video is deceptive.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did Russian Army attack in Ukrainian President Zelenskyy’s house? Another clip is getting viral on social media under Ukraine-Russia conflict. Chanchal Mahmud posted a video on March 6, 2020. In the video, some soldier were charging in the house and the video was of 2 minutes, 32 seconds. He claimed that it was Russian army attacking in the house of Ukrainian President.Bortoman Jhenaidah TV also posted the same video and claimed that Russian army has attacked in President Zelenskyy’s house.Fact checkAfter Google image search, we found the whole video on The Street Journal official YouTube page. The video was posted in 2016 and captioned it as the raid occurred during the arrest of Joaquin “El Chapo” Guzmana. He is formally known as drug lord in Mexico.Therefore the claim over the video is misleading as it has no connections with Ukraine-Russia Conflict.Conclusion: the claim is misleadingClaim review: Russian Army charge in Ukraine President Zelenskyy’s houseClaim by: Bortoman Jhenaidah TVFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Aditya Yogi Nath and Akhilesh Yadav and his family  meet post elections? A picture is circulating on social media showing Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Aditya Nath along with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav and his father Mulayam Singh Yadav and Uncle Shivpal Yadav.People are claiming that these three are meeting after the recently conducted elections.Many shared it on Facebook under the caption, “Uncle Shivpal, Papa Mulayam Singh and Akhilesh Yadav came to congratulate after the victory, this is called politics”(translate Hindi)Fact Check:We Reverse search the image to find the authenticity of the picture. We found that the picture belongs to the year 2019.This similar picture of showing Yogi Adityanath meeting Akhilesh Yadav, his father Mulayam Singh Yadav and Uncle Shivpal Yadav was shared by an article covered by NDTV with the headline, “UP CM Yogi Adityanath met Mulayam Singh Yadav, said this by tweeting (translate Hindi)Then we also found the same picture on a tweet by ANI/UP under the caption, “UP CM Yogi Adityanath meets SP leader Mulayam Singh Yadav at his residence. MS Yadav was admitted to hospital yesterday due to high levels of blood sugar. SP Chief Akhilesh Yadav and Pragatisheel Samajwadi Party Chief Shivpal Yadav were also present.”UP CM Yogi Adityanath meets SP leader Mulayam Singh Yadav at his residence. MS Yadav was admitted to hospital yesterday due to high levels of blood sugar. SP Chief Akhilesh Yadav and Pragatisheel Samajwadi Party Chief Shivpal Yadav also present. pic.twitter.com/bOKWeqa6uq — ANI UP/Uttarakhand (@ANINewsUP) June 10, 2019Conclusion:Hence the picture is circulating with a false claim.Claim Review: Aditya Yogi Nath and Akhilesh Yadav and his family meet post elections.Claimed by: Many social media users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Mamta Government Waived Off The GST Of The Muslim Traders In West Bengal? All the religions in the constitution of India have the same place. But, some people fulfill their selfish motives ignite hatred among different religious communities. One such news is going viral on the internet with the claim that the Mamta government in West Bengal has waived off the GST on Muslim traders. Further, @KisKumMis wrote on his handle, “Secularism- Secularism- Mamta government will provide GST waiver for Muslim traders. Mamta Banerjee’s government in West Bengal says that Muslim traders have been harmed by GST, so The government will pay the tax, that is, the tax waiver of Muslim traders. The Muslim population in Bengal has become 35%.”सेकुलरिज्म-मुस्लिम व्यापारियों का GST माफ़ GST भरेगी ममता सरकार पश्चिम बंगाल में ममता बनर्जी की सरकार का कहना है की GST से मुस्लिम व्यापारियों को नुक्सान हुआ है, इसलिएटैक्स सरकार भरेगी, यानि मुस्लिम व्यापारियों का टैक्स माफ़। बंगाल में मुस्लिम जनसँख्या 35% हो चुकी है। — 🇮🇳Kishor K Mishra🇮🇳 (@KisKumMis) March 12, 2022Similarly, many other users have shared this on their handles.Fact CheckOn our keyword research, we found that the Mamta government has not announced any such news. Hence, the viral news is fake. Above all, we found that the same news went viral in 2018 also.In the above tweet, there is a spelling mistake in the heading. Hence, we can easily say that the news is fake.ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check analysis it can be easily concluded that the viral news is fake. Moreover, some users had spread this news in the past also to harm the communal harmony and to create a divide between Hindus- Muslims..
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Truth behind the viral Ukrainian – Russia war video. Amid Ukraine- Russian war a video is getting viral on social media getting the attraction of many people on Facebook and different Twitter handles.The video was also shared by Islamic TV on their official Facebook page under the caption, “#Russian army and #ukrine army fighting #fresh.”Fact Check:By reverse searching this image, we get to know that this image is already uploaded on a YouTube account. Dated 8, Feb 2020 under the caption, “Phantom Fury Footage Shows Intense Battle On Iraqi Streets.The Raid took place at the Golden Mosque on October 1, 2004. As part of the Battle for Samarra, also known as Operation Baton Rouge.Which resulted in the Iraqi and US commandos ending up capturing 26 enemy fighters in the Golden Mosque. One US service member, possibly Army Sgts Michael A. Uvanni, of the National Guard’s 2nd Battalion, 108th Infantry Regiment, was KIA during the operation as well.Conclusion:This is the old video getting viral with the claim of the war.Claim Review: the viral Ukrainian – Russia war video.Claimed by: Islamic TV.Fact check: false.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Rahul Gandhi was seen playing badminton after the defeat of Congress in the assembly elections? In the recently held assembly elections in five states, Congress had to face a major defeat. In Punjab, the party not only lost its power. Rather, many big leaders including Congress’s CM candidate was not able to save their seats.Meanwhile, a video of former party president Rahul Gandhi is going viral on social media with the claim that he was playing badminton amid the party’s defeat. In the video, Rahul can be seen playing badminton on an indoor court surrounded by some party leaders, police and security guards.Fact checkTo verify the above claim, when we converted this video into individual keyframes with the help of InVid tool and Google reverse image search of each keyframe, we found a report by ABP News in this regard. A collage of two photographs was used in the report.While in one picture Rahul is seen enjoying ice cream, in another picture he is seen holding a badminton racket. According to the report, this picture of Rahul is related to the Legislative Assembly elections of Kerala. The picture was clicked just before the declaration of election results in Kerala.In this regard, we also found a video posted by the official YouTube channel of Congress on March 9.So it is clear that the viral picture is misleading.Conclusion: The claim is misleading.Claim review: Rahul Gandhi was seen playing badminton after Congress’ defeat in Assembly electionsClaim by: Best Hindi NewsFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: A deceptive picture of a man holding a gun was shared as an Israeli Terrorist. Know the reality. An image is getting viral on the internet. The image is of a man holding the gun at someone or something. Sharing the image social media users are claiming that he an Israeli terrorist and he had fired bullets towards a school in the occupied West Bank. Moreover, sharing the image @cjwerleman wrote the caption, “An Israeli terrorist fired live bullets towards a school in the occupied West Bank, where hundreds of Palestinian students were inside.” Further, he also gave the reference of the report of qudsnen.co. Moreover, this post was retweeted on social media more than a thousand times.https://twitter.com/cjwerleman/status/1503134054450819080?t=pIEIbbrQXK7vfyZj841PFg&s=08Similarly, many other social media users shared this post.Fact CheckOn doing a reverse search image, we found the same image on the website mintpressnews.comThe caption of the image was, “an Israeli Jewish settler shoots in the air as a Palestinian protest against the Prawer Plan to resettle Israel’s Palestinian Bedouin minority from their village in the Negev Desert, near the Israeli settlement of Bet El, north of the West Bank city of Ramallah.”Further, we found the viral image on APimage.com.Hence, we can see that many reports and social media users used this image at different times.Also read: The Video Of Youth Being Brutally Beaten By BJP workers After Winning Elections Goes Viral.ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check it is clear that the viral image is deceptive. Users are sharing it to mislead people.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Know the truth about the viral picture of the downing of the Russian helicopter amid the attack on Ukraine Picture shared on social media on March 7 and 8, 2022, amidst Ukraine’s attack on Russia, claimed that Ukraine destroyed a Russian helicopter.Sharing the picture, it was captioned that “AFU report may be reviewed on the destruction of a #Russian helicopter near #Vyshgorod.”Fact Check:On reverse-image of the viral image, we found that this image is of February 24, 2022. The day the Russian invasion of Ukraine began.This picture can be seen in the New York Post and Daily Mail report on the Russia-Ukraine conflict published on February 24.Hence the viral picture has been found to be misleading.Conclusion:The claim is misleading.Claim review: Ukraine destroys a #Russian helicopter near #VyshgorodClaim by: Bekeris PovilasFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did CM Yogi Burst into tears after watching ‘The Kashmir Files’? The Kashmir Files has hit the box office and opinions on social media as well. A big claim is going viral that even CM Yogi Adityanath cried after watching the movie directed by Vivek Agnihotri. The movie represents the story of an exodus that took place in Kashmir against Kashmiri Pandits.नितेश सेन..देवास posted a short clip of CM Yogi Adityanath where he is seen shedding tears. The video was posted on March 14, 2022. He claimed that UP CM got emotional after watching The Kashmir FilesThe video is catching fire as many other users posted the same short clip of Yogi Adityanath and claimed the same.The kashmir files Movie को देख रो पड़े पूज्य योगी आदित्यनाथ महाराज जी……. आप सभी से निवेदन है आप भी एक बार जरूर देखें…..🌹@myogiadityanath ji pic.twitter.com/sUftaiid6I — Dr .Rakesh Rai (@DrRakeshRai1) March 14, 2022https://twitter.com/vishalmishr343/status/1503369970591301634?s=20&t=QW8DsYxdT6g-jNNvvIBLlAFact checkAfter reverse image search, we found that the video is 2 years old. Zee News portal covered the news where CM Yogi burst out into tears after watching a program that was dedicated to martyred soldiers. The program was conducted in Gorakhnath Temple of Gorakhpur.After seeing the image embed in the article. We got to know that the viral is from the program conducted for soldiers. Thus the claim of CM Yogi shedding tears after watching The Kashmir Files is fake.Conclusion: the claim is fake.Claim review: CM Yogi Burst into tears after watching ‘The Kashmir Files’Claim by: नितेश सेन..देवासFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The Video Of Youth Being Brutally Beaten By BJP workers After Winning Elections Goes Viral. Recently, assembly elections were held in five states. Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is going to form its government again in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Manipur, and Goa. However, in Punjab the party got disappointment. Meanwhile, a video is becoming massively viral on social media. In which some people are brutally beating a person by shouting Jai Shri Ram. Further, in the video police are rescuing the bleeding youth.Moreover, sharing this video on Twitter, the user gave a caption, “Ramraj has started, now the people of OBC SC ST who have voted for BJP, see what is going to happen, how the people of Bahujan Samaj are being killed, this is yesterday’s incident, and say Jai Shri Ram.”https://twitter.com/Shifali36718769/status/1502207408353210371?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1502207408353210371%7Ctwgr%5E%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fdfrac.org%2Fhi%2F2022%2F03%2F14%2Fbeating-of-youth-after-winning-the-elections-by-bjp-workers%2FSimilarly, many other users on Facebook and Twitter shared this video in large numbers.Fact Check:To verify the above claim, we took the help of the InVid tool by converting the video into different keyframes and doing a google reverse image search in each keyframe. Then, we found a news report from TV 9 Hindi in this regard. A screenshot of the viral video was used in this report.Further, according to the report this incident is of Shivaji Chowk in Bhabua, Bihar. There was an incident of assault with the accused son of the ward member. In the video, a mob is seen thrashing the accused man while chanting ‘Jai Shri Ram.’Apart from this, the UP Police also confirmed that the viral video is not related to Uttar Pradesh but to the police station Bhabua, District Kaimur, Bihar.Also Read: The Reality Of The Drunken Police In Bhagwant Mann’s AAP Rule.Conclusion:Hence, the claim of BJP workers beating up the youth after winning the elections is misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Have Khalistani supporters conducted a rally after the win of AAP in the Punjab Assembly Polls? Aam Janta Party has made a remarkable win in Punjab. Parties’ governance in Punjab has risen support as well critics on social media. Wherein a video is getting viral where a rally of Khalistani supporters is commenced.Yas Hindu, a user has posted a video of a rally where Khalistani supporters are chanting Khalistan Zindabad in the presence of Punjab Police. He posted the video on March 13, 2022, and claimed that it all happened after Arvind Kejriwal came into power in Punjab.https://twitter.com/hindu_yas/status/1502887112001351681?s=20&t=X29DHwboMyjOrnASBPH8VAMany other users also posted the same.Fact CheckAfter cross checking we got to know that the video got in air on 25th February, 2022. Before the announcement of the election result. Asli Bharat Analysis posted the video on its official page. The rally was conducted by followers of Deep Sidhu who recently died in an accident.Therefore, the claim is misleading as the rally was conducted before the announcement of the result of the Punjab election 2022. Arvind Kejriwal has nothing to do with the rally.Conclusion: the claim is misleading.Claim review: Khalistani supporters have conducted a rally after the win of AAP in the Punjab Assembly Polls?Claim by: Yas HinduFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: A Fake Picture Of New York Stock Exchange Got Viral After BJP’s Victory. The wave of PM Narendra Modi-led BJP government was seen in the assembly elections of four states this year. Consequently, Modi supporters were enthusiastically hailed for the BJP and Modi. Internet got flooded with many posts related to this grand victory. Meanwhile, many people shared the picture of the New York Stock Exchange with a digital scroll that showed the news of the BJP’s win “in India’s biggest state.” sharing the image @MODIfyingINDIA2014 wrote in the caption, “Just ZOOM and see at New York Stock exchange what is displayed in the digital display.”Similarly, many other users shared this image on their social media handles.Fact CheckAfter the reverse image search,a we found that this is an old image. Moreover, the image is not of NSE. Above all, this image got viral in 2017 also.News of BJP's big win under Prime Minister Modi splashed in Canary Warf, prominent business district of London. Zoom it.. #IAmNewIndia pic.twitter.com/Z17OtsUatL — Amit Malviya (मोदी का परिवार) (@amitmalviya) March 12, 2017ConclusionHence, from our Fact check analysis it is clear that this image is fake. It has no relation with the BJP victory in assembly elections this year.Claim Review: The New York Stock Exchange with a digital scroll that showed the news of the BJP’s win “in India’s biggest state Claimed by: @MODIfyingINDIA2014 and other social media users Fact check– fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did LK Advani gets emotional over the movie “The Kashmir Files?” Since its release, the Kashmir files are doing good on the box office. Lot many people are seen as emotional over this movie as it shows the brutal reality of the exodus of Kashmiri Pandit from the valley in 1990.Meanwhile, a clip is getting viral over social media of BJP leader LK Advani . He is seen getting emotional at a movie theater.@ashwani_mahajan too shared the video on his Twitter account.Many Facebook users shared the video.Fact Check:After we researched this video, we found that this was the video shared by Vidhu Vinod Chopra directorial. He shared a video on Instagram where Advani was seen in an emotional state and could be seen trying to hold back tears post viewing the film.The video was uploaded with the caption, “Shri L K Advani at the special screening of #Shikara. We are so humbled and grateful for your blessings and your appreciation for the film Sir.”https://www.instagram.com/p/B8RK6b4FYSw/?utm_source=ig_embed&utm_campaign=loadingThe news was also covered by The Indian Express under the heading, “LK Advani’s emotional response to Vidhu Vinod Chopra’s Shikara.”Conclusion:Hence, the video of LK Advani getting emotional is actually of the movie Shikara which was too based on Kashmiri Exodus. Not The Kashmir Files.Claim Review: LK Advani gets emotional over the movie “The Kashmir Files.”Claimed by: many social media users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Fake videos of children from the Ukraine war situation got viral on the Internet.    Ukraine-Russia war has been continuing for 2 weeks now. Many lives have been lost during airstrikes and attacks from the Russian Army. US President Biden has announced to ban the import of Diamond, Vodka and seafood from Russia as a symbol of aggression. Meanwhile, a short click is going viral where users are claiming that it represents the situation of Ukraine in the war.Ukraine Russia War 24×7 News Updates posted a video of a small girl, where the person is asking the girl where her dad is and have she had lunch. The video was posted on March 2, 2022. In his caption, he depicts the situation of Ukraine after the war.Other users also posted the video and claims to be the present situation of Ukraine.Fact checkAfter researching we got to know that the video is from 2017 and has no links with the Ukraine-Russia war. Humanity Lives On posted the video as the depiction of Humanity is Power. In the video, the same girl is present who is present in the viral video.https://youtu.be/UW4BuFsqK-sAnother proofPreemptive Love is claimed that the girl’s name is Malak and she has survived the war with ISIS. Wherein, she lost her family, therefore the viral video is not from the Ukraine war situation. Instead, it is from the ISIS war.Conclusion: Hence proving that the claim is misleading.Claim review: Fake videos of children from the Ukraine war situation got viral on the Internet.Claim by: Humanity Lives OnFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The Reality Of The Drunken Police In Bhagwant Mann’s AAP Rule. A video is going viral on the massive internet targeting Bhagwant Mann. The video is of a heavily drunken man in the police officer. Further, the man is rolling over the ground and there is an empty whiskey bottle beside him. Sharing the video, @rose_k01 wrote, “Bhagwant Mann AAP Rule Starts in Punjab.“Bhagwant Mann AAP Rule Starts in Punjab 😂🍻 pic.twitter.com/q0kWyA4Epr — Rosy (@rose_k01) March 12, 2022Similarly, many other users have posted the same video on their social media users. And, they are trying to take a dig over Bhagwant Mann and how his administration in Punjab going to be.Fact CheckOn keyword research we found, we found a video on YouTube. SPORTSQUARTERINDIA the video was uploaded on YouTube on April 12, 2013.Hence, it has nothing to do with the present scenario. But, users are sharing the video misleadingly to malign the image of Bhagwant Mann.Moreover, users posted this video in 2027 also with the caption, “Security is too tight in Punjab and Haryana after today’s #ramrahimsentence, Be safe guys.”Security is too tight in Punjab and Haryana after today's #ramrahimsentence, Be safe guys pic.twitter.com/HyOYThzoye — Chandan Parihar (@aara_bhaiji) August 28, 2017Also Read: Did American actor Leonardo DiCaprio donates $10 million to Ukraine?ConclusionTherefore, from our Fact check analysis, it is clear that the video is misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Australian Airline CEO gets pie on his face for his speech over Vaccine Mandate? A video is getting viral, where users are claiming that Australian Airline CEO got smashed with a pie on his face after he gave a speech over vaccine mandates.Jo McAdams shared a short clip of 20 seconds on 6th March, 2022. He claimed that the speaker is the CEO of Australian Airline and he got smashed with a pie by an l who ran into him on the stage.Other users also posted the same viral video.https://youtu.be/EI8L9Zn1T3IFact checkAfter reverse research, we got the video and found that the speaker was not the CEO of Australian Airline. Rather he is a CEO of Qantas, Alan Joyce. 7 News Perth posted the video on its official Facebook account on 10 May, 2017.Another ProofThe Guardian also covered the incident and interviewed the Tony Overhue. He smashed the cake as a political attack over the CEO for supporting same sex marriages.Conclusion: Therefore the claim is misleading as it was a viral of the CEO of Qantas and it came in 2017. The covid-19 came into existence after 2019 so the caption over vaccine mandate is also fake.Claim review: Australian Airline CEO gets pie on his face for his speech over Vaccine MandateClaim by: Jo McAdamsFact check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did SFJ’s Chief  Gurpatwant Pannun wrote a letter to Bhagwant Mann? Victory fell into the side of AAP in the Punjab Elections 2022. As in every election, we can hear many controversial news. The same is the case with the Punjab Elections 2022. Many people suspect that there is some sort of relationship between AAP and SFJ. Moreover, former AAP member Kumar Vishwas also alleged Delhi CM Kejriwal to be a separatist. In response to these allegations, Kejriwal called himself the world’s sweetest terrorist”.#WATCH | AAP Convener Arvind Kejriwal responds to allegations of his former party colleague & poet Kumar Vishwas. "This is comedy. If their allegations are to be believed, I am a big terrorist. In this case, what were security agencies doing in last 10 years," he says. pic.twitter.com/G2Nzws2VCe — ANI (@ANI) February 18, 2022Meanwhile, a letter by the name of SFJ chief and a pro-Khalistani Gurpatwant Pannun is getting circulated on the internet. Sharing the letter users are claiming that, AAP won the Punjab elections because of SFJ’s support. Further, the letter also claimed that AAP got the votes of pre-Khalistanis. The letter is to Bhagwant Mann from Pannun. Moreover, AAP won the Punjab elections by deceptively bagging the votes of pro-Khalistan Sikhs in Punjab who support SFJ’s secessionist Referendum for the independence of Punjab from India.खालिस्तान वोट, खालिस्तान फंडिंग !! SFJ का दावा है कि खालिस्तानी समर्थन के कारण AAP ने पंजाब में चुनाव जीता। अगर सच है, तो पंजाब का भविष्य …? pic.twitter.com/GRzbolGnEc — Radhika Khera (Modi Ka Parivar) (@Radhika_Khera) March 11, 2022Similarly, many social media users shared this letter.Fact CheckOn doing keyword search we found no such letter from Gurpatwant Pannun.The SFJ chief Pannun, himself stated that the letter is fake. Further, he clearly said, “The letter circulated in the name of SFJ is fake. It is circulated by Bhagwant Mann and AAP. SFJ does not believe in the Indian Constitution or any political party. SFJ’s only goal is separating Punjab from India, and for that, we will do referendum voting soon.”Moreover, another such fake letter was circulated on social on 17th February.Therefore, we can see that there is a series of letters by the name of SFJ related to AAP. But, they are not authentic.Also Read: Did American actor Leonardo DiCaprio donates $10 million to Ukraine?ConclusionHence, it is clear that Pannun sent no such letter to Bhagwant Mann.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Abhisar Sharma Is Going To Shift From Noida To Delhi Because Yogi Won Again? Renowned author of Kaafir’s Love, Hundred lives for U, Predator, Edge Of Machete, Abhisar Sharma is getting light on the internet. After one of his Tweets got viral. In the tweet, it is written that, if Yogi Aditya Nath will again the UP Elections then he will shift from Noida to Sheik Sarai Delhi and there he will put a stall of eggs and omelet. Sharing the screenshot of his post, @BellamSwathi asked sarcastically when will Abhisar Ji go to start an egg omelet stall in Delhi?https://mobile.twitter.com/BellamSwathi/status/1501928865551110148Moreover, many users shared this viral screenshot on their handles.https://mobile.twitter.com/trsriniwas/status/1501992718028836875Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis we found no such tweet by Abhisar. Further, in the viral screenshot, the timing of the tweet is shown as 11:42 P.M, 4th February. However, we found Abhisar’s other tweet done at the same time. He wrote in the tweet, “Happy Birthday @rollgandhi_Brother. Keep smiling, keep laughing. Keep your spirits high and continue your search for bead in Noida.”Happy birthday @RoflGandhi_ bhai. Haste rahiye, hasaate rahiye. Hausla buland rakhen aur Noida me Manka kee talaash jaaree rakhen . — Abhisar Sharma (@abhisar_sharma) February 4, 2022ConclusionHence, from our fact check analysis we found that, the viral screenshot of the tweet of Abhisar Sharma is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Viral video of President Zelenskyy singing song in the music video, Know the Reality The war under the Ukraine-Russia conflict continued for 2 weeks now. Under the crisis, a short video is getting viral. In the video, users are claiming that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has sung a song for his wife.Endless love Sung by: Pres. Volodymyr Zelensky & wife Olena for each other & for Ukraine pic.twitter.com/0uRXyiMnFO — David Bouchard (@davidbouchard) March 10, 2022Felix Malsi is a user who posted a video of 4 minutes 28 seconds where a male singer along with the female singer is singing a song. He claimed that the singers are Ukraine President Zelenskyy and Ukraine’s first lady Olivia. He posted the video on March 9, 2022.Fact checkAfter researching, we found that the singer’s original identity is Lionel Richie and Diana Rose. It is not Zelenskyy and his wife. The music video got released on February 20, 2022, on the official YouTube page of Boyce Avenue.Nevertheless, President Zelenskyy’s wife is Olena Zelenska, and her original look does not match with the female singer.Hence proving that the claim is misleadingClaim review: Viral video of President Zelenskyy singing song in the music video along with his wife.Claim by: Felix MalsiFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Are Ukrainians selling Russian tanks on eBay? Another hour passed with the Russia-Ukraine war and another news round the corner is spreading with rapid speed. It is being claimed that the Ukrainians are selling Russian tanks on eBay.A picture is getting viral on social media sites. The screenshot is describing the features of Russian tanks as fully functional T-72 tanks.The screenshot is getting viral with captions like, “Ukrainians are selling used Russian Tanks on eBay.”اوكرانيين يعرضون دبابات روسية مستعملة للبيع في مزاد علني في متجر ايباي Ukrainians 🇺🇦 are selling used Russian 🇷🇺 Tanks on eBay pic.twitter.com/WjE14uHeJT — Saad Abedine (@SaadAbedine) March 2, 2022An official Twitter account of Horace Dediu also shared the same image on his Twitter handle.Ukrainians are selling (slightly used) Russian Tanks on eBay I’d recommend waiting. Prices will be going down.https://t.co/xNHzUHqGwm — Horace Dediu (@asymco) March 2, 2022Fact check:To find out the truth behind this, we went through eBay’s military policy. We get to know that the sale of military items is restricted for safety.Military surplus items and body armor that follow our policy can be sold, explosives and military ordnance aren’t allowed on eBay.By digging more into this picture we found that the similar-looking picture on DEFENCETALK.COM .The picture was taken in the year 2010 as provided in the description of the picture.Conclusion:The picture being circulated on the internet of Russian tank T-72 is morphed and not a real image.Claim Review: Ukrainians selling Russian tanks on eBay.Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: false.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Fake news about Former US President Donald Trump got viral A video is going viral on social media, wherein users are claiming that Donald Trump was legitimately elected as the President of the US. Later he was thrown out.Nick Moseder, shared a video of the Russian Ambassador’s dubbed speech in the United Nation. In the video, the female is stating how a legally and systematically elected President was thrown from his position in the US. The user pointed to former President Donald Trump in the reference.https://twitter.com/nick_moseder/status/1499180367986794499?s=20&t=pGvuLqZ2UyL0HbBb6tQNAwFurthermore, many users were claiming the same after inserting the short video of Russian Ambassador on social media platforms.https://twitter.com/marklthatcher13/status/1499315368925356035?s=20&t=fDNo3vjF82NtofbBdmWThghttps://twitter.com/PeaceHammieGood/status/1500276703788257284?s=20&t=AmS4lNnUPpaFz02Hmf4Y3QFact checkAfter researching, we got to know that he did mention how a US president was thrown out but he didn’t mention anything about Donald Trump. As per the users, Donald Trump was thrown out of the president’s post. His speech was driven towards the issue of the Ukraine-Russia conflict. United Nations posted the video on 3rd March 2022.Conclusion: The claim is misleadingClaim review: Fake news about Former US President Donald Trump got viralClaim by: Nick MosederFact check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did American actor Leonardo DiCaprio donates $10 million to Ukraine? Amidst Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Hindustan Times claimed in a report that American actor Leonardo DiCaprio has donated $10 million to Ukraine.Hindustan Times reported in its report that the actor has personal links with Ukraine. Because his maternal grandmother Helene Indenbirken was born there. But, in 1917 she moved to Germany with her parents. Furthermore, it also claimed that Leonardo’s donation to his grandmother’s native land was announced by the International Visegrad Fund.Moreover, several other media houses including Tribune India, India Times, India today, India tv, outlook, ib times, NDTV, and FilmyBeat have made similar claims in their reports.Fact Check:On checking the above claim, we got a report from Insider. In the report, the International Visegrad Fund told that it has no record of any donation received from the actor.Further, the organization’s spokesperson Lucia Becova stated that “We are not aware, nor do we have any information about Leonardo DiCaprio donating USD 10 million/£ 7.6 million to Ukraine. The International Visegrad Fund did not announce this information..”Hence, the claim of American actor Leonardo DiCaprio donating $10 million to Ukraine from various media houses is fake.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Are the Ukrainian people faking the bloodshed? Social media users have shared a video claiming that the Ukrainian people are using fake blood and portraying themselves as injured in front of the whole world. Amid Russia-Ukraine war.People now all over the internet are giving it the name of a propaganda war. It is said that actors are pretending to be the victims of the war through fake applications of blood.For the same, a user named @5thSu shared the video under the caption, “Empire of Lies, fake blood, video games clips, copious amounts of moaning and crying, and selfies”https://twitter.com/5thSu/status/1498454863319121920?s=20&t=GwsQNnfdo93_m5oZmT8m8QThe same video was shared on Facebook under the caption, “Crisis actors in Ukraine. The media is lying to everyone.Crisis actors are the ones who pretend to be the victims under a conspiracy theory.Fact Check:The video is not of the current situation of Ukraine. It is a clip from a Tv series of Ukraine, named “Contamin” by Ukrainian-based producer DRIU Productions.Through reverse search image, we also found that the video was of the year 2022 but of the year 2020.The pictures were also shared on Twitter by @CinemaPeople_ captioned, “Bts from aset of Contamin tv series.Conclusion:Hence, the video is not of the Russia-Ukraine war.Claim Review: Ukrainian people faking the bloodshed.Claimed by: social media usersFact Check: misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Are BSP’s Votes Going To BJP? Know The Complete Truth. A picture is going viral on the internet. Sharing the picture users are claiming that BSP votes are going to BJP. Along with the post, BSP Youth wrote, “Till now it seemed that the contest is BJP-SP vs BSP. But, now I believe that the contest is #EVM vs BSP. Let’s see #EVM wins that #BSP. But I will always oppose #EVM. BSP won the election with a majority and respected sister Mayawati Ji took over the reins of #UP for the fifth time, wishing you a lot of hearty congratulations at the feet of the Tathagata.Similarly, many other users have shared this picture with the claims that there is something wrong with the EVM machine and all the votes of BSP are going in the BJP.Fact CheckAfter doing the reverse image, we found that is an old picture. But, some users are circulating this image with misleading claims. We found the same picture on many social media accounts shared in the year 2019. Moreover, the account named Bsp party in Telangana shared the same viral image of the EVM on12th April 2019.Therefore, this image has no relation with the elections of Uttar Pradesh, in 2022.ConclusionHence, from our Fact check analysis, it is clear that the viral image of the EVM is old. Therefore, the claims made by posting this image are baseless and misleading. There is a plethora of fake news related to the elections. DFRAC warns the readers to rely only on authentic sources of information and not to believe any social media post before proper investigation. Moreover, if any reader has any doubt on any piece of information DFRAC is always there for them to analyze its credibility.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: The truth behind the picture of a man with his cat? The war between Russia-Ukraine has hit its 15th day with Russian forces striking at different parts of Ukraine like Zythomyr and Mariupol. On the other side president, Zelenskyy is no longer pressing for NATO membership for her country.Meanwhile, the updates and news regarding this war are all over the internet. With this, a picture of a man with his cat is getting viral on the internet under the caption, “Bombs & bullets will never break our bond with our companion animals.When we reverse search this image we found that this is an old image from Jan 17, 2018.it was covered in an Istanbul daily named DAILY SABAH with the headline, “Old Man In Tears Hugged His Beloved Cat As His Home Burns Down.”This picture was also was voted for “First Iftar of Turkish Soldiers” in the news category by Ozkan Bilgin, “Ali and his cat” in the life category by Ilhami Cetin, and “Sultans of Karate” in the sports category by Burak Akbulut.Conclusion:The photo getting viral is not from Russia-Ukraine war , but from the year 2018.Claim Review: The truth behind the picture of a man with his cat.Claimed by: @Neelprajapati09 and moreFact check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did People Themselves Came Out To Guard The EVM In UP? A video of a mob is going viral on the Social Media Platform. Sharing the video social media users are claiming that, the villagers themselves came to guard the EVM in the ongoing elections in UP.Sharing the video, Hansraj Meena said, “The people themselves have come on the road to teach a lesson to the dictatorship.” Though he later deleted his tweet we have the archived version of the tweet as proof.In the same vein, many users have posted this video on their social media handles.Fact CheckAfter doing the keyword research, our team found the viral video on Facebook. The video was uploaded on July 9, 2021, with the caption, “This video is from Dubulia block of Basti district, where Talewan Yadav was the candidate from Samajwadi Party.”Hence, from the above video, it is clear that this has nothing to do with the ongoing UP Elections 2022.Further, we also found a tweet of Rajesh Yadav dated July 9, 2021.जनपद बस्ती के दुबौलिया ब्लॉक से समाजवादी पार्टी प्रत्याशी श्री तालेवान यादव जी को भाजपाई गुण्डे जब नामांकन नही करने दिये तो आसपास के हजारों की संख्या में लोग तालेवान जी के समर्थन में निकल पड़े, फिर भाजपाई गुण्डों की क्या मजाल ब्लॉक परिसर के कोसों तक नजर नही आये। pic.twitter.com/UFXvg0Bfyv — Rajesh Yadav(Raju) (@rajeshyadavmlc) July 9, 2021ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check analysis it is clear that the users are sharing an old video with fake and misleading comments.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Fake image of a soldier got viral under Russia-Ukraine Conflict Russian airstrike has hit the hospital in Mariupol. As per president Zenlenskyy, women and children were injured in the airstrike. After seeing such attacks on Ukraine, social media is flooded with sympathy and support for Ukraine. Meanwhile, a picture of a soldier having tears in his eyes is getting viral.Linda posted the viral picture of a soldier carrying sorrow in his eyes and captioned it as Ukraine needs prayer in the time of war.Many other users also posted the same picture on 4th March 2022.https://twitter.com/filipvanessche/status/1499768523710767107?s=20&t=8sYk5iduQnztlLmS4FHRQwFact checkAfter reverse image search, we found that the image is from the article of The Sun in the year 2020. As per the article, the picture is of a soldier whose brother was martyred in war against the Taliban in 2008. His name is Pte Doherty and when he became the soldier after his brother, he burst out into tears. Hence proving that the image is not from the Russia-Ukraine conflict. It is two years old.Conclusion: the claim is misleading.Claim review: Fake image of a soldier got viral under Russia-Ukraine ConflictClaim by: LindaFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: IS AIMIM is actually surpassing other parties in UP Election Exit Poll? Today i.e. 10th March is the day of fate for all the political parties involved in UP Elections. Since morning every news channel is showcasing the exit poll results on their respected channels.In between all this hustle-bustle, much fake news is also trending on different social media sites.We came across a picture on Twitter by @ShubhamSinghOn2 showcasing the results of the exit poll under the caption, “This is the best Exit Poll.”(Hindi Translate)सबसे सही यही Exit Poll यही है बे ..😂 pic.twitter.com/PJeUZES4Hb — Shubham Singh Yadav (@ShubhamSinghOn2) March 7, 2022In this picture the maximum number of seats were shown to be of AIMIM (All India Majlis-E-Ittehadul Muslimeen) Party, with BJP (Bharatiya Janta Party) on second with 84 seats following SP (Samajwadi Party), BSP (Bahujan Samaj Party), And OTH with 56, 12, 01 respectively.A Facebook user too shared the same image on his Facebook account.Fact check:As all the news channels since morning is updating the people with the exit poll results.So a video was shared by ABP News on their official Twitter account showcasing the real exit poll results.सबसे सही यही Exit Poll यही है बे ..😂 pic.twitter.com/PJeUZES4Hb — Shubham Singh Yadav (@ShubhamSinghOn2) March 7, 2022At 9.00 A.M a picture was also shared by ABP News under the caption, “Uttar Pradesh’s final exit poll, 228 -244 seats for BJP and 132-148 for SP.”From the above picture and video, we can see that the picture above is morphed and is far away from the reality grounds.Conclusion:The picture shared on different social media is morphed one and is far away from the ground report.Claim Review: AIMIM is actually surpassing other parties in UP Election Exit PollClaimed by: social media users.Fact check: misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did CNN Post A Story Of  “The Karkhiv Kid Finder”? A screenshot of CNN is going viral on the internet. The screenshot includes a picture of a man. His name is written in the screenshot is Ivan Kotchinski. Moreover, it is written that he is a former primary school teacher. He has been traveling throughout the city and taking care of unaccompanied minors. And, locals have started calling him “the Karkhiv Kid finder” for his seemingly supernatural ability to find young boys who don’t have anybody protecting them.Similarly, many other social media users have posted this picture on their social media handle.Fact CheckAfter doing keyword research, our team found that CNN never posted any such news. And, the screenshot is fake.Moreover, the man in the screenshot is Vaush (real name is Ian Kochinski). He is an American Youtuber. He is a Libertarian socialist , Antifascist, and an average democracy enjoyer as described in his Twitter bio. Further, viewing his profile, we didn’t got any such video or claim of him being a Kid finder.ConclusionHence, it is clear that the viral screenshot is fake and the claim is false and baseless.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Truth behind the viral video of Zelensky dancing. Zelensky, president of Ukraine is getting mocked everywhere on social media. The video shows a man singing in Ukrainian and staring at the cleavage of the women present on stage.People are claiming that the person seen in the video with girls around Zelensky.Many Facebook users like Sunil Badileya , @Mysteryman6162 etc writes in hindi, “यूक्रेन के महान राष्ट्रपति – वोलोदयमिर ज़लेंस्क्य! अकेले पूरी रशियन फौज का डट कर मुकाबला करते हुए।!जैसा नेता चुनोगे वैसा देश को भुगतना पड़ेगा|” which translates to, “Friends, Let’s present to you. The new global hero, intellectual, brand (a slur to describe liberals), new brother-in-law of the elite. Great President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Alone, he is fighting against the whole Russian army. Salute to you”Fact Check:Through reverse image search, we found this video that is claimed of recent times is basically from the year 2017. Also, the guy in the video is a former comedian turned Ukrainian administrative official Vasily Gumenyuk singing in a sexualized-comedy skit.A news site named telegraf shared a news w2ith headline, “Comedian from the “League of Laughter” was appointed as head of the RGA in Khmelnitsky: Zelensky’s decree”Another Ukrainian site posted a picture of gumenyuk as a freshly appointed Head of RGAConclusion:The person in the video is misidentified as zelensky, as in actuality he is Comedian from the “League of Laughter now turned head of RGA Vasily Gumenyuk.Claim Review: Truth behind the viral video of Zelensky dancing.Claimed by: Sunil Badileya , @Mysteryman6162 etcFact Check: False.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Has Russia made a military move on the backyard of America in 2022?   After Russia’s order for keeping nuclear arms on high alert under the Ukraine-Russia conflict. A claim is getting viral on social media where users are claiming that Putin is making military moves in America’s backyard.Security Affairs International posted a video on Facebook which is a recording of news covered by CNN over Putin’s military moves in the backyard of America as well as the military tension between Russia and America. The video was posted on 2nd March 2022.Frank Iroroh.com posted a video the same viral video over Putin’s military moves towards America. According him Russia deploys two nuke bombers in the US’s backward Venezuela on 1st March 2022.Fact checkAfter digging further, we got the video of CNN. The viral video was from the 2018 when Russia was trying to establish a hold near the American shores. A military tension was witnessed between Russia and America at that time.CNN posted the video on their YouTube page in the year 2018. Therefore the video is old and again getting viral on social with certain claims.Another proof where in the article of The Guardian, Russia has landed Nuclear-capable “Black-jack” bombers in Venezuela in order to show support with Nicolas Madura, president of Venezuela. Most importantly the article was published 3 years back. Hence proving that the claim and news are old and now again getting viral.Conclusion: the claim is misleadingClaim review: Russia made a military move on the backyard of America in 2022Claim by: Security Affairs InternationalFact check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Are the NATO Countries transferring 70 combat airplanes to Ukraine? Amid the Russia-Ukraine war, many news are paving their way into social media and getting the attention of everyone.Similarly, a new picture related to the Russia-Ukraine war is getting the attraction of most of the people on social media platforms. The news is shared by Unews Press Agency captioned as, “Three #NATO countries to transfer 70 combat airplanes to #Ukraine.Another Facebook page RT(Russian Outlet) shared the same news on march 1 under the caption, “Bulgaria, Poland, and Slovakia are said to be delivering 70+ airplanes for the Ukrainian military.”Fact Check:A newspaper EURACTIV shared a news and the headline was Bulgaria will not send fighter, troops to Ukraine.Poland President Andrez Duda said on March 1 in the NATO Press conference that he will not send any jets to UkraineNewspaper The Salvok Spectator Slovakia mentioned in the headline Salvokia won’t give its fighter jets to Ukraine, but may ground them earlier than planned.Conclusion:EU foreign policy chief Joseph Borrell gave this statement mistakenly on Feb 27 and clarified his statement to the public the next day i.e on Feb 28.Claim Review: NATO Countries transferring 70 combat airplanes to Ukraine.Claimed by: RT(Russian Outlet) and other social media users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Ukraine invade Iraq in 2003? Ukraine President Zelenskyy no longer wants to join NATO, National Atlantic Treaty Organization. In short, Zelenskyy is ready to negotiate under two clauses with Russia. A picture is getting viral over social media which has a claim that Ukraine invaded Iraq in 2003. Amjad Islam Amjad also mentioned that the crusaders sent a tank to Iraq which is now destroyed likewise Ukraine is destroyed.In the viral picture, we can see a tank on which the emblem of Ukraine is printed. The tweet was posted on March 2, 2022.In 2003, Ukraine invaded IraqThe tank was sent by the Crusaders to IraqDestroyed Today, Ukraine itself has been destroyed#RussiaUkraine pic.twitter.com/hIt5xUdLnf — Amjad Islam Amjad (@A_IslamAmjad) March 2, 2022fancyELITEboy posted the same viral picture with the tank. Likewise, he made the same claim over Ukraine invading Iraq.IF THIS IS TRUE, why should I cry, when all I see is Kama, In 2003, Ukraine invaded IraqThe tank was sent by the Crusaders to IraqDestroyed Today, Ukraine itself has been destroyed#RussiaUkraine #RussianUkrainianWar pic.twitter.com/aZQoEs4yFc — Mummy Zee🇳🇬🇬🇭 (@Chikezie84) March 2, 2022Fact checkAfter doing the reverse image search, we found that the picture was photoshopped, the original image was from the article of 2013 when Iraq reiterates its commitment to pay Kuwait compensation. In the original picture, there’s no such print of a Ukrainian emblem. Hence proving that the image is photoshopped and most importantly the US, UK and Poland were the ones who invaded Iraq in 2003 and not Ukraine.Conclusion: the image is photoshopped and the claim is misleading.Claim review: Ukraine invaded Iraq in 2003Claim by: Amjad Islam AmjadFact check: fake
label: truth

content: Fact check: Has the first female pilot of Ukraine died in the Russia-Ukraine war? Under the Ukraine-Russia conflict, users are claiming that the first female pilot of Ukraine has died due to severe injury. Raja Hassan Kiyani posted a tweet over the demise of the Ukrainian Female Pilot on 1st March. He has inserted a picture of a female and claimed that she is the first female pilot of Ukraine.https://twitter.com/naremansalam/status/1497621974666858497?s=20&t=Oc1sUg3ijRvs5jejHTiLZwUkraine's first female fighter pilot died after being severely injured today. 😥Valhalla awaits the hero 🇺🇦Первая в Украине женщина-летчик-истребитель погибла 😥 после тяжелого ранения сегодня pic.twitter.com/dizFVKt8uo — CHE GUEVARA (@DJDOM59) February 27, 2022Fact checkAfter cross-checking, we found Nadiya Savchenko first female pilot of Ukraine. She is a present politician in Ukraine Parliament and has worked in the army till 2014 after that she became the Ukraine delegate to the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe in January 2015. Last but most important she is alive as well. People are spreading the fake picture as well the claim of her demise.The article of the Los Angeles Times covered the news where she got freed in 2016 by Russian authority after spending two years behind the bar. She was imprisoned for killing two Russian Journalists.After seeing the picture, it is clear that the viral picture is not matching with the original picture of the first female pilot.Conclusion: the claim is fakeClaim review: the first female pilot of Ukraine died in the Russia-Ukraine warClaim by: Raja Hassan KiyaniFact check: Fake
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did Ukrainian citizens destroy 2 Russian tanks with Molotov cocktails in Kiev? The momentum between the Russia-Ukraine war is increasing each hour. Russia launched a full-scale military invasion on Feb 24, 2022. Since then things have escalated between the two countries.Meanwhile, on Social media sites, we saw certain posts going viral all around the globe.Certain pictures of the explosion got viral claiming it to be of recent times. So many people took it as an opportunity to praise the brave hearts of Ukraine.MAYURESH writes, “Ukrainian citizens destroy 2 Russian tanks with Molotov cocktails (Petrol, Gasoline) in Keiv. They are using guerrilla war tactics to counter the Russian army in their capital. Salute your courage✊ #Ukraine #RussiaUkraineWar”Ukrainian citizens destroy 2 Russian tanks with molotov cocktails(Petrol, Gasoline) in Kiev. They are using the guerrilla war tactics to counter russian army in their capital. Salute your courage✊ #Ukraine #RussiaUkraineWar pic.twitter.com/lszsUyN6bl — Mayuresh (@mayuresh2110) February 26, 2022Another Facebook page “ Republic-Times news“ posted the same under the same caption in Hindi .Fact Check:By reverse image search we found that the same images on the web platforms like Flicker and gettyimages. Through these platforms, we learned that images getting viral on social media sites in recent times are old images from January from the year 2014.The reason was Ukrainian anti-government protesters who throw Molotov cocktails during clashes with riot police in central Kiev.The news was also covered by a newsletter “THE CONVERSATION” giving the details of the protest held in the year 2014.Conclusion:Although the images are from keiv, Ukraine but from the protest against the government in the year 2014 and not of Russia-Ukraine war.Claim Review: Ukrainian citizens destroy 2 Russian tanks with Molotov cocktails in Kiev.Claimed by: “ Republic-Times news“and others.Fact Check: misleading..
label: truth

content: Fact check: Has slogans were raised in favor of PM Modi in the Parliamentary session of Pakistan. Almost 3k plus students have reached safely from Ukraine to India according to the reports. As per the BJP Punjab, Pakistani are raising the slogan of ‘Imran Murdabad and Modi Zindabad.’ After news of Pakistani students saving themselves by putting India’s flag on their vehicle from Ukraine is getting viral, since then users are claiming that people are praising Narendra Modi in Pakistan.BJP Punjab also posted the same video of Pakistan Parliamentary session on their Facebook page. They also used a #मोदी_है_तो_मुमकिन_हैRakesh Goel a verified account on Twitter and a state head from BJP also posted the same video and the same claim about appreciation of PM Modi in the Parliamentary session.Fact checkAfter digging further, we got the full video of the Parliamentary session on YouTube. The video is of the speech given by Shah Mehmood Qureshi in the parliament on 26th October, 2020. In the speech he accused the other politician for behaving likewise Modi or following his ideology. In the whole speech no such appreciation were given to Narendra Modi rather people were criticizing him.Dunya News, posted the video and captioned it with, ‘Shah Mehmood Qureshi Speech in National Assembly | 26 October 2020 | Dunya News | HB1L’.In fact, Dawn also covered the speech of foreign Minister Shah Mehmood Qureshi in the National Assembly over a resolution unanimously passed in the assembly on blasphemous sketches.Conclusion: Therefore, the claim is misleading as no such slogans were raised in the favor of PM Modi in the National Assembly.Claim review: slogans were raised in favor of PM Modi in the Parliamentary session of Pakistan.Claim by: BJP PunjabFact check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check:  Did Putin say,” Russia will play FIFA World Cup in Qatar, or there won’t be WORLD CUP at all.” FIFA and UEFA now have decided to expel all Russians from all types of the international club or national soccer competitions. Meanwhile, the Russian Football Union (RFU) after a few days, decided to appeal to the Court of Arbitration to Sport such sanction.To this, a picture is getting viral on social media. A page names TV channel shared this picture under the caption:Putin said that “FIFA must not enter into war politics, The National Football team of Russia will play FIFA World Cup in Qatar, or there won’t be WORLD CUP at all”Putin said that “FIFA must not enter into war politics, The National Football team of Russia will play FIFA World Cup in Qatar, or there won’t be WORLD CUP at all”#UkraineRussianWar #Russia p pic.twitter.com/AIJTjTsyGI — TV Channel (@mdntvlive) March 5, 2022A Twitter user truthteller shared it on its official page.https://twitter.com/Truthte83602973/status/1499850637902848009?s=20&t=JbS5-6YqJ0_H-Qb4Z3cMcQFact Check:No such statement was given by Putin. In actuality RFU(Russian Football Union) appeals to CAS against the decisions of FIFA and UEAF“As shared by Tariq panja on Twitter and captioned it as, “Russian Football Union confirms it will appeal its expulsion from football and called for an accelerated hearing to ensure there’s a decision before March’s World Cup playoffs.”Russian Football Union confirms it will appeal its expulsion from football and called for an accelerated hearing to ensure there’s a decision before March’s World Cup playoffs. pic.twitter.com/NiRsajnHvT — tariq panja (@tariqpanja) March 3, 2022Conclusion:No such statement was given by Putin. Therefore it is fake in nature.Claim review: Putin say,” Russia will play FIFA World Cup in Qatar, or there won’t be WORLD CUP at all.”Claimed by: socil media users.Fact check: Fake.
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Fake Claim Made By Global Times. Know The Reality In this ongoing Russia and Ukraine crisis, many people are speculating on India’s move. Many fake pictures and claims are getting viral on social media platforms related to this. In the same vein, a picture of Qutub Minar getting massively viral on the internet. Sharing the image Global Times, wrote the caption that, “India lit up the Qutb Minar, one of the landmark buildings in New Delhi, with the colors of the Russian flag.”Similarly, many other social media users also shared this picture on their handles.Fact checkOn our fact check analysis, we found that this was shared from the official handle of Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana. They shared this picture on 5 March 2022, to commemorate the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav at Qutub Minar.Qutub Minar illuminated with Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav and Jan Aushadhi theme from 5-7th March 2022.@pmbjppmbi @AmritMahotsav #JanaushadhiDiwas2022 #AmritMahotsav pic.twitter.com/ddkG3kB1KL — Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (@pmbjppmbi) March 5, 2022Hence, watching the above tweet it is clear that the @globaltimesnews which is a China state-affiliated media, shared a fake claim that Qutub Minar added the colour of the Russian Flag on the it.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Was a Muslim woman thrown from a moving bus for wearing a hijab? Know the truth of viral video. A video is going viral on social media. In which it was claimed that a Muslim woman was thrown from a moving bus by RSS workers for wearing a hijab.Fact Check:On checking the viral video, we found that this video is from Bangladesh. This video was published by ‘ATN Bangla News’ channel on 09 March 2021. In which it was told that the woman was pushed for not paying the bus fare.According to the news channel report, this incident came to the fore in Rohitpur area on Dhaka-Nawabganj road in Keraniganj, Bangladesh. In this case, the accused bus driver and helper were immediately arrested by the team of the local Rapid Action Battalion (RAB).Conclusion:Hence the viral video is misleading. Because this incident is not of India but of Bangladesh.Claim Review: A Muslim woman was thrown from a moving bus for wearing a hijab.Claimed by: Social Media Users.Fact Check: Fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is cash is being distributed on UP Lok Shaba’S Election BY BJP? In the last phase of the UP election, a new video has come forward which was shown to be of NEWS18. In that video, People are accusing BJP (Bharatiya Janta Party) of distributing 500 rupees amid Elections. All these people were inked on the finger and were directed not to vote.The video was allegedly shared by Om Thanvi, HJ State University of Journalism & Mass Com, Jaipur.Captioned it as, “The world’s largest democracy!”Many social media users like Om Rakesh Kumar too shared this video on Facebook.Fact Check:By reverse image search and using different key phrases we found the video as old one.This video is an old video from Tara Jivanpur village of Chandauli district in Uttar Pradesh in the year 2019 which is again being shared on social media sites.The true video of this incident was shared on the YouTube channel of NEWS18 AND MIRROR NOW .Chandauli Police too warned people about the Misleading viral video, they stated on their official Twitter account, “The case is of the year 2019 Lok Sabha elections, in which necessary action has been taken at that time, by linking it to #विधानसभाचुनाव2022 , please do not spread confusion without proper information and confirmation of facts.”Conclusion:This video is old, hence misleading.Claim Review: cash is being distributed on UP Lok Shaba’S Election BY BJPClaimed by: Om Thanvi, Rakesh Kumar etc.Fact check: misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: A viral picture suggesting Salman Khan and Sonakshi Sinha as married. The wedding of famous Bollywood Actor Salman Khan has always been a buzz in India. This buzz got more fire when recently a picture was shared on social media sites showcasing Sonakshi Sinha (Bollywood actress) and Salman Khan where Salman is seen dressed in a white sherwani and Sonakshi is in a red bridal lehenga as a married couple. People all over the internet are talking about their secret marriage.An image was shared by Quick Times states, “Salman Khan secretly marriage With Sonakshi Sinha.”https://twitter.com/aishamalik4u/status/1498899880655400961?s=20&t=2K5zf0JJ13EpkcMW5sT2MQFact Check:By only looking at the picture it can be said that the picture is morphed and not a real picture.Many media houses like The Tribune, etc have published this news and claimed it as fake news.Sonakshi too has spoken on this picture, asking people, “are you dumb that you cannot tell the difference between a real and morphed image.”Conclusion:The image getting viral is morphed image and not a real one.Claim Review: A viral picture suggesting Salman Khan and Sonakshi Sinha as married.Claimed by: Social media users.Fact Check: fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is President Putin declaring a war on Africa with Missiles for talking about Ukraine? A Tik-Tok video is getting viral on many profiles from Facebook where it is shown in the video that the President of Russia, Putin has declared a War on Africa.The running subtitles are claiming that Putin is warning people not to interfere in the War and threaten our people will have to face the consequences. the subtitles says,“I have made a decision of a military operation. How can Kenya invade our missions? Kenya has put itself in a war that it can’t even shoot a single bullet. Bombing Kenya will only take a few minutes from my military men. As from now, we will start sending our missiles to Nairobi so we can destruct Kenya,”The whole link to the video is attached in the image below and was shared by NCB on 24th februrary.Fact Check:When we Research the video and ran the video on Google translator we found that the speech of Putin did not match with the English subtitles. According to the real speech this is what Putin said:“I have decided to conduct a special military operation. Whoever tries to prevent us, and even more so, to create threats for our country for our people, should know that Russia’s response will be immediate and will lead you to such consequences that you have never seen in your history,”A news firm called BARRON’S too have shared the whole speech of Putin.Conclusion:Therefore the videos getting viral on Facebook are morphed videos and not true.Claim Review: President Putin declaring a war on Africa with Missels for talking about Ukraine.Claimed by: Fcaebook users.Fact Check: fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Police Arrested SP Leader’s Daughter For Spreading Fake News? Many videos of students stuck in Ukraine requesting the Indian government for help are going viral on the internet. Meanwhile, an image of a girl sitting on the ground with police officers standing is getting massively viral on social media. Sharing the image users are claiming that she is SP Leader’s Daughter. And, she made a fake video of her that she is in Ukraine. Along with the post, Rajesh Chaudhary wrote the caption, It’s amazing that UP Police is the fastest. Village head daughter of former block chief and SP leader rescued from Ukraine by UP PoliceSimilarly, many users shared this picture on their handles. With the claim, that she is Vaishali Yadav, the daughter of Hardoi’s Gram Pradhan, Samajwadi party leader. And, she made a fake appeal video from Ukraine rescued by UP police’.In the same vein, Naveen Kumar Jindal shared a post with the caption, “Vaishali Yadav, daughter of SP leader Mahendra Yadav, made a video from her home at the behest of her father to defame the Modi government.”सपाई नेता महेंद्र यादव की पुत्री वैशाली यादव ने अपने पिता के कहने पर मोदी सरकार को बदनाम करने के लिए अपने घर से ही वीडियो बना दिया। लाल टोपी मतलब रेड अलर्ट pic.twitter.com/bX0JIKuve2 — Naveen Kr Jindal 🇮🇳(मोदी का परिवार) (@naveenjindalbjp) March 2, 2022Fact CheckAfter doing a google image reverse search, we found a report of Amarujala. From the report, it is clear that she is Kamala Chaudhary, not Vaishali Yadav. She was arrested in Nagaur, Rajasthan under Arms and IT Act.Moreover, we also found a Tweet of the Nagaur Police with the caption, “Quick action of Nagaur Police! The girl created an atmosphere of fear among the general public by making a video viral with a weapon on social media. Within 24 hours, the girl was arrested from Nagaur.”ConclusionHence, it is clear that users are sharing the picture with fake and baseless claims.
label: rumor

content: Raid On Fake: Timeline of Fake News on Russia & Ukraine Crisis Momentum is building up between the two countries Russia and Ukraine leading to a war-like situation. Now both the countries have entered the 10th day into such a situation, to which the US has held the hand of Ukraine by sending tons of weapons and ammunition to the Ukraine army. Where on the other side Russians on the west are trying to talk it all loud in GENEVA.The situation is heating up and the tension between Russia and Ukraine is increasing every hour, the Russian military has too launched a military war against Ukraine, resulting in the killing of more than 2000 civilians.Where It All Started?So to know how it all started let’s dig into the history:The Russian-Ukrainian War began in 2014 when the Russian troops annexed Crimea from Ukraine.This all began as an internal Ukrainian crisis in November 2013, when President Viktor Yanukovych showed no interest to join hands with NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organisation) which lead to a great protest against victor forcing him to run away from the country.In April 2014 with low-level fighting between the Ukrainian military and Russian. The separatist rebels seized some towns in predominantly Russian-speaking eastern Ukraine. It has since escalated and remains an undeclared war between the two countries.Fake News That Paved Its Way into these crises?In between these tensions, many videos and pictures are getting viral all over social media and getting the attraction of many people.So through our research, we have spotted such fake and misleading pictures and videos to show the real picture from the ongoing scenario.Claim1. The picture of The Woman Holding A Riffle On A Bus is from Ukraine.Fact Check: This same Image was found on Reddit which was 7 months old hence, cannot be of recent Ukraine.Claim2: Subramanian Swamy, Zee Tv(DNA), and News18 shared an image of ISCKON Temple distributing food to Ukrainians on their official account.Fact Check: The pictures getting viral is from 2015 which was shared on ISCKON Temple’s official website and the image was used in the article.Claim3: Photo of the injured girl going viral is from the 2018 Syrian war is again used in the Ukraine war.Fact Check: This picture is from the Syrian War. Which was published by the BBC in one of its articles on January 6, 2018.Claim4: Ukrainian President, Volodymyr Zelenskyy has put on the military costume amid the war.Fact Check: The image was uploaded on December 6, 2021, when Volodymyr Zelenskyy visited the military in Donbas, as already captured by gettyimages.Claim 5: Zelenskyy has joined the army to fights against the Russian Army. In the same way, another news of the vice-president’s wife joining the Ukraine army is going viral.Fact Check: The picture is of 2021. I-stock posted the same picture on 22 August 2021 on the celebration of 30 years to Ukraine’s Independence, also the Lady is not the wife of the Vice-president of Ukraine. Hence the picture is not of the Ukraine-Russia war.Claim 6: Amid Russia’s attack on Ukraine a huge explosion can be seen claiming it to be an attack on Ukraine headquarters.Fact Check: Video of the explosion at Beirut Port In which nearly 218 people were killed and 7,000 were injured in the explosion caused by the storage of a large amount of ammonium nitrate.Claim 7: Two young Ukrainian children holding hands of each other, sending off soldiers to fight the Russians.Fact Check: the picture is from Ukrainian National News(UNN). This report was published on March 23, 2016. Under the headline’ “A series of photos “Children of War” was published by the Ministry of Defense.”Claim 8: The Sikh community raising a helping hand is getting viral on social media amid the Russia-Ukraine war.Fact Check: WeTheSikhs posted the same picture of a food truck in 2018 food truck as it is Canada’s first free food truck and it works as Langar.Claim 9: An emotional video is shared, where it is seen that the men in uniforms are leaving for war and giving a tight hug, showing the scene of Anxiety, fear, and love.Fact Check: this video is from a documentary film of Ukraine titled, ‘The War Of Chimeras’ from the year 2017.Claim 10: Ukrainian Interior Ministry confirms that its capital Kyiv is under attack from Russian cruise and ballistic missiles and war has begun.Fact Check: This picture is of Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip, controlled by the Palestinian Islamist movement Hamas, and was of May 10, 2021.Claim 11: The video was shared by Zee news under the caption, “जंग के बीच रूस पहुंचे Imran Khan के साथ हो गया खेल” which translates into Imran khan got played when he reached Russia in between the war.Fact Check: The video getting viral is an old video from Parade rehearsal 05/04/2020, Air part, Flight of aircraft over Tushino.Claim 12: A video is getting massively viral on the internet. Sharing the video, social media users are writing the caption, “Russian military paratroopers land in Ukraine, near Kharkov.”Fact Check: The video was uploaded on 18th september, 2016 with the caption, “Massive air ‘desant’. Russian Airborne Troops is the strategic reserve of the Supreme commander and subordinate to the President of Russia.Conclusion:Lot many fake news are all around the internet. It is advice able to confirm the news first and then share it if real to the on-going scenario. We at DFRAC (Digital Forensics Research And Analytic Center) always search such fake news and present the reality in front of you. So that you are always updated with the outside world and news.
label: truth
