content: Fact Check: Are Ukrainians uploading videos on Tik-Tok teaching how to drive abandoned and captured vehicles? Amid the 10th day of the war, heavy fighting and shelling continue on the borders and different parts of Russia and Ukraine.Russia has declared a full-scale invasion of Ukraine which has resulted in displacing over 1 million people on February 24th. Meanwhile many fake news is coming forward on the situation diverting the people on social media by not showing the real picture of the scenario.A video teaching how to drive abandoned and captured trucks is getting viral on social media. There is a girl shown in the video who is actually teaching the masses about how to drive the vehicle.@JoshuaPotash writes on Twitter, “The future is a very weird place. Ukrainians are uploading videos on TikTok about how to drive abandoned or captured Russian military vehicles.”https://twitter.com/JoshuaPotash/status/1498332884121399307?s=20&t=NGWY_YJ6r-a3MMWXRG1oAwAnother user @SharonsRose13 takes up the Twitter and write, “Posted @withregram @jewishbreakingnews WATCH: Ukrainians are uploading videos on TikTok and Instagram showing Ukrainians how to drive abandoned or captured Russian military vehicles.”Posted @withregram • @jewishbreakingnews WATCH: Ukrainians are uploading videos on TikTok and Instagram showing Ukrainians how to drive abandoned or captured Russian military vehicles. https://t.co/dUY2HbA0Hz — Sabrina Hogan (@SharonsRose13) March 1, 2022Fact Check:By digging into the video more by Reverse Image Search. We found that this video is from February 2021. Hence, not of the recent times. The girl in the video is also not from Ukraine.We too found the Instagram handle of the girl named tymannastya. Shttps://dfrac.org/hi/?p=10430&preview=truehe has posted this video on her reels section which she reposted again 4 days ago. It was very prominent from her account that she is into cars and most of her videos are like this only telling people about different vehicles.Conclusion:The video is not from recent times but from the year 2021.Claim Review: Ukrainians uploading videos on Tik-Tok teaching how to drive abandoned and captured vehicles.Claimed by: @JoshuaPotash , @SharonsRose13 and other social media users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Has the Japanese Ambassador become a Samurai warrior to fight against Russia? After Ukraine President, Volodymyr Zelenskyy now rumours of Miss Ukraine Anastasiia Lenna joining the army has also got viral. In a report of Indian Express, the rumours were nullified by beauty pageant winner, herself. Under the conflict Russian invasion of Ukraine, a picture of the Japanese Ambassador in Kyiv is going viral. Korsunsky Sergiy, a Japanese user shared a picture of a man, dressed up in a Samurai costume with a sward on February 15, 2022. He considered the man as a warrior fighting against Russia in the caption of his tweet.We know what we are fighting for. How about Russia?私たちは何のために戦っているのかを知っています。ロシアはどうですか？ pic.twitter.com/8FEInU3bWn — セルギー・コルスンスキー駐日ウクライナ特命全権大使 (@KorsunskySergiy) February 15, 2022Mikael Salo, a Facebook user posted the same picture of a samurai man and identified him as a Japanese ambassador in Ukraine. He also considered him a warrior and posted the picture on 27th February 2022.Fact checkAfter searching for the Japanese ambassador to Ukraine, we found that the man shown in the picture is not the ambassador. Instead, Matsuda Kuninori is the working ambassador of Japan to Ukraine. In 2021, he attained the position.Therefore, the picture and claim is fake as the Samurai man is not the Japanese ambassador of Ukraine.Claim Review: the Japanese Ambassador became a Samurai warrior to fight against Russia.Claim by: Mikael SaloFact check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Putin Greets Indian Students Evacuated From Ukraine? Indian Nationals stuck in Ukraine in this ongoing war situation is a matter of big concern for India. Consequently, the Government of India started an operation Ganga to evacuate Indian Students from Ukraine amidst the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine. Meanwhile, a video is going viral on the internet. Sharing the video users are claiming that Putin greets Indian students evacuated From Ukraine.Along with the post, Durai Raj K wrote, Russian President Putin himself directly went on aircraft of (AI) AIR INDIA to convince Indians. What a Respect for India. Be proud of to be an Indian.Similarly, Srinivasan Krishnamoorthy wrote, Rushian President Putin himself went on aircraft of Air India to convince Indians. What a Respect for India. Be proud of to be an Indian. Many other users also have posted this on their handles.Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis we found that the viral video is completely fake and baseless. On reverse image search, we found that the viral video is of India’s Ambassador to Romania Rahul Srivastava interacting with Indian students evacuated from Ukraine. However, some users are sharing this video with the false claim that Putin himself interacted with the Indian students evacuating from Ukraine. After that, we also found a Tweet from the official account of DD news with the caption, “Watch | India’s Ambassador to Romania, Rahul Shrivastava, interacted with evacuated students from #Ukraine who were on their way to Mumbai from Romania.”Watch | India's Ambassador to Romania, Rahul Shrivastava, interacted with evacuated students from #Ukraine who were on their way to Mumbai from Romania@eoiromania pic.twitter.com/QznhisS0Vd — DD News (@DDNewslive) February 26, 2022Moreover, Piyush Goal has also shared the video on his Twitter account with the caption, “These encouraging words by India’s ambassador to Romania to our students returning home, is what the Govt. under PM @NarendraModi Ji stands for. Committed to every Indian anywhere in the world.”ये जो देश है तेरा, स्वदेश है तेरा…🇮🇳 These encouraging words by India's ambassador to Romania to our students returning home, is what the Govt. under PM @NarendraModi ji stands for. Committed to every Indian anywhere in the world. निराश न होना, आस ना खोना! pic.twitter.com/4djL0NtOEc — Piyush Goyal (मोदी का परिवार) (@PiyushGoyal) February 26, 2022ConclusionHence, it is clear that Putin has not come to greet Indian students evacuating from Ukraine. But, some users are sharing the video of India’s Ambassador to Romania Rahul Srivastava.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Do civilians of Ukraine are fighting with the cardboard made AK-47 against Russia?   Another picture from Ukraine is getting viral on social media. As the conflict between Russia and Ukraine is neither coming to an end nor has a settlement been made under the conflict.In the picture, two civilians are holding AK 47 made up of Cardboard. People are claiming that some civilians will fight in the war with these cardboard guns against Russia. Ethan M. tweeted, ‘What is the max effective range of a cardboard AK-47?’ on 1st March 2022. Many users are spreading the picture on social media and making fun of Ukraine in the caption.https://twitter.com/3MOOR30910/status/1498503603740413952?s=20&t=Jd5LFtThnFFuZrqhHaDLXQhttps://twitter.com/VerumBellator1/status/1497720731043450887?s=20&t=Eka2KGKRVfMG97M1akAlLwFact checkThe picture is of a session conducted by Ukraine defence officials to teach how to hold and use weapons for survival in war. I-stock posted the same picture on 19th February 2022 and mentioned the territorial defence drill given to the people of Kharvik, Ukraine.Business Insider India has also posted how people are spreading misleading news by using pictures.Therefore, the claim is misleading as officers were taking drill sessions to civilians and not using them to fight in the war.Claim Review: People of Ukraine are the cardboard made guns in the warClaim by: Ethan M.Fact check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Is Paul McCartney asking the crowd to support Ukraine by hosting the Ukrainian flag? Amid Russia and Ukraine war people around the globe are presenting their opinion in one way or the other over social media sites. Some are supporting Ukraine others are supporting Russia. In the midst of all this, much fake news is circulating on social media sites diverting people from the real scenario.One more time an image of Paul McCartney is getting viral in which he is seen holding the flag of Ukraine in his hands in one of his concerts. People all over the internet are praising him as he came forward to show his support to Ukraine.One of his fans showed her happiness over this and wrote on Twitter:Thank you, sir Paul, and thanks to everyone who supports our country these days. It means so much to us! My husband, friends, colleagues and all of Ukrainians have felt so positive after seeing this. We grab for each positive news.#StopPutin #SaveUkraine — Liuda Kyslenko (@Liuda_li) February 27, 2022The same level of excitement and happiness was witnessed on Facebook too as can be seen above.Fact Check:Through reverse image search, we get to know that the image of Paul holding a Ukrainian flag which is getting much love and appreciation from all over the world on social media sites is actually an old image from one of his concerts.The concert pic is from the year 2008. The pic is from the independent Concert in Independence Square on June 14, 2008, in Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine.The picture was posted by gettyimagesPaul McCartney too wrote on his official Twitter account on this image, in which he said that he remembered the concert in Ukraine and is supporting the country.As can be seen here.Remembering playing for our friends in Ukraine in Independence Square in 2008 and thinking of them in these difficult times. We send our love and support. 🇺🇦 #StandWithUkraine 1/2 pic.twitter.com/aGTQ3xW9KX — Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) February 28, 2022Conclusion:Although Paul showed his support to Ukraine, but by posting an old picture from his concert at Independence Square, Ukraine. Which people thought is of recent times.Hence, this picture is misleading.Claim Review: Paul McCartney asked the crowd to support Ukraine by hosting the Ukrainian flag.Claimed by: Social Media Users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did actress Sara Ali Khan tweet about the Hijab controversy? A screenshot of Bollywood actress Sara Ali Khan’s tweet regarding the ongoing hijab controversy in Karnataka is going viral. In which it was said that Muslim girls wear hijab only in Muslim areas because they are sexually harassed there.Fact Check:To check the above screenshot, we first checked Sara Ali Khan’s Twitter account. During this we found that the verified Twitter account of Sara Ali Khan is in the name of @SaraAliKhan. Whereas the username @WhoSaraAli has been given in the screenshot.When this account was investigated, it was found that there is no such account on Twitter. At the same time, we did not find any such tweet on Sara Ali Khan’s verified Twitter account @SaraAliKhan.Conclusion:So it is clear that the screenshot of the tweet going viral in the name of Sara Ali Khan is fake.Claim Review: Sara Ali Khan tweeted about the Hijab controversy.Claimed by: @WhoSaraAliFact Check: fake
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Akhilesh Yadav appeal to cancel the election in Kunda? UP Elections have reached their 6th phase and today CM Yogi Adityanath will face assembly election as a contestant in Gorakhpur. CM Yogi is found confident over winning 80% of seats in UP.Meanwhile, a claim is getting viral on social media by Rajhuraj Pratap Singh MLA from Kunda District in Uttar Pradesh. He claimed that SP president Akhilesh Yadav has shared a video from Haryana and claimed that a man is caught doing illegal activities on the Kunda election booth. SP President also appealed to cancel the assembly polling in Kunda.Rajhuraj Pratap Singh posted the tweet with embedding Akhilesh Yadav’s tweet inserting a picture on 1st March 2022.आदरणीय ⁦@yadavakhilesh⁩ जी, आप एक दल के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष हैं और वरिष्ठ राजनेता भी, उक्त वीडियो 2019 के चुनाव का हरियाणा का है जिसे आप कुण्डा का बताकर चुनाव निरस्त करने की माँग कर रहे हैं, राजनीति में इतनी घृणा भी अच्छी नहीं होती। pic.twitter.com/NyBiv6yoAs — Raja Bhaiya (@Raghuraj_Bhadri) March 1, 2022Fact checkAfter checking the authenticity of the tweet, we found no such tweet on the Twitter profile of Akhilesh Yadav. We only found one tweet where he wrote that goon’s governance will stop and people from different caste will work together in Kunda. He also claimed that the people of Kunda will demand no BJP in this election. The tweet was made on 27th February 2022. He also inserted a video of Bharat Samachar which covered news of SP candidate Gulshan Yadav from Pratapgarh being attacked in Kunda during the polling.Therefore the claim is fake and the picture is edited.Claim review: Akhilesh Yadav appealed to cancel the polling in KundaClaim by: Rajhuraj Pratap SinghFact check: Fake
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Karnataka High Court Permit Muslim Girls To Attend Class In Hijab? The image claims that breaking news! Muskan won. Karnataka high court permitted that Muslim girls can take education in the Hijab. Further, the Karnataka High Court on Wednesday said the uniform prescribed by the schools and colleges should be followed till the disposal of the case.ConclusionHence, from our analysis, it is clear that the viral image is fake and misleading. content: Fact Check: Did Putin Says PM Modi Is His Childhood Friend? The whole world has its eyes on the ongoing Russia-Ukraine crisis. content: Fact Check: Did Subramanian Swamy shared fake image about ISKCON Temple on his official account ? The tensions between Russia and Ukraine are increasing each passing day. Hindus of AOL and Hindus of ISKON in the forefront to help the people of Ukraine even if the Govt which came to power on a Hindu wave is silent on Russian blatant aggression against a free country pic.twitter.com/A7Kx5aeVeN — Subramanian Swamy (@Swamy39) March 1, 2022Also, big media houses like News18 and ZEE Media (DNA) have shared this picture.Fact Check:Through reverse image search, we found that the pictures getting viral is from 2015 which was shared on the website and the image was used in the article.Another image that is getting viral on social media is of the Relief work done at Chechnya, Chechnya is a constituent republic of Russia situated in the North Caucasus in Eastern Europe, close to the Caspian Sea is also shared on the official website of ISKCON.We also cross-checked the media this viral news where it is claimed that ISKCON Temples are providing humanitarian aid. content: Fact check: Did Russia bombard at Ukraine Headquarters?   A video is going viral on social media regarding the Ukraine-Russia conflicts. A huge explosion can be seen in the video.User captioned the video, “Russia bombed Ukraine’s headquarters.”Fact CheckTo check the above claim, we converted the viral video into multiple keyframes with the help of the Inside tool. By reverse-searching images of individual keyframes, we found the video to be uploaded on August 4, 2020. The video is of an explosion that took place in the Lebanese capital, Beirut.https://twitter.com/mhijazi/status/1290675030561566720At least 218 people were killed and 7,000 were injured in the explosion caused by the storage of a large amount of ammonium nitrate at the port of Beirut. In addition, there was property damage worth the US $15 billion.Conclusion: Hence proving the claim is misleading.Claim review: Russia bombard at Ukraine HeadquartersClaim by: JanYe Longguan Rapier LoomFact check: Misleading

content: Fact Check: Is Photo of the injured girl going viral is from the 2018 Syrian war is again used in Ukraine war? A picture of an injured girl is going viral on social media. For the sake of humanity, Putin must end it. ”Fact Check:On reversing the picture, it was found that this picture is from the Syrian War. Which was published by the BBC in one of its articles on January 6, 2018.Apart from this, we found this photo on the website of the European Press Photo Agency along with other information. “The young girl was treated in a hospital after a bomb blast in Mesraba, eastern Al-Ghouta, Syria, on 3 January 2018. At least 19 people were killed in airstrikes on the cities of Erbin and Mesraba by forces loyal to the Syrian government.conclusion:The girl shown in the picture was injured not in Ukraine but during the Syrian war in 2018.Hence, the viral picture is misleading.Claim Review: The photo of the injured girl going viral is from the 2018 Syrian war is again used in the Ukraine war.claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Putin threaten India for interfering in the conflict? content: FactCheck: Two Young Ukrainian Children Sending Off Soldiers To Fight The Russians. The Reality Of The Viral Image. An image is going viral on the internet. content: FactCheck: The Complete Truth Of The Viral Video Of Massive  Explosion At Ukraine. The tension between Russia and Ukraine is increasing day by day. The video is more than four year old. Therefore, it has nothing to do with the ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine.ConclusionHence, it is clear that social media users are sharing an old video. content: Fact check: Did Akhilesh Yadav disrespect the statue of Gautam Buddha? A short clip of Akhilesh Yadav is getting viral on social media. content: Fact Check: Is Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine is under cruise and ballistic missiles attack? The tension between Russia and Ukraine is increasing every hour, the Russian military has too launched a military war against Ukraine, resulting in the killing of 40 military men.In between these tensions, many videos and pictures are getting viral all over the social mediaThe getting attraction of lot many people. Likewise, a picture is revolving over the social media getting maximum attraction of viewers on social media sites.The picture of a large explosion is shared under the caption, “As Russia’s Putin announces a ‘military operation’ in Ukraine, Ukrainian Interior Ministry confirms that its capital Kyiv is under attack from Russian cruise and ballistic missiles. War has begun.”And the heat of this news of the start of world war 3 is throughout the social media sites and people are presenting their opinion on this issue. The picture of explosion can be seen below:BREAKING: As Russia's Putin announces a 'military operation' in Ukraine, Ukrainian Interior Ministry confirms that its capital Kyiv is under attack from Russian cruise and ballistic missiles. War has begun. pic.twitter.com/pxzMTiAx2O — MD Rais Ansari (@Rais76Ansari) February 24, 2022Fact Check:Through reverse image search we found this image in the getty image site. This picture is of Israeli airstrikes in the Gaza Strip, controlled by the Palestinian Islamist movement Hamas, and was of May 10, 2021 when Israel launched deadly airstrikes on Gaza in response to a rockets fired by the Islamist movement Hamas amid spiraling violence sparked by unrest at Jerusalem’s Al-Aqsa Mosque. The link is embedded below:Conclusion:Therefore this image of the explosion is not from recent times but from the year 2021. When Israel launched deadly airstrikes on Gaza.Claim Review: Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine is under cruise and ballistic missiles attack.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Zee News posted a wrong footage of Russian air striking Ukraine? Russia and Ukraine crisis took a major turn on the 24th of February. Yesterday Russian troops launched their anticipated attack on Ukraine as President Vladimir Putin cast aside international condemnation and sanctions, warning other countries that any attempt to interfere would lead to “consequences you have never seen”.Big explosions were heard before dawn in Kyiv, Kharkiv and Odesa.This video was also shared by Zee news under the caption, “जंग के बीच रूस पहुंचे Imran Khan के साथ हो गया खेल” which translates into Imran khan got played when he reached Russia in between the war.The video entirely talks about how Imran khan, Prime minister of Pakistan reached Russia in between war and how he is excited about being there. The whole video can be seen here in the link.Fact Check:The video getting viral is an old video from Parade rehearsal 05/04/2020, Air part, Flight of aircraft over Tushino. It is a former village and town to the north of Moscow, which has been part of the city’s area since 1960.This can be seen in this YouTube video.Conclusion:This video is misleading as no such airstrike has taken place in Ukraine.Claim Review: Russia launching an airstrike on Ukraine.Claimed by: ZEE NewsFact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did Russian military paratroopers land in Ukraine, near Kharkov? The eyes of the whole world are on the ongoing tension between Russia and Ukraine. Consequently, every day we can hear many news related to it. Some are true but many fake news are also getting viral to mislead people. Meanwhile, a video is getting massively viral on the internet. Sharing the video, social media users are writing the caption, “Russian military paratroopers land in Ukraine, near Kharkov.”Similarly, many other social media users shared this video on their handles.https://twitter.com/RaqeebK82134449/status/1496842428887744514?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1496842428887744514%7Ctwgr%5E%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ibtimes.sg%2Fhundreds-russian-paratroopers-descend-war-planes-kharkiv-dubious-video-triggers-panic-social-62975FactCheckAfter doing keyword research, we found a video on facebook. Surprisingly, this is the same video, that got viral recently amid Russia -Ukraine crisis. But, the video was uploaded on 18th september, 2016. Further, the caption of the video was, “Massive air ‘desant’ of Russian VDV airborne troops (around 2000 paratroopers) in Rostov region from 17 Ilyushin Il-76 aircraft. Each Il-76 can take 126 paratroopers (‘desantnik’). Year 2014. ‘VDV’ or Russian Airborne Troops currently go through enlargement from 35 000 in 2014 to 72 000 by 2019. VDV is the strategic reserve of the Supreme commander and subordinate to the President of Russia. The only heavily mechanized airborne capable force in the world.”Hence, it is not related to present day situation.ConclusionTherefore, the viral video showing hundreds of Russian paratroopers descending from fighter planes on the Ukrainian soil is fake and misleading.Claim Review: Russian military paratroopers land in Ukraine, near Kharkov.Claimed by- @majharul_00, @RaqeebK82134449 and other social media users.Fact check– fake and misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Does Murder Mystery of Harsha have a connection with the release of Fatwa? Harsha, a 23-year-old, Bajrang Dal Activist was recently murdered in Shivamogga, Karnataka. An uproar of aggression can be seen among the members of the Bajrang Dal after the death of Harsha. As per the Araga Jnanendra (Home Minister of Karnataka), the three accused of the murder are under custody of the Police but their names won’t be revealed. Meanwhile, a claim is getting viral on social media that a Fatwa was released in the name of Harsha calling him blasphemy of Islam. Users are relating his death with the release of Fatwa.Rashmi Samant, a Hindu Human Rights activist claimed that in 2015, a Facebook group named Mangalore Muslims has released a Fatwa against Hindu activist Harsha. She added that the Harsha took active participation in the Hijab Row. She also mentioned Lavanya and Rupesh Pandey along with Harsha. Lavanya was a 17 year-old-girl of Thirukattupalli, Tamil Nadu who committed suicide because of the extreme pressure built on her for conversion to Christianity. BJP members gave much elevation to the case alleging the brutal site of conversion in Tamil Nadu. Rashmi Samant posted the tweet on 21st February 2022 by inserting a Facebook post of the Mangalore Muslims which is written in Tamil.https://twitter.com/RashmiDVS/status/1495618912448303104?s=20&t=yMZYUdER9oujoDdtaSzYGwB L Santhosh, National General Secretary of BJP org, also connected the murder case with protest regarding Hijab in Karnataka. He claimed that Harsha was killed by Jihadi Fundamentalists brutally in front of his house in Shivamogga for showing support in Hijab Row. He considered him a martyr.Harsha was killed by jihadi fundamentalists brutally in front of his home in Shivamogga for supporting #YesToUniform_NoToHijab . He was a marked man by anti Hindu forces . Tributes to Balidani Harsha . We will stand by his family in this hour of grief . 🙏🙏🙏 pic.twitter.com/Tb1GLINvv4 — B L Santhosh ( Modi Ka Parivar ) (@blsanthosh) February 21, 2022Fact CheckAfter seeing the post of Mangalore Muslims, we translated the caption which says that “Prophet Muhammad Mustafa has been abused by the activist of the Hindu terrorist organization Harsha. He has also used obscene words about Allah and disrespected Kaaba. The people of Shivamogga should find more evidence against him and file a case in the nearest Police Station.”We cannot find anything related to Fatwa’s release in the entire post of Mangalore Muslims. Thus the claim that Harsha was killed due to the release of Fatwa in 2015 is entirely fake and misleading.Home Minister Araga Jnanendra also said that there is no connection between Harsha’s death with Hijab Row. As per TOI.Another report of India Today that says Chief Minister, Basavaraj Bommai and Araga Jnanendra have clearly said that they have not found any credible source which states Harsha was killed because he played anti in Hijab Case. Therefore, there is no link between the death of Bajrang Dal Activist and Hijab Row.Conclusion: The claim which proves Bajrang Dal activist was killed because of a Fatwa release is fake news. As Mangalore Muslims never mentioned anything about Fatwa in their Facebook post. Another claim where people were linking connection between Hijab Row and the murder was denied by both CM of Karnataka and Home Minister of Karnataka itself.
label: truth

content: FactChek: Fake Image Got Viral That Targets Arvind Kejriwal. Know The Truth. An image of hoarding is getting massively viral on the internet. Not to Kejriwal.” This image is shared by many famous personalities including Paresh Rawal, Major Surendra Poonia, and Shweta Bhattacharya.Similarly, many other users have shared this image. Moreover, the caption of the post was, “Such a brilliant hoarding. Respect taxpayer.”https://twitter.com/RenukaJain6/status/1084691898265231360?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw%7Ctwcamp%5Etweetembed%7Ctwterm%5E1084691898265231360%7Ctwgr%5E%7Ctwcon%5Es1_&ref_url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.altnews.in%2Fdelhi-cm-arvind-kejriwal-tax-payers-thanks-morphed-bill-board%2FFactCheckAfter doing a reverse image search, we got to know that this image is morphed. Yellow hammered shared this image in an article in June 2015. Further, it does not contain the words, “not to Kejriwal.”Hence, it is clear that users are sharing an edited image and targeting Arvind Kejriwal.Also Read: #DFRAC Exclusive: Yogi Devnath- A Man Who Runs a Hate Factory on Twitter.ConclusionTherefore, from our fact check analysis it is clear that amid ongoing assembly elections users are sharing morphed images to mislead people. The actual hoarding contains words that create awareness that one should respect the taxpayers. But, some users are sharing an edited version of the image to target Delhi CM Kejriwal.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did the Muslim Mob attack a temple in Telangana? A video is getting viral on social media where a user, Sushant Singh has posted a video on February 23 and claimed that a Muslims Mob has entered the Karmanghat Hanuman Temple and vandalized the property of the temple. According to him, 2 women were also attacked by the group of 25 men.https://twitter.com/SushantSingh113/status/1496289547059343360?s=20&t=v6c37SAkBaLFgCj7VXb0lAAnother user squineon, who can also be called saffron defender posted a video in which a man is speaking about how some group of men have attacked us while we were protecting our cow vigilantes near the temple. They also captioned the video, ‘Peacefuls has attacked Karmanghat Hanuman temple in Telangana’. The user has also tried to mislead the people from the original news.https://twitter.com/squineon/status/1496208073194901505?s=20&t=hYXvOXtYD0RWmnHn4sE9MAFact checkAfter reading the claims we researched further and got to know the entire violence erupted between cow vigilantes and cattle transporters. Rachakonda Police released a press note which states the detail of the case. According to the note, illegal transportation of the cattle created communal tension in Telangana.In the whole report, there have been no mentions of the Muslim mob attacking cow vigilantes or anyone in the Karmanghat Hanuman Temple from 22 February to 23 February. The Hindu also covered the news of the clash between cow Vigilantes and cattle transporters in Hyderabad.Conclusion: No Muslim mob has attacked in Karmanghat Hanuman Temple, Therefore the claim is fake and misleading.Claim Review: Did the Muslim Mob attack a temple in Telangana?Claim by: Sushant SinghFact check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: A fake video of a woman getting a beating went viral, in the name of communal Riots. A Video in the name of communal riots is all-around on the internet where a woman is seen getting a beating by a group of men on the road. The woman is seen screaming in pain in the video for help but no one present there is coming forward to save the woman from the violence.To our amusement, the inspector present at the time of violence too choose to be a mute spectator.People are sharing this all over the globe under the captions like, “If this is the condition of law and order under the fascist Hindutva regime, let them know that their barbarism is being watched and every human right’s violation will be harshly accounted for.Civilised world won’t allow this Jungle Raj.” And questioning the secularity of India as can be seen under this tweet.https://twitter.com/Talal_Alkashte/status/1496489665855168515?t=fltoM_6Wi0g0ErO94L2MaA&s=09https://twitter.com/MJALSHRIKA/status/1263950263716589568?s=20&t=h39y3gVH_MYUo6HyMjfykAFact Check:By reverse image search and using different keyphrases we found the article related to this incident in the newspaper of Dainik Bhaskar two years before. That tells us that this incident is from adhinpur UP, and has nothing to do with the communal riots, as it was a domestic violence case over a land dispute.All four accused are under arrest and the two policemen were suspended over this issue as stated by the newspaper.Conclusion:The claims are fake, as the woman was not beaten in communal riots but over domestic violence. Hence, this is clear that many same kinds of fake videos are spreading in the name of communalism in other parts of the world to defame India.Claim review: Muslim women getting a beating went viral, in the name of communal Riots.Claimed by: Ali Kisken ,@Talal_AlkashteFact Check: Misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did Amit Shah say PM Modi sleeps for the whole day? Nowadays Home Minister, Amit Shah has been campaigning in Manipur for the upcoming elections. Amit Shah also made promises to bring peace in the state while having a word with Kuki Militants. As militant groups like Kuki Militants demand a different state identity for the Kuki Tribe in the Manipur.Meanwhile, a video of the Home Minister got viral on social media. In the video, users are claiming that he is heard speaking that PM Narendra Modi sleeps for the whole day. @DrDatta01 posted the video on February 2022. Many others also posted the same short video and captioned with, PM Modi sleeps for 24 hours.https://twitter.com/Ashwani820064/status/1495697292124377091?s=20&t=EWzPwquWeDqpXbgUlYQ4yAThe same video also got viral in April 2021, ‘Modi Ji sleeps for 24 hours a day so that the poor of this Country progress.’Modi Ji sleeps for 24 hours a day so that the poor of this Country progress pic.twitter.com/1pRwe5NZeq — Brijesh Kalappa (@brijeshkalappa) April 23, 2021Fact CheckAfter digging further, we found the entire video of Amit Shah, giving a speech at a public meeting in Chapra, West Bengal. In the original video, Home Minister said, Modi Ji, thinks about the welfare of the poor/needy people. The Hindi word ‘Sochte’ which means to think was replaced by ‘Sote hai’ (to sleep) in the viral video. Thus people mislead his actual words. The original video was posted on BJP’s official YouTube Page, 10 months ago.Exactly after 5 minutes 39 seconds, you can listen to him speaking, ‘Modi ji 24/7 think about the progress of deprived ones whereas Didi only thinks of making her niece as the Prime Minister.Hence proving that the video is misleading.Claim Review: Did Amit Shah say PM Modi sleeps for the whole dayClaim by: @DrDatta01Fact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Do CM Yogi owns an asset worth Rs 81000? A claim is getting viral on Twitter that Yogi Adityanth owns assets whose total worth is Rs 81000. Users are also claiming that he wears a gold ear coil which weighs 20 grams and is worth Rs 49000, a Rudraksh gold platted Mala weighs almost 10 grams around his neck which costs Rs 20,000 along with a Samsung Smartphone of Rs 12000. शिवदान सिंह छौंकर posted a picture of CM Yogi holding a paper in the presence of Amit Shah (Home Minister) and captioned it with listing his total assets on February 4th 2022. Following many more users claimed the same.#हमारे_योगी_जी ..कान मे सोने का कुण्डल भार 20 ग्राम कीमत 49000 (क्रय कीमत)….गले मे सोने की डोर में रूद्राक्ष माला भार 10 ग्राम कीमत 20000 ….सैमसंग मोबाईल अदद एक कीमत 12000 कुल संपत्ति केवल रू. 81000 .. ये कुल चल अचल संपत्ति है हमारे महंत बाबा आदित्यनाद जी की …….! pic.twitter.com/JH08BR3t7b — शिवदान सिंह छौंकर (@ChhonkarShivdan) February 4, 2022कान मे सोने का कुण्डल भार 20 ग्राम कीमत 49000 (क्रय कीमत).गले मे सोने की डोर में रूद्राक्ष माला कीमत 10000.सैमसंग मोबाईल अदद एक कीमत 12000कुल संपत्ति 72000ये कुल चल अचल संपत्ति है योगी महाराज कीइसीलिए तो त्रेता में राम जी कह गए कि सन्यासी से अच्छा कोई राजा नहीं हो सकता है pic.twitter.com/JNDwxIxMaZ — Deepak Sharma (मोदी का परिवार) (@Deepakbjpsharma) February 4, 2022Fact Check:After Analyzing, we found that the news which is circulated over Twitter about Yogi Ji owning assets worth Rs 81000 is not true. As per the report in TOI, Yogi filled an affidavit and declares his net worth of Rs 1.55 Crore. The Article also states that his net worth in the last UP election was Rs 96 lakh. Therefore the claim is fake and misleading as his net worth is in Crore and not in thousands.The picture which was shared by users was of the day when CM Yogi filled a nomination from Gorakhpur Assembly Constituency in UP Election 2022.https://twitter.com/myogiadityanath/status/1489528770382143491?s=20&t=z_QYHyYgSoJMGuITojRAXQClaim Review: Do CM Yogi owns an asset worth Rs 81000?Claimed By: शिवदान सिंह छौंकरFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Rajasthan Police closed the temples during the lockdown and did not drape chadar in Ajmer Sharif. A video is going viral on social media extensively with the claim that Rajasthan Police draped Chadar at the Dargah of Hazrat Khwaja Garib Nawaz in Ajmer during the lockdown. While during this time all the temples were closed on the orders of the state government.While sharing the video, a user wrote that the Rajasthan Police, who had stopped worshiping in the temple built in the police station as per the orders of the Rajasthan government,are now offering chadars at dargah.Many other users also shared this video with similar claims.Fact Check:On checking the viral video, we found the video in two parts. To test the first part, convert the video into several key frames with the help of the Inside tool. On reverse-searching images of individual key frames, we found a post on the Facebook page of Ajmer Police. In which the pictures related to the video have been posted. It was also told that to prevent the spread of coronavirus, an awareness rally was taken out on behalf of Ajmer Police. At the same time, Ajmer Dargah Committee also confirmed that the Dargah was closed during the lockdown.In which the pictures related to the video have been posted. It was also told that to prevent the spread of corona virus, an awareness rally was taken out on behalf of Ajmer Police. At the same time, Ajmer Dargah Committee also confirmed that the Dargah was closed during the lockdown.At the same time, in the second part of the video, some Burkanshin women are also shown along with the policemen inside the dargah. Watching the video carefully, it appears that no one is wearing a mask during this time. In such a situation, it is clear that the second part of the video is before the lockdown.Apart from this, if there is a question of presenting Chadar at the Dargah of Rajasthan Police, then every year at the end of year Chadar is draped by the district administration as Shukran at the Dargah. In which the policemen including top officials are also involved.Conclusion:Hence the claim made with the viral video is fake and misleading.Claim Review : Rajasthan Police closed temples and climbed chadar during lockdown in Ajmer SharifClaimed by: Facebook user.Fact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Has Karnataka tuned into Saffron Colour after the case of Hijab Row? The Karnataka High court has started taking hearings for the ban of Hijab in the Educational System. In the earlier hearing Court passed an interim order of not wearing Hijabs and saffron shawls while attending the class in Karnataka. As per India TodayMeanwhile, a video under claims of Hijab Row is getting viral. A certain area is filled with saffron Flag and a boy is waving the flag. The flag has the picture of Lord Rama on it and it is believed to be a symbol of Hinduism. The video was posted on 19th February 2020 by @mahendruraghav on Twitter followed by other users respectively.Fact CheckAfter searching for the authenticity of the video, we got to know that the same video has gone viral from June 2021. Budharam hindustani, a Facebook user has posted the same video in 2019 and captioned it with slogans of Jai Shree Ram.Conclusion: The video has got viral since June 2021, therefore, the video does not come under Hijab Row because the case started in February 2022. Hence proving the video is misleading.Claim review: Has Karnataka tuned into Saffron Colour after the case of Hijab Row?Claim By: Budharam hindustaniFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did Narendra Modi was waving at the empty ground in Unnao? Assembly elections are at peak in five states of the country including UP. Meanwhile, a video of Prime Minister Narendra Modi is becoming massively viral. In this video, PM Modi can be seen waving hands and greeting. Sharing this video on the internet, some people are claiming that PM Modi was waving hands in an empty field. Sharing the video, Rupa Gulab said, “But where are the people? Who is he waving to?”Similarly, many other users shared this video on Twitter and Facebook.FactCheckOn our Fact check analysis, we found that NDTV had uploaded the same video on its official Twitter account. The caption of the post is, “#ElectionsWithNDTV | Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrives for his rally in Unnao.”#ElectionsWithNDTV | Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrives for his rally in Unnao #UttarPradeshElections pic.twitter.com/gGFaEH5C5N — NDTV (@ndtv) February 20, 2022In this video, we can see the people standing behind barricades and on the terrace of houses at a distance from PM Modi. And, Modi Ji was waving hands to them.Further, we found another tweet of ANI regarding the same video. In the tweet, ANI mentioned, “#WATCH | People throng terraces and buildings near the helipad to welcome PM Narendra Modi in Unnao.#WATCH | People throng terraces and buildings near the helipad to welcome PM Narendra Modi in Unnao #UPElection2022 pic.twitter.com/OxuokLhxaO — ANI (@ANI) February 20, 2022ConclusionHence, from our fact check analysis, it is clear that PM Modi was not waving his hand at the empty grounds. But, some people are sharing an edited version of the video to mislead people.
label: truth

content: Fact check: What did Rahul Gandhi say during his speech in Manipur? Manipur Assembly Election will be held in March 2022. Narendra Modi has already stated that this polling will decide the next 25 years of Manipur. BJP’s work in the last 5 years will benefit Manipur for the next 25 years. Both BJP and Congress are conducting rallies in the state.Meanwhile, a video of Rahul Gandhi is going viral where a user sarcastically quoted Rahul Gandhi’s word. In the video, he is heard speaking, “it was raining and that caused you trouble, Thank you.” The video was uploaded on 21st February 2022 by Jayesh.Baarish thi, aapko kasht hua uske liye dhanyawad – Rahul 😂 pic.twitter.com/EpIPzHEN5d — Jayesh Patel (@jayeshforreal3) February 21, 2022Baarish thi, aapko kasht hua uske liye dhanyawad – Rahul 😂 pic.twitter.com/y9qjJVT6iO — Hardik (Modi Ka Parivar) (@Humor_Silly) February 21, 2022Fact checkAfter looking further, we got the full video of Rahul Gandhi which is circulated on social media. The viral video is taken during his public meeting at Hapta Kangjeibung, Imphal. In his speech, he mentioned that the ruling party (BJP) comes with the air of superiority in Manipur whereas Congress respects the language and culture of the state. At the end of the speech, he politely mentioned that even though it was raining but you all came to the gathering, Thank you. Rahul Gandhi himself posted the video of his speech on Twitter. Therefore, the video is edited and misled by the users.Claim review: What did Rahul Gandhi say during his speech in Manipur?Claim by: JayeshFact check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: The edited clip of Raghav Chada threatening deep Sidhu supporters got viral. A video of Rghav Chada, (Aam Aadmi Party leader) claiming that he threatened the supporters of deep Sidhu, as he spoke against AAP before he was dead.Sidhu met with a road accident on the 15th of February was an activist and critical of AAP.The clip where Chada was threatening the supporters of Sidhu went viral in which he said that, “We’ll file defamation cases against all of them. Once we’re in power, we’ll bring them to justice. Just wait, it’s only a matter of days. After March 10, we’ll deal with them one by one. Spread the word, after March 10, we’ll deal with each one of them.”The video was getting viral all over the internet with some text written on it in Punjabi stating, “jhandu gang (AAP) is threatening those supporting Deep Sidhu, how will they behave towards Sikhs if they got elected?Fact Check:We found out that the clip getting viral is an edited version of the real video through our research. In the real video, Raghav was talking about Gurtej Pannu, a former AAP leader who was accused of money laundering in exchange for election tickets. The news was also covered by the Hindustan Times.Also, the original video is shared on the YouTube channel at 19.43 minutes we can see the part where Raghav Chada is speaking these words and how the words got molded up in the sentences and created the edited video.Conclusion:The clip getting viral is the edited version of the video and , hence misleading in nature.Claim Review: The edited clip of Raghav Chada threatening deep Sidhu supporters got viral.Claimed by: Facebook users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Akhilesh Yadav say Lawbreakers should vote SP? The third phase of voting in UP Elections took place on 20th February. Polling was held in 16 districts of UP. Ajay Kumar Shukla, Chief Electoral Officer also mentioned that no case of violence was registered in the third phase of polling at the end of the day. A viral statement of Samajwadi Party’s Leader Akhilesh Yadav got viral on social media.In the video, he claimed that if someone does not want to follow law and orders or torture the poor class they can vote for Samajwadi Party. It also carried a slogan at the end of the video that roughly translates, hands of rioters and support with criminals. The viral video has created an ignite among the users.Fact checkAfter watching the video, we knew that somewhere the video is edited and through research we got an article of Zee News of 12th February 2022 which covered Akhilesh Yadav’s statement during election campaigns in Bareilly. Akhilesh Yadav mentioned that lawbreakers should not vote SP but the user edited the entire video and posted it on the internet to spread fake news.Conclusion: Therefore, the entire video is edited and no such statements were made by Akhilesh Yadav on UP elections 2022.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Fake statements of  Mehbooba Mufti got viral A statement of Mehbooba Mufti is going viral on the internet, these days. Users are claiming that Mehbooba Mufti said that, the defeat of the BJP will be bigger freedom for the Muslims than the independence of 1947. A user @VishnuMTiwari1 tweeted,” Clear message of Mehbooba Mufti. Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti, who came to campaign against the BJP in UP, has told the Muslims yesterday that the defeat of the BJP will be bigger freedom for the Muslims than the independence of 1947. Think about this all the Hindus wearing secular glasses.”*महबूबा मुफ्ती का क्लियर संदेश**यूपी में भाजपा के विरुद्ध में प्रचार करने आए जम्मू कश्मीर की पूर्व मुख्यमंत्री महबूबा मुफ्ती ने कल मुसलमानों को यह कहा है कि भाजपा की हार मुसलमानों के लिए 1947 की आजादी से भी बड़ी आजादी होगी। सेकुलर चश्मा पहनने हुए हर पार्टी के हिंदू को सोचना — विष्णु तिवारी (Modi Ka Parivar) (@VishnuMTiwari1) January 27, 2022In the same vein, many users shared this post on Facebook and Twitter.FactCheckAfter doing keyword research our team found a video of Mehbooba on the Youtube channel of RP Global Media. that. The caption of the video is, “Peoples Democratic Party President Mehbooba Mufti address One Day Tribal Youth Convention in Jammu.” The video was uploaded on 17th January, 2022.The former chief minister said, “Jammu and Kashmir had joined hands with Gandhi’s Hindustan. Jammu and Kashmir were not with Godse’s Hindustan. BJP wants to make this country Godse’s Hindustan.” Further, she said that BJP wants to spread hatred. We don’t have to fear them. They want to erase our existenceHowever, in her whole speech, she never said that the defeat of the BJP will be bigger freedom for the Muslims than the independence of 1947.ConclusionTherefore, in our FactCheck analysis, we found that users are spreading fake and misleading information regarding Mehbooba Mufti’s statement.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did Yogi Adityanath say that Saffron Hijab is the solution for the conflict? A statement of Yogi Adityanath on Hijab row is going viral on social media. The Fauxy has claimed that UP CM says wearing saffron hijabs is the solution to resolve conflict. The article also added that Orange Hijab can easily be accepted by both sides. Many users are spreading the viral claim over the internet.Up Govt. To Start Production Of Orange Hijabs, Says It Solves Issue Of Both Sideshttps://t.co/es8El7JEoB — The Fauxy (@the_fauxy) February 14, 2022Fact checkAfter cross-checking the authenticity behind the statement made by Yogi Adityanath, we got an article of Hindustan, which has covered the original statement made by CM. UP Chief Minister in an interview with ANI said that system should work with discipline and not with personal beliefs, likes and dislikes. He also raised a question, “may I speak to all the employees or people in the north to wear saffron?#WATCH भारत की व्यवस्था संविधान के अनुरूप चलनी चाहिए, हमारी व्यक्तिगत आस्था और पसंद-नापसंद हम देश और संस्थाओं पर लागू नहीं कर सकते हैं। क्या मैं UP में सभी कर्मचारियों या लोगों को बोल सकता हूं कि आप भी भगवा धारण करें? स्कूल में ड्रेस कोड लागू होना चाहिए: हिजाब मामले पर UP CM pic.twitter.com/KwuwQ1UKd2 — ANI_HindiNews (@AHindinews) February 14, 2022Therefore, the claim is misleading as CM Yogi made no such statement regarding Saffron Hijab.Claim review: Did Yogi Adityanath say that Saffron Hijab is the solution for the conflict?Claim by: The FauxyFact check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Illegal firemen were waved in SP (Samajwadi Party) video got viral. A video was shared by Prashant Umrao, a Standing Counsel in Supreme Court of India for the State of Goa and a Spokesperson for BJP (Bharatiya Janta Party) official account in which he was humiliating SP (Samajwadi Party) in his caption stating, “सपा के जुलूस में लहराये सैकड़ो अवैध तमंचे। सपा के पूर्व कैबिनेट मंत्री व विधानसभा प्रत्याशी शाहिद मंजूर के बेटे नवाज़िश के स्वागत में हुई फायरिंग। जुलूस में हथियारों के साथ डांस और स्वागत में फायरिंग का वीडियो वायरल किठौर विधानसभा का है वायरल वीडियो। तमंचवादी समाजवादी पार्टी|”This translates into, “Hundreds of illegal firearms were waved in the SP procession. Firing took place at the reception of Nawazish, son of former SP cabinet minister and assembly candidate Shahid Manzoor. Video of dance with weapons in procession and firing at reception goes viral Viral video of Kithor assembly.”सपा के जुलूस में लहराये सैकड़ो अवैध तमंचे। सपा के पूर्व कैबिनेट मंत्री व विधानसभा प्रत्याशी शाहिद मंजूर के बेटे नवाज़िश के स्वागत में हुई फायरिंग। जुलूस में हथियारों के साथ डांस और स्वागत में फायरिंग का वीडियो वायरल किठौर विधानसभा का है वायरल वीडियो। तमंचवादी समाजवादी पार्टी। pic.twitter.com/zNczBSC2Af — Prashant Umrao (Modi Ka Parivar) (@ippatel) February 16, 2022Fact Check:Through our analysis, we got that this video is not from recent times as claimed by Prashant Umrao. It was of the year 2016. It was also found out that the whole issue is of Meerut.It was also cleared by UP Police fact check official account where it was clearly stated that by spreading such fake news , one shall not mislead people.Claim Review: Illegal firemen were waved in SP (Samajwadi Party) video got viral.Claimed by: Prashant UmraoFact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: RJD UttarPradesh claimed actor Vin diesel as CM Yogi , picture got viral. RJD (Rashtriya Janata Dal) Uttar Pradesh, formed by Lalu Prasad Yadav, in 1997. The mass base of the party has traditionally been OBC, Dalits, and Muslims In 2008, RJD received the status of the recognized national level party following its performance in north-eastern states. RJD was derecognized as a national party on 30 July 2010.A picture is spreading all over the internet that is shared by the official Twitter account of RDJ In which a man is sitting near a sleeping girl.RJD IS claiming CM Yogi in that picture captioned as , “क्या यह थाईलैंड में शूट हुई “बाबा के झरोखे से” फ़िल्म का दृश्य है?” which roughly translate to, “ Is this a scene from the movie “Baba Ke Jharokhe Se” shot in Thailand?” Below is the picture that got viral.Fact Check:Through reverse image search, we found that the image shared by RJD Uttar Pradesh is of the movie “fast and furious” and the man that was claimed as a yogi is actually Vin Diesel and the lady is Michelle Rodriguez. This movie is a great hit among the millennial generation as it deals with a series of action films that are largely concerned with illegal street racing, heists, spies, and family.Conclusion:Therefore, it is so very clear that the man in the picture is not CM Yogi, but a renowned actor Vin Diesel from the movie fast and furious.Claim Review: CM Yogi is seen with a girl in the viral picture.Claimed by:C RJD UttarpradeshFact Check: Misleading.
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Lord Jagannath Falls iil. Know The Reality Of The News A picture of a newspaper cutting went viral on the internet. This viral news of Pratika claims that Lord Jagannath Puri got ill. Moreover, many social media users shared this picture at different times with different captions.@E_V_periyar shared this picture on 17 Jan 2022 with the caption, “Kuch Bhi(anything)”. Likewise, Dr.Vilas Kharat has shared the same picture on June 11, 2021, with the caption, “The havoc of Brahminism.”Similarly, many users have shared this picture on their social media handles.FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, we found an article by Patrika regarding the same news.It is an old tradition that Lord Jagannath Swami becomes ill in summer and he gets treatment. He becomes sick for 15 consecutive days from the full moon of Jeshtha month and gets healthy on the new moon day of Ashad month. According to the priest of the temple, this tradition is going on for about 150 years. Which is still being followed.But, Patrika.com has written the article in a very misleading way. According to the article, it seems that the God in the person form falls ill and gets treatment.ConclusionDifferent sections of society have different rituals and traditions. People celebrate these traditions with full zeal to show their faith to the almighty. Similarly, Lord Jagannath falling ill is a 150-year tradition.Claim Review: Lord Jagannath falls ill.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is a Muslim lady getting a beating by the police in HijabRow Controversy? Today is the 9th day in HijabRow Controversy and the continuation of the protest is still on all over the country. People are coming up with different news and videos every now and then regarding the issue of HijabRow.Meanwhile, we get to see a video getting viral on social media, where a Muslim lady wearing a Hijab is seen beaten up by the police.People all over the internet are sharing this video under #HijabRow, to tell the world about the atrocities faced by Muslims in India. The same video is shared by a Pakistani Youtube channel where they humiliated India on international grounds.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2FZyRB01ENoFact Check:To know the reality of this video we searched it and got to know that this video is of a woman who was wearing a Burqa and Hijab is basically a foreigner who allegedly stabbed a cab driver in gurugram, Haryana.The cab driver was severely injured and admitted to the hospital for treatment. When police interrogated into the matter the women mishandled the policemen too as can be seen in the video by @live_Hindustan.गुरुग्राम में बुर्का और हिजाब पहने हुई एक विदेशी महिला ने कथित तौर पर एक कैब ड्राइवर को चाकू मार दिया। घायल कैब ड्राइवर को इलाज के लिए अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया है। पुलिस आरोपी महिला को हिरासत में लेकर पूछताछ कर रही है। इस दौरान महिला ने पुलिसकर्मियों से भी हाथापाई की। pic.twitter.com/QYURAeY6iu — Hindustan (@Live_Hindustan) February 15, 2022Conclusion:Therefore, the video getting viral on social media sites is misleading as no Muslim lady is hurt during the #HijabRow Controversy.Claim Review: Muslim lady getting a beating by the police in HijabRow Controversy.Claimed By: AR VideosFact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Mayawati and Jayant Chaudhary form an alliance for UP Election 2022? UP will witness its seventh phase of polling on March 7 starting with Jaunpur along with 54 other constituencies. UP election plays a pivotal role in ensuring the governance at central. Meanwhile, a claim is going viral on social media where a user is claiming that Jayant Chaudhary paid a visit to Mayawati at her residence. Niraj Kumar M. Niraj, a Facebook user posted a video of both the political leaders meeting on 16th February 2022 and wrote that this time BSP will come to Uttar Pradesh as RLD and BSP are allying.Fact checkAfter cross-checking the authenticity of the video and viral claim, we got to know that the video is from March 2019. ANI UP/Uttarakhand posted the tweet inserting some pictures of Jayant Chaudhary and Mayawati’s meeting. The post was captioned by, “Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD) leader Jayant Chaudhary meets Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) supremo Mayawati in Lucknow”. As we can see both the viral video and pictures are of the same meeting which took place in 2019. Therefore the viral claim is misleading.Rashtriya Lok Dal (RLD) leader Jayant Chaudhary meets Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) supremo Mayawati in Lucknow pic.twitter.com/LreoIgGgmm — ANI UP/Uttarakhand (@ANINewsUP) March 16, 2019
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did Arvind Kejriwal made a statement that he’s a BJP or RSS Man? A video of Arvind Kejriwal goes viral on social media platforms where users claim that Delhi CM has become a part of BJP.Dadra and Nagar Haveli Congress Sevadala verified account on Twitter posted Kejriwal’s interview with NDTV, where he is heard saying that he has a family of Jan Sangh and belongs to BJP since birth. He also said that his father was jailed during the time of the emergency on 13th February 2022.We have aalready been telling this. It's now wide and open. Kejriwal is BJP/RSS Pawn. Paidaieshi BJP wale hain ye.#AAP_BJP_Exposed pic.twitter.com/o0CJ5DhTyy — Dadra and Nagar Haveli Congress Sevadal (@SevadalDNH) February 13, 2022Trinamool Congress (Abar TMC) has also posted the same video with a caption of, ‘Kejriwal admits he is a BJP-RSS man’Kejriwal admits he is a BJP-RSS man pic.twitter.com/PnNILBS5ER — Trinamool Congress (Abar TMC) (@abarTMC) January 29, 2022In short- a video is going viral of Arvind Kejriwal with a claim that he’s a BJP Man.Fact checkAfter seeing the original video of CM’s interview on NDTV, we witnessed no such claims made by Delhi CM in his interview regarding his connection with BJP. Another proof if you look upon the frame closely, you will find a line popping out in the middle of the frame. ‘Our Focus is Development, Positive Feedback’ are the lines. Meanwhile, in the original video, Kejriwal can only be heard speaking about his alliance with Anna Hazare and Aam Janta Party’s efficiency when those lines show up in the video.In the article, NDTV has only mentioned Kejriwal’s statement regarding Shaheen Bagh and the video was posted on 4th February 2020. Therefore the video is edited and fake.Conclusion- Our fact check proves that Arvind Kejriwal didn’t mention his connection with BJP rather he spoke about the efficiency of the AAP Party in the video during the time duration which has been edited in the viral video.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Reality Of The Picture Of The Woman Holding A Rifle On A Bus A photo of a girl holding a gun is going viral on the internet. The woman is holding a rifle on a bus. Further, along with the picture, @terror_alarm wrote, Life in #Ukraine, “Life in #Ukraine, now.”Likewise, @Abbakar1030 wrote, “IMAGE recently taken of a girl on a bus in Ukraine. With well-manicured nails, chatting on her mobile while clutching AK47. Awaiting Russian troops was well-manicured AK47 awaiting Russian troops. ”IMAGE recently taken of a girl on a bus in Ukraine. With well manicured nails,chatting on her mobile while clutching an AK47 awaiting Russian troops. 🤭 pic.twitter.com/P0F4M218M0 — HABUN GWAGGO (@Abbakar_affan) February 12, 2022similarly, many other social media users shared this picture on their handles.FactCheckAfter doing a reverse image search we got to know that, this is an old image. Moreover, we found an archived link in which the same picture was uploaded seven months ago.Also, we found the same image on Reddit, it was uploaded on March 31, 2020.ConclusionTherefore, it is clear that users are circulating the viral image on different forums such as Reddit and meme-sharing blogs since March 2020. And, many internet users have previously attributed to numerous locations, such as Belarus and Russia. Hence, the claims with the viral image are fake and misleading. Also, it is not related to Ukraine.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Will BSP Will Form The Government In Uttar Pradesh? Know the Reality Of the Viral Screenshot. Amid the hustle and bustle of elections in Uttar Pradesh. Many predictions are being made about the party that will form the government. In the same vein, many media houses are conducting opinion polls. Meanwhile, a screenshot of News24 is going viral on the social media platform. According to this viral opinion poll image, BSP is going to get around 203-211 seats in the ongoing UP Elections.Further, sharing the screenshot Kundan Kumar wrote, “BSP in 22. Vote for #Bahujan Samaj Party. #Government of full majority is going to be formed.”Similarly, many other social media users are sharing this screenshot on their handles.FactCheckAfter doing the keyword search, we found a video on the YouTube channel of News24 uploaded on 22 Jan 2022. Further,After watching the full video we got to know that the viral screenshot is an edited screenshot taken from this video.According to this survey, the BJP alliance is likely to get 144-152, SP alliance 203-211, BSP 12-20, and Congress 19-27 seats in the UP elections. But, some people are sharing its edited version to mislead people.Also Read: Mapping #Muskan: A protest amplified by PakistanConclusionHence, it is clear from our Fact check analysis that the viral screenshot is edited.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Is Fidel Castro the father of Justin Trudeau? A story claiming Justin Trudeau, Prime Minister of Canada as the son of Fidel Castro, Cuban Dictator is a new buzz on social media sites. This Conspiracy theory is getting viral.It all started when on On Jan 30th, Zviad Gogiashvili, an anti-vaccine Facebook user, posted a collage showing the Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau’s mother, Margaret Trudeau, and the former Cuban President Fidel Castro.The college includes the faces of Justin Trudeau and Fidel Castro themselves, which is probably used to show the viewers the similarity between both of them.The Affair between the two Margaret Trudeau, mother of the Prime Minister of Canada and the leader of the Cuban Revolution, Fidel Castro were circulating on the Internet since 2016 after the death of Castro.It came as a more noticeable matter when in a speech by Justin Trudeau mentioned that his father, Pierre Trudeau was proud of his friendship with Fidel Castro, and it was a great honor for him to meet Castro and his family in person.It is also said that they both too resemble a lot. To which we have provided you with the collage below:Fact Check:This picture was taken in the year 1976 when Justin was already 4 years old. These allegations are also being denied on the part of the Canadian Government.As far as the resemblance is concerned Justin Trudeau and his father Pierre Trudeau look-alike as can be seen in this picture.It was too said that Castro son Fidelito stated in a letter Justin as his half-brother proof of which was neither found by the media nor the independent reporters.Conclusion:The Trudeau family definitely holds a good relationship with Fidel Castro. But the viral fact is false on the grounds mentioned above.Claim Review: Is Fidel Castro the father of Justin Trudeau.Claimed By: Zviad GogiashviliFact Check: false.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Home Minister Amit Shah’s speech went viral. Home Minister Amit Shah Video in which he was addressing the people of Raipur, Uttrakhand spread all over social media. It is shown in the video that as soon as HM Amit shah took the name of congress public at once shouted Zindabad to his speech.Supporters of Congress on social media are trolling him for the same. As can be seen in these tweets:Fact Check:By our research on the various medium we found that this is the clipped part of the whole speech given by HM, Amit Shah. No such thing happened in the campaign, or over his speech.The people in the campaign were fully supporting him and were shouting in his favor only.This can be seen in the video of the full speech given by HM, Amit Shah which was uploaded by BJP on various media platforms.There is a YouTube link for the same Which can be heard at about 11:20 min in the video.The full Speech was also seen in the twitter account.Conclusion:Therefore the clipped part of the whole video is misleading in reality, no such scenario happened in the speech.Claim Review: Home Minister Amit Shah’s speech went viral.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: A misleading claim made on Samajwadi Party for mob molestation taking place in UP UP elections have emerged many fake and misleading claims since the beginning of February 2022. A video of mob molestation is going viral on social media. In the video, a group of boys are harassing two females and users are accusing Samajwadi Party of the hideous act and are appealing help from UP Police.https://twitter.com/yogibaba387/status/1493204164159377409?s=20&t=r1XAGGh4MLrnTrS_Co5LTgFact checkAfter reverse researching, we got a tweet from UP police sharing the same video and mentioned that the incident took place in 2017 as per the Rampur Police. UP police also added that the action has already been taken under the NSA act.Conclusion: Hence proving that the video is misleading as the incident took place in 2017.Claim review: A misleading claim made on Samajwadi Party for mob molestation taking place in UPClaim by: योगी बाबा (बुलडोज़र वाले)Fact check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check: A PhotoShopped Image from Yogi Aditiyanath’s Twitter account got viral. CM Yogi Adityanath triggered his election campaign by distributing smartphones and tablets to 1 crore students of Uttar Pradesh. In this hunt, an image was uploaded from his official Twitter account which was captioned, “जनपद इटावा, इतिहास रचने जा रहा है’आतंकियों के रहनुमा’ और अपराधियों के सरपरस्त’ यहां पस्त होंगे।इटावा ने ठाना है, हर बूथ पर कमल का फूल खिलाना है| which roughly states, “District Etawah is going to create history.The ‘leaders of terrorists’ and protectors of criminals’ will be battered here. Etawah has decided, Lotus flower is to be fed at every booth. Thanks, Etawah!The tweet can be seen here:जनपद इटावा, इतिहास रचने जा रहा है… 'आतंकियों के रहनुमा' और अपराधियों के सरपरस्त' यहां पस्त होंगे। इटावा ने ठाना है, हर बूथ पर कमल का फूल खिलाना है… धन्यवाद इटावा! pic.twitter.com/4RpIPbQSfn — Yogi Adityanath (मोदी का परिवार) (@myogiadityanath) February 15, 2022Fact Check:Through our research, we detect that the image shared from the official Twitter account of CM Yogi is basically photoshopped. Many have trolled CM Yogi for sharing a photoshopped image to promote himself in UP elections. Here is the real image of the same.Conclusion:The Image shared by Yogi’s official Twitter account was not real, hence misleading in a real sense.Fact Check: A PhotoShopped Image from YogiAditiyanath’s Twitter account got viralClaimed by: YogiAdityanathFact Check : Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did the Hijab Girl Muskan got honoured by Burj Khalifa? Hijab Girl Muskan has come out to be the rising star of the protest happening in Karnataka. Muskan’s act of bravery has got both praise and critics from the people over social media platforms. The fact that Muskan gained overnight popularity and became an inspiration to millions of Hijab girls has emerged as a big claim. A video is going viral on Social media where the users are claiming that Muskan is being honoured by the authorities of Burj Khalifa on 12th February.Fact checkAfter seeing the viral claim, we went to the official account of Burj Khalifa on Twitter and thus we didn’t find any such video on the wall. Therefore, we concluded that the video is fake and edited.Claim review: Did the Hijab Girl Muskan got honoured by Burj Khalifa?Claim by: Wasim Quraishi GulbargaFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Zee News Opinion Poll on Uttrakhand Elections Correct or Not? Zee News recently started their Designed Box Opinion Poll in which to know in whose favor the mood of the people of Uttarakhand is this time, ZEE MEDIA in association with DESIGN BOX has conducted a pre-poll survey in two divisions, Garhwal and Kumaon.The image of this DESIGN-BOX is getting viral all over Twitter and other social media apps. According to that congress is leading the polls with more than 50 percent vote share. The image getting circulated is shown below.Fact Check:Through reverse image search, we found that the picture is not exactly of the polls shown by ZEE News. In the opinion poll shown by ZEE News.According to ZEE MEDIA-DESIGN BOX, in the 2022 assembly elections, BJP can get 38 percent, Congress 42 percent, AAP 10 percent, and others 10 percent vote share. Whose entire news can be read under this link.https://zeenews.india.com/hindi/india/up-uttarakhand/uttarakhand/zeeopinionpoll-which-party-is-winning-in-kumaon-mandal-and-favorite-cm-face/1073222Furthermore,video is also provided for more clear information about the vote share in Uttrakhand.Conclusion:Hence, the image shown on social media is photoshopped image of the actual image of vote polls conducted by ZEE Media to mislead the people.Claim Review: Zee News Opinion Poll on Uttrakhand ElectionsClaimed By: social media usersFact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Did Police Resort To Lathi-Charge On The Students Protesting Over Hijab Ban In Bengal? These days Hijab ban has become the most talked about topic on all the media platforms. Meanwhile, many pictures and videos linked to it are becoming viral. One such video is going massively viral on social media sites. In the video, police resort to lathicharge on some people protesting. Additionally, there are some women wearing hijab in the video.People are claiming this video is of Murshidabad, Bengal where students who are protesting over HijabRow are beaten up brutally by the police. Further, sharing the video Tarique Anwar Champarni wrote, “This @MahuaMoitra And@MamataOfficial The video is from Murshidabad district of Bengal. Earlier girls were prevented from going to college in hijab and burqa. When the girls protested, the police behaved brutally. @MahuaMoitra there is a big difference between the speech given in the Parliament and the action taken by him.”Similarly, many social media users shared this video on Facebook as well as on Twitter.FactCheckOn google reverse image searching with the keyframes of the viral video, we found that this is an old video. Furthermore, we found the video on SahilOnline TV news. The channel uploaded this video on 15th September, 2021. Moreover, the caption of the video is, “Bengaluru: Police resort to lathi-charge on students protesting against National Education Policy.”Some people are sharing a clip of this video. Therefore, it is not related to the HijabRow protest. The students were protesting against National Education Policy.Also Read: Mapping #Muskan: A protest amplified by PakistanConclusionHence, in our FactCheck analysis, it is clear that the viral video is not related to the ongoing HijabRow Protest in any way. But, some people are sharing it to mislead people.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Ratan Tata give a speech on balance in life at Symbiosis, Pune? A claim is getting viral on social media where people are claiming that Ratan Tata gave a speech in Symbiosis College, Pune. A superpower speech of Tata concluded that one should never take life seriously, ease out a bit, concentrate on the career and keep a balance of everything in life. Take care of your relationship and mental health too. Users are sharing Tata’s speech as a motivational quote.Fact CheckAfter researching we got to know that words in the super speech of Ratan Tata are original of Chetan Bhagat. In short, Ratan Tata didn’t give the viral speech instead Chetan Bhagat gave at Symbiosis, Pune in 2008.Conclusion- Hence proving that the superpower speech about having balance in life was not given by Ratan Tata rather it was Chetan Bhagat who spoke at Symbiosis, Pune in 2008.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did BJP party members were attacked during the  UP elections 2022? Polling at the Goa assembly and Uttarakhand assembly has already begun. With the passing election dates, we witness cases of violence, chaos in the public. A video is going viral on social media that claims Bharatiya Janata Party workers have got beaten up by anonymous party members during the UP elections in 2022.In the video, the sight of the rampage can be seen. The tweet was posted on 11 February 2022 by a Congressman.Fact checkAfter researching, we got to know that the video is of a rampage that took place in the Jangaon District of Telangana between TRS party members and BJP party members. The violence took place after TRS workers started protesting over a comment made on Andhra Pradesh by PM Narendra Modi in Rajya Sabha. https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Hyderabad/tension-at-jangaon-as-trs-bjp-workers-clash/article38403936.eceAnother proofIndian Express also writes, “Tension rises as BJP and TRS clash in Jangaon district, Telangana”https://www.newindianexpress.com/states/telangana/2022/feb/10/tension-rise-as-bjp-and-trs-clash-in-jangaon-disrict-telengana-2417595.htmlConclusion:Hence proving that Bharatiya Janata Party members were not beaten up during the UP election. Instead, there was a clash between TRS and BJP members in the Jangaon district of Telangana.Claim review: BJP party members were attacked under UP elections 2022Claim by: Twitter UserFact check Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Salman Khan-Aamir Khan and Turkey did not gave any reward to hijab girl Muskan With the Karnataka Hijab controversy coming to the fore, social media is flooded with fake news. Meanwhile, it is being claimed that the Turkish government has given a big reward of Rs 1 crore to the protesting student hijab girl Muskan.Along with this, there has also been talking of announcing a reward of Rs 3 crore for Bollywood actors Salman Khan and Aamir Khan.Fact CheckTo verify the viral claim, we checked the press release of the Turkish Foreign Ministry. Apart from this we also saw reports of Turkish media. But we did not get any such report. In which there has been talking of rewarding the smile.Also searched similar keywords on Google to see the news related to Bollywood actors Salman Khan and Aamir Khan’s claim of giving 3 crore rupees in reward. Apart from this, no such tweet and post were found on the social media of both the actors. This proves that Salman Khan and Aamir Khan have announced a reward of Rs 3 crore to Muskaan.Hence, all the above viral claims are fake.Claim: Salman Khan-Aamir Khan and Turkey did not gave any reward to hijab girl MuskanClaimed By: Facebook and YouTube UserFact Check: Fake
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Is The Girl With Rahul Gandhi Involved In The HijabRow Controversy In Karnataka? Know The Reality Of The Viral Picture. A picture of Rahul Gandhi is going viral on the internet again. In the Picture, Rahul Gandhi is with a girl. Further, social media users are sharing this viral photo with the claim that she is the same girl who was in the Karnataka hijab Row controversy. Meanwhile, sharing the picture, Ankita Singh wrote in the caption which can be nearly translated into English, “This is the girl from Karnataka, understood now, The whole game belongs to Congress!!https://twitter.com/Ankita_107/status/1491712102939066373Similarly, Dinesh wrote, “This is the girl from Karnataka, understand now! The whole game belongs to Congress!! ?The real root of the hijab game!!”Likewise,, many other social media users shared this picture. Apparently, by sharing this picture with these captions, they are trying to, convey that somewhere hands of Rahul Gandhi or Congres are involved in the ongoing Karnataka Hijab row protest.FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, our team first tried to decode who real identity of the girl in the picture. Consequently, we found out that she is Amba Prasad, “MLA, Barkagaon, Jharkhand Legislative Assembly.”Moreover, Amba Prasad herself took to her official Twitter account to quash these claims. She wrote, “This is me @INCIndia Barkagaon MLA from the party. An attempt is made to spread discord by calling this photo a girl in Karnataka’s burqa. So, let me tell you that everyone in our party has respect and rights. Be it saffron clothes or hijab. @JharkhandPolice Please take action against those who comment on such tweets. https://twitter.com/Trishul_Achuk/status/1491467868923314178…”ConclusionTherefore, it is clear that the girl in the viral video is not related to the ongoing Hijab row protest in Karnataka. But, some users are sharing this picture to mislead common people.
label: truth

content: Fact check: The fake image of the Luxurious Hotel in Nakuru city got viral. Kenya announces its fourth incorporated city Nakuru. President Uhuru Kenyatta on 1st December 2021 awarded a city chapter to Nakuru city which is situated in the northwest part of the Capital city Nairobi. Mr Kinyanjui, Governor of Nakuru city said that various other projects will result in the growth of the city. Meanwhile, a claim is made about the city owning a Tower one Hotel in Nakuru city.A Facebook user JML, having 65K followers on Facebook made the claim, “TOWER ONE Hotel in Nakuru City Kenya, when we say we are the Number in Africa, not Only East Africa my people from Tanzania and Uganda pls respect us”Kampala Vibe, also claimed that Tower One Hotel a lavishing as well as the luxurious hotel is built on the land of Nakuru, Kenya.Fact CheckAfter digging inside the truth behind the claim on the picture, we got to know that the viral picture is of the luxurious hotel in Singapore and the picture was taken in 2018. Therefore, the claim is misleading.Claim review: The fake image of the Luxurious Hotel in Nakuru city got viralClaim by: Kampala VibeFact check: misleading.
label: rumor

content: Factcheck: Did Shivraj Chauhan carry doubt over BJP’s victory in Uttarakhand? Yesterday we witnessed the first round of the Uttar Pradesh general assembly elections in 11 districts. Meanwhile, a video of Shivraj Chouhan got viral claiming that he said there are full chances of BJP winning in Uttar Pradesh but chances in Uttarakhand are null.Uttarakhand Congress tweets, “After campaigning from Uttarakhand, Chief Minister @ChouhanShivraj of Madhya Pradesh told the reality of BJP in Uttarakhand, said BJP has gone from Uttarakhand. #उत्तराखंड_से_भाजपा_तो_गईHarish Rawat, Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, also tweeted that the CM of Madhya Pradesh said that BJP stands no chance in Uttarakhand.Fact checkAfter searching for the ground reality of the video and the claim, we got an article from NBT Times that writes in the viral video Shivraj Chauhan was talking to the journalist and said that BJP is in UP as well Uttarakhand. There is competition yet BJP can make it through. After that, he also requested the boy to not record the video.Zee TV also wrote how Madhya Pradesh, CM claimed about BJP is alive in Uttarakhand as well.Conclusion- Hence proving that the claim over Shivraj Chauhan is misleading.Claim Review: Shivraj Chauhan carry doubt over BJP’s victory in UttarakhandClaim by: Uttarakhand Congress, Harish RawatFact Check: Misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Whole truth behind Kejriwal’s viral video on supporting Shiromani. A Video of Delhi’s CM Arvind Kejriwal supporting and asking people of Punjab to vote for Shiromani Akali Dal, a Centre-right Sikh –centric state political party in Punjab.In this video, Kejriwal is praising Shiromani for all the work they have done in Punjab and made it a better state in the past 19 years and will make it better if you will vote and support Akali dal.Fact Check:The viral video is the clipped part of the whole video, where kejriwal is seen giving facts checks to people about the Akali Dal.
