He said that if you the people of Punjab support Akali dal, I am not here to ask you to leave the party and support my party.Rather I am requesting you to try a new party this time so that Punjab can too be a progressive state, with good schools and hospitals.This can be seen in the video below:Conclusion:The viral video is a clipped part of the real video therefore this is misleading.Claim Review: Kejriwal’s viral video on supporting Shiromani.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check : Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Fake picture of ‘Hijab Girl’ Muskan got viral. Recently, a video of ‘PES College of Arts, Science and Commerce’ located in Mandya city of Karnataka went viral on social media extensively. In which some youths are harassing a girl wearing a burqa by shouting Jai Shri Ram. At the same time, the girl was seen raising the slogan of Allahu Akbar in the video.The girl was identified as Muskan Khan. She is a B.Com second-year college student. After the video where Muskan came out as a symbol of bravery got viral, social media was flooded with posts in support of Muskan. Later Muskan was given the title of Hijab Girl. At the same time, many people also opposed her. Meanwhile, a picture is going viral on social media. The girl seen in the picture is not wearing a Burqa and people are identifying her as Muskan. Nevertheless, people are also claiming that Muskan plotted the Burqa walk in the viral video and she does not wear Burkha, generally.Fact checkAfter cross-checking for the authentication of a viral picture, we found that this picture is not of hijab girl Muskaan but Janata Dal (Secular) member Najma Nazir Chikkanrale. Najma uploaded this picture on Facebook on July 13, 2018, and she has confirmed it.Conclusion: the viral claim over the picture is fake as the girl in the picture is not Muskan Khan but Najma Nazeer Chikkanerale.Claim review: Fake picture of ‘Hijab Girl’ Muskan got viral.Claim by: Facebook usersFact check: fake
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Bangabandhu Tunnel Is South Asia’s First Tunnel Under The Karnaphuli River. Know The Reality Of The Viral Claim. An image is getting massively viral on social media platforms. The picture is of an underwater tunnel. Further, sharing the image, Mohibul Arman wrote which can be nearly translated into English, “Bangabandhu Tunnel is the South Asia’s first tunnel under the theKarnaphuli River. Joy Bangla Joy Bangabandhu My Bangladesh.”Similarly, many other social media users have shared the viral picture on their handles.FactCheckOn our fact check analysis we found that the viral image is morphed.The original picture is of the Engelberg tunnel. But, the users are sharing the edited image. Moreover, they are claiming that this is Asia’s first underwater tunnel on the Karnaphuli river, Bangladesh.Also Read: The Reality Of The Video In Which A Muslim ManTry To Marry A Hindu Girl.ConclusionHence, from our fact check analysis, it is clear that users are sharing an edited picture. Although, many projects are going on the Karnaphuli river. But, there is no such tunnel as claimed on the river. We got many reports from which we came to know that Bangabandhu Tunnel or Karnaphuli Tunnel, is still under construction.
label: truth

content: Fact check: The truth behind the video where girls in Hijab were assaulted. Escalation of Hijab Row enables the manufacturing of fake and misleading news. Another video is going viral on social media where a mob of girls wearing Hijab is getting harassed by a few boys on the street. The video presents a wicked act of racism. Tariq Baloch said ‘Deplorable! Control the thugs and Mobs, they are tarnishing India’s image. RSS Hindutva extremists Gangs are throwing dirty water on Muslim girls wearing hijab’ while addressing PM Modi.https://twitter.com/Tariq81620975/status/1491374762777792517?s=20&t=NtlYu2P-35lJxigm8i5uZQFact Check:After researching the ground of the video, we got to know that the video is of a college raging in the Eastern University of Sri Lanka. Students of Eastern University were assaulting Muslim students.Mohamed Sarjoon a Facebook user posted the same video on 23rd February 2019 where women in Hijab are running on the streets and boys are splashing water and different liquid material on them on the road in Sri Lanka.Another user Lanka Sun News wrote the same note over the injustice done with Sri Lankan Muslim students of Eastern University.Hence proving that the claim over video is misleading as the heinous act took place in Sri Lanka and not of India. People are using it as a weapon to escalate the Hijab Row protest.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is the Viral Video of women caught in a fire-related to Hijab Row? Hijab case is catching flame in the air of Karnataka with each passing day. The Supreme Court denies taking any hearing before the appropriate time on the case. On the other hand, Karnataka High Court has appealed to students for not wearing a religious dress until the verdict on the Hijab Row. A terrifying video over social media is going viral and people are claiming its involvement with Hijab Ban. Two-three women are standing on the top of the water tank whereas one lady among them tried to burn Hijab first and accidentally got herself burned in the fire depicts the video.Users on Facebook and Twitter are captioning that ladies did everything to show their support in the Hijab protest.Watch this video this lady was going to show her protest against #Hijab and what happened next will shocked you!!#HijabisOurRight #हिजाब_से_दर्द_क्यों #HijabIsIndividualRight pic.twitter.com/zNVKTGLIBX — AFZAL HUSAIN افضل حسین (@AhusainFAIZI) February 7, 2022Fact CheckAfter cross-checking the story behind the video. We found the video was highly misled by the users on social media. The video is 10 years old and the incident took place in Kapurthala District of Punjab. Few teachers went on the top of the water tank of Kapurthala District Hospital and demanded to meet the education minister of Punjab, Upinderjit Kaur. Unfortunately, the minister didn’t show up and in return two of them burned themselves. The fiery outburst was covered by Sikh Revolution on YouTube. Hence proving the claim is misleading.Claim review: Viral Video of women caught in a fire is related to Hijab RowClaim by: Tanveer photo Grapher BanihalFact check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Is New Zealand is planning to introduce the vaccine in the city supply water? New Zealand is expecting an outbreak of Omicron, predicators are saying that almost 1 million New Zealanders will get affected by this variant of Coronavirus. Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern has passed an advisory, “Prepare for winters”. The government has announced to get tested even if you have a mild fever. In between the season of Omicron, a claim of PM is getting viral, “According to the claim, Email between Government official and multiple local councils appear to introduce the possibility of Covid-19 Vaccine into city water supplies in areas where the vaccination rates have not reached 90%”Fact CheckAfter cross-checking the viral claim, we didn’t find any such post on nzherald.co.nz. Therefore, the claim is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did 50% of the Canadian Police resign to support Trucker’s protest in Ottawa? The Trucker’s protest in Canada’s capital city Ottawa is getting uncontrollable, Jim Watson the mayor of Ottawa has declared a national emergency after seeing the elevation in protest occurred due to Covid-19 protocols. Meanwhile, another big claim is getting viral on social media about how 50% of Canadian Police have resigned from their post and the rest 50% are not taking orders from the Canadian Government to show their support in Trucker’s protest.A month ago, a protest was drawn to raise voices against Trudeau’s new rule regarding Truckers crossing the US-Canadian border unvaccinated should get quarantined for a few days.https://twitter.com/bufy68/status/1490781960893083652?s=20&t=bkBLSY53BX8Z5Mg_LJpDUQWow BREAKING NEWS – Truckers in Ottawa are WINNING….. 50% of police in Ottawa just resigned!! The other 50% are not enforcing orders from Government. yea FREEDOM. Next is for the prime minister soy boy to be ousted. Thumbs up if you agree! — Bagboy (@maineacbagboy1) February 7, 2022Fact CheckOur research led to a different fact where Anita Anand, MP of Oakville has cleared the confusion by tweeting Canadian Force is not Canadian Police and the government has yet not planned to involve Arm forces in the protest happening in Ottawa.The @CanadianForces are not a police force. As such, there are no plans for the Canadian Armed Forces to be involved in the current situation in Ottawa in a law enforcement capacity. https://t.co/7ZJF72diQw — Anita Anand (@AnitaAnandMP) February 3, 2022After checking the sites, we didn’t find any such news on the Canadian website, newspaper or any newspaper in that case. Therefore the claim is fake and misleading as there’s only one news that Army won’t get involved in the protest as time soon.Claim review: 50% of the Canadian Police have resigned to support Trucker’s protest in OttawaClaim by: @maineacbagboy1Fact check: fake and misleading
label: truth

content: FactCheck: The Reality Of The Video In Which A Muslim ManTry To Marry A Hindu Girl. A video is going massively viral on social media the internet. In the video, a woman wearing black attire was crying and beating a man. Moreover, the man was dressed up like a Hindu groom and there was another girl also. The other girl was wearing a red bridal lehenga. In the video, the man was trying to marry another girl but he was already married. Furthermore, he was a Muslim man as the girl in black dress claimed. But, he was trying to marry a Hindu girl by changing his name.Sharing the video users claim that the man in the video is a fraud and tries to trap Hindu girls in his love. Along with the video, Sunil Tiwari wrote the caption which can be nearly translated into English, “This is happening along with Hindu girls, they are being implicated by changing their names.”Similarly, many other social media users shared this post. Moreover, the comments on the post were flooded with various ill words.FactCheckWe found that this was not a real video on our FactCheck analysis. The viral video is scripted. But, some people are sharing it misleadingly. Basant Jagra uploaded the viral video on his Facebook handle.We can see many such scripted videos on the profile of Basant Jagra.Also Read: Zakir Naik Absconded But His Mission ContinuesConclusionThat is to say, the viral video is fake and scripted. They made this video to make girls aware of such fraud man. But, users are sharing this video to mislead people. DFRAC, warn the readers not to believe in any such fake video.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind post a tweet seeking votes for BSP? A screenshot of Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind’s tweet is going viral on social media. In which an appeal has been made to vote for the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) in the UP election 2022.The wordings in the screenshot says that wherever you will find a Muslim contestant fighting in the UP election 2022 from Bahujan Samaj Party, Kindly cast your vote for them. As many Muslim candidates will win, Inshallah, our Muslim community will get stronger. He also added that BSP has also got the votes of our Dalit brothers.Fact CheckAfter our analysis, the claim came out to be false and fake. At the same time, Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind also denied the appeal to vote for BSP by tweeting on their Twitter account.Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind in his tweet said it denies seeking votes for a particular party and someone has surely edited one of our tweets from the Twitter account of Jamiat. As Jamiat never announces to vote for any party in elections. Therefore, the screenshot of Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind requesting casting votes for BSP is fake.Claim Review: Jamiat Ulama-i-Hind appeals to vote for BSPClaimed by: TwitterFact Check: Fake.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Has Mayawati Pledged To Support BJP In UP assembly polls? Know The Reality Of The Viral Video Vidhan Sabha elections are very near in Uttar Pradesh. Consequently, many news are coming every day regarding it. Some are real but many are fake or misleading. Today, DFRAC has come up with one such news for the readers. The news is regarding BSP leader Mayawati. Meanwhile, sharing the clip on 8th February 2022 Rambhakt Somesh Singh wrote which nearly translate into English, “Now even the aunt has spoken to the babua. No Lal Topi, Kala Kot, no vote for SP ”https://twitter.com/officialsomesh0/status/1490940040062836739Similarly, other users shared this clip on their social media handles.FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, we found that users are misleadingly sharing this video.The print uploaded the video on Oct 29, 2020. The viral video is a clip taken from this video. In the video, Mayawati had said that in the then-upcoming MLC elections in UP her party would vote for the BJP or any other party’s candidate to defeat the SP’s “second candidate.”Also Read: Sushant Singh Rajput Dead But Trending Everyday On TwitterConclusionTherefore, from our FactCheck analysis, it is clear that users are misleadingly sharing the viral clip. Mayawati has not pledged to vote for BJP in the upcoming UP elections
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Ravi Kishan’s interview on “Maharaj Ji” with News 24 goes viral. A video of Ravi Kishan, a member of Lok Sabha and renowned actor is getting viral everywhere on the internet. In this, he is shown speaking for “Maharaj Ji” also known as Yogi Aditya Nath.He stated, “पर्चा भर के चल जइह न बहुत बेज्जती होई” which roughly states that, you shall leave the place after filling the form, else it will be a disgrace. This can be heard in these tweets belowअजय सिंह बिष्ट को बोले पर्चा भर के चल जइह न बहुत बेज्जती होई… गजब बेइज्जती है! 😜😂 pic.twitter.com/DKZh5YNkmI — Dinesh Chauhan (@dinesh_chauhan) February 5, 2022People all over the internet are trolling Kishan for such statements.https://twitter.com/Pr54671680/status/1489881287837970434Fact Check:When we listened to the whole video, rather than the clipped part of the video we found an entirely different meaning of video.In the interview given to NEWS 24 Ravi Kishan stated, “हम महाराज जी से बोले -केवल पर्चा भरकर चले जायें, यहां प्रचार मत करना बड़ी बेइज्जती होगी’ ‘उत्तरप्रदेश के इतिहास में महाराज जी की सबसे बड़ी जीत होगी’ which roughly sates, “’We told Maharaj ji – just fill the form and go away, it would be a disgrace to campaign here’ ‘Maharaj ji’s biggest victory in the history of Uttar Pradesh’: BJP MP Ravi Kishan .”Conclusion:Hence, the video getting viral on social media is a clipped video from the statement of Ravi Kishan given interview to NEWS 24.Claim Review: Ravi Kishan’s viral statement on Maharaj Ji.Claimed by: social media users.Fact Check: Misleading.
label: rumor

content: CM Yogi, A Man of His Words or a mislead through his Tweets  Uttar Pradesh is going for a month-long assembly election from the 10th of February 2022, polling for 403 seats would be done in seven phases. In 2017, BJP with its allies got a landslide majority of 312 seats. In a highly surcharged political atmosphere stakes of BJP and Samajwadi Party-led collisions are high. With Congress and the Bahujan Samaj Party is also trying to regain its lost ground in the state.All Political formations including BJP which is facing anti-incumbency are making tall claims to win as many seats. The incumbent CM of UP Yogi is now more active on Twitter and trying to build a narrative by tweets. He is tweeting very frequently the political content as well as making claims of his government’s achievement. We have scanned and analyzed various tweets of Yogi Adityanath and fact-checked the claims.Fact Checks on The Tweets Of CM YogiClaim no.1Election campaigns bring out the best possible promises which can be made by a politician. Providing employment comes under the vital necessity for any party. According to this claim of Yogi Adityanath, before 2017 the unemployment rate was 17.6%. But, after 2017 the unemployment rate slides down to 3.0%.वर्ष 2017 के बाद यूपी के इतिहास में प्रदेश की बेरोजगारी दर सबसे कम हुई… फर्क साफ है! pic.twitter.com/CuB1wUBcxF — Yogi Adityanath (मोदी का परिवार) (@myogiadityanath) February 3, 2022Let’s dig into the claim, first of all in the governance of BSP or Akhilesh Yadav in February 2017 the employment rate was also 3.0 %, and coming back to the Yogi government, indeed the employment rate of January 2022 is 3.0 % but it does not include the whole graph. According to CMIE, Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy in April 2020 and March 2020, unemployment was at a peak of 21.5% and 20.5 % respectively in Uttar Pradesh. The tweet is quite misleading. As all the political parties have their ups and downs, if you see the graph.Conclusion the tweet is misleading as both governments have their ups and downs.Claim 2In 2017 after winning the election Yogi Adityanath promised to give 70 Lakh jobs in UP. CM Yogi stressed generating the job opportunity through vocational education and skill development in the upcoming 5 years.UP CM added that our government will provide 70 lakh jobs to the population where 1 crore people are unemployed.Alas! Reality came out to be brutal, as per the data only 4.5% Lakh Jobs was given by the Yogi govt in the tenure of 5 years claimed by BJP MP Harish Diwedi.Conclusion the tweet is misleading as only 4.5 lakhs job has been provided in UP.Claim no. 3The CM Yogi at his completion of 2 years as a Chief Minister on 3rd January 2019, remarked that no riot has taken place under his governance in Uttar Pradesh.मार्च में मेरे शासनकाल के दो वर्ष पूरे होंगे। मेरे अब तक के शासन में, कोई दंगा नहीं हुआ है। — Yogi Adityanath (मोदी का परिवार) (@myogiadityanath) January 3, 2019FACT CHECKAn article of Business standard tells us about the burning cases of UP riots. In comparison from 2017 to 2020, UP has witnessed the fastest fall in riot cases but having said that UP’s falling statistics are more than the number of current riot cases present in any state of India.If you look at the data closely Rioting cases in Uttar Pradesh is on the third number after Bihar and Maharashtra in 2018 among all other states in India as per the National Crime Records Bureau. Keeping the point in my mind that UP holds a population of 23 crores but according to CM, no riot took place in UP after his governance.According to our next data in 2019, the crime rate of Uttar Pradesh is the highest among all the states of India which is 13% whereas all other states lie on or under 10% including Bihar.Last but the most important one, in the comparison between the crime rate cases from 2016 to 2018 the criminal cases have doubled in the District like Kanpur, Gaziabad, and Lucknow.Conclusion: Hence proving a misleading claim is made about no riot taking place in UP by CM Yogi Adityanath’s Twitter accountClaim 4CM Yogi, on 8th January 2022, in the tweet mentioned that the party distributed sports essential kits to 25000 members of Mahila dal including women and youth in Lucknow and this is a step taken to empower the Mahila Mandal.आज लखनऊ में युवक एवं महिला मंगल दलों को खेल-सामग्री वितरित की गई है। यह प्रोत्साहन खेल-सामग्री, प्रदेश में लगभग 25,000 युवक एवं महिला मंगल दलों को उपल​ब्ध कराई जा रही है। युवा कल्याण विभाग तथा दलों से जुड़े युवकों व महिलाओं को हृदय से बधाई! — Yogi Adityanath (मोदी का परिवार) (@myogiadityanath) January 8, 2022Fact CheckMedia coverage of the report: Hindustan Newspaper134 members of the Youth and Mahila Dal have been given the sports incentive kits in Lucknow. 81 members of Yuva Mahila Dal and 83 to Mahila Mandal Dal. A program was organized by the Youth Welfare Department at the Youth Center near Sai Mandir where MLC (Member of Legislative Council) handed over incentive kits to the members of Yuvak Mangal Dal and Mahila Mangal Dal.Conclusion: the claim is misleading and fake.Claim 5Yogi Ji determined the development in ‘Har Ghar Nal Yojna’. PM Narendra Modi had introduced this scheme in November 2020. This scheme comes under the Jal Jeevan Mission, launched in two districts of Uttar Pradesh Mirzapur and Sonbhadra. Yogi Ji claimed that under the surveillance of Har Ghar Nal Yojna, pure water is supplied to 30k Gram Panchayat villages.Fact CheckThe spin in the story comes here as per the SARKARIYOJNA.COM, the scheme only prevails in 2 districts of UP, Mirzapur has 1971 villages and Sonbhadra has 1450 villages which make a lump sum of 3500 villages. Then how come this scheme has served the people of 30k villages.Another proof where Police Result posted about Har Ghar Nal Yojna, as you can see the article was posted on 29th December 2021. They have specifically mentioned that the scheme has been launched in only two districts of Uttar Pradesh, Mirzapur, and Sonbhadra.Conclusion- Serving 30k villages is a fake and misleading tweet done by UP CM Yogi Adityanath. As the scheme, Har Ghar Nal Yojna only serves 2 districts of Uttar Pradesh.Claim 6In the tweet of 3 February 2022, CM Yogi posted a clip of a press conference held in Lucknow. Yogi was talking about UP’s growth in terms of vaccination and GDP rate. According to him in the period of 5 years (2017-2022), UP has made a place on the second number or the second largest contributor in the country’s economy. At exactly 10:57 to 11:20 minutes of the video, UP CM claims that due to pandemic states got affected still UP made it to the second position which has not been seen from 1947 to 2017. From 1947 to 2017, UP stood at 6th or 7th position after being the most populous state in the country.Fact CheckYogi Adityanath’s statement does not match with data, to be honest. As per the report of RBI, in the list of Gross State Domestic Product Uttar Pradesh was also at 2nd number and Maharashtra at 1st under the governance of CM Mayawati in the (FY 2009-10) UP.In the year 2017-18, there was a down as UP was ranked to 4th position after Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Tamil Nadu as per the tableau of RBI. Under the governance of Yogi Adityanath.Conclusion: The claim is misleading and fake as in the data of FY 17-18, UP stood at 3rd position after Tamil Nadu. Hence proving that before 2017 also UP made it into the top 3 in the list. And, after 2017 the governance of Yogi Adityanath never came on the second position in the GSDP list.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Energy Minister Shrikant Sharma chased and thrashed by the Human chain, video goes viral. The video of Energy Minister Shrikant Sharma goes viral all over the internet. It’s shown in the video how the human chain lost its control and jumped on the vehicle in agitation.People all over the internet are trolling him under various hilarious captions like “the crowd is checking the speed of the vehicle of energy minister.” And “The crowd is checking the energy of the energy minister”.Fact Check:Through our research, we found that in this video people are not chasing the energy minister, but of Koderma MP Ravindra Rai. He was attacked by the human chain near the Telmachcho bridge of Bokaro.Rai himself told the press about this attack on him. He said that he was unaware of this human chain agitation. An FIR is also registered on the agitators. The news was also covered by the newspaper of Kolkata “The Telegraph”https://www.telegraphindia.com/jharkhand/language-stir-turns-violent-as-agitators-call-for-stringent-forms-of-protest/cid/1849803Conclusion:Therefore the news was misleading, as the agitators did not attack the Energy Minister, but the of koderma MP Ravindra Rai.Claim Review: The agitators attack Energy Minister Shrikant Sharma.Claimed by: Social Media Users.Fact Check: misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did the students of Shimoga District replace the National Flag and Hoisted Saffron Flag? Hijab Row is an issue raised during the protest that erupted between the students wearing saffron shawl and hijab outside the Mahatma Gandhi Memorial College Campus in Karnataka. According to Muslim students, they have been banned from wearing hijabs in the classroom. The matter got into heat and went into the hands of the Karnataka High Court. The state government also declared three day holiday for the school and colleges after seeing the elevation of the protest. Hijab keepers are raising voices against the ban whereas other students are defending Hinduism on Twitter. Meanwhile, political leaders also shared their views on the Hijab Row as Priyanka Vadra Gandhi made a statement, “It is woman’s right to decide what she wants to wear”.The protest led to a new trend on Twitter (#HijabRow), users were quarrelling their opinion on social media. Nevertheless, it is a known fact that social media protest leads to the incoming of fake and misleading claims. A video is going viral on social media where people are claiming that students of a college are replacing the National Flag with Saffron Flag in Shimoga. The video has ignited the environment of communal hatred around the nation.The National Flag is replaced by a Saffron Flag in a Karnataka College !! You have no problem Mr CM @BSBommai ??? pic.twitter.com/hAXbEpE5HU — Augustine Varkey (@logicalindianz) February 8, 2022#Update: #KarnatakaHijabRow Education Minister @BCNagesh_bjp informs that a probe has been ordered in this incident. If at all National flag has been replaced by Saffron flag it is condemnable. — Imran Khan (@KeypadGuerilla) February 8, 2022Renowned Newspaper, India Today also got tricked and posted a story on it.How people are taking the #HijabRowDK Shivakumar a verified account and a Congress MLA said, “Some anti-national elements allied with BJP have brought down the national flag in a college in Shimoga. I urge everyone to post a photo of themselves with the national flag as a mark of protest.”Some anti-national elements allied with BJP have brought down the national flag in a college in Shimoga. I urge everyone to post a photo of themselves with the national flag as a mark of protest.#MyTricolourMyPride pic.twitter.com/zHvPg53FHh — DK Shivakumar (@DKShivakumar) February 8, 2022https://twitter.com/AmanHarris/status/1491062299632746503?s=20&t=SQJusykUk8_oKbx7LGYKzwOwaisi once asked Hindus, how long Modi and Yogi will safeguard you. Mr Owaisi, here is the reply..we! #Shimoga https://t.co/YGQz7vkbTo — Organic Hindu (@OrganicHindu) February 8, 2022In short– A video is going viral where people are claiming that some students replace the Nation Flag with Saffron Flag in Shimoga District.Fact CheckAfter digging inside the viral claim, we got tweets from the verified accounts ANI stating that the Tricolour Flag was not hoisted on the poll in fact the poll was empty. Students only hoisted the saffron flag and didn’t replace it with National Flag.Karnataka Hijab Row | There was a report that the national flag was lowered & in place of that a saffron flag was put up but there was no national flag on the poll. Only a saffron flag was hoisted on top of the poll& later they removed it themselves: Shivamogga SP BM Laxmi Prasad pic.twitter.com/3EmS0Wm8C6 — ANI (@ANI) February 8, 2022Deepak Bopanna (correspondent at Times Now), tweets that the principal of the college in Shimoga District posted a picture of a bare poll, clarifying that Tricolour Flag was initially not hoisted on the top of the poll. He also added that students only went to hoist the saffron flag on the bare poll while protesting against the Hijab Row.Saffron flag controversy: Principal of the Shivmogga college Dhananjaya has shared this pic of the bare flag pole from earlier today. Protesting Hindu students later went on to hoist a #Saffron flag while protesting against #Hijab. He says Indian flag was removed on Jan 26th. pic.twitter.com/xQRZYbwwME — Deepak Bopanna (@dpkBopanna) February 8, 2022India Today also covered the news of Hijab Row and clarified that the Tricolour was not replaced by a saffron flag in Shimoga and locals have informed that the flag poll was empty.Karnataka hijab showdown: Sources say Tricolour not replaced in Shivamoga; local authorities claim flag post was empty. #5iveLive with @ShivAroor pic.twitter.com/PIxuktwG4c — IndiaToday (@IndiaToday) February 8, 2022Conclusion: The claim on the video is fake and misleading as initially the Tricolour Flag was not hoisted on the poll and students only aimed to hoist saffron flag on the poll in occurrence of Hijab Protest.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Truth behind Bhagwant Mann’s viral video? A video is getting viral on social media sites of AAP’s (Aam Aadmi Party) Punjab president Bhagwant Mann on social media sites where he is being trolled on a statement that he gave against CM Arvind Kejriwal.Many users on social media claimed his statement as a drunk statement and him as a drunkard. This is the video that is getting viralhttps://twitter.com/MeraSanatana/status/1489254268473585666?s=20&t=DpSBVlIC6azxIKXyjE6alQFact Check:Through our research, we get to know that the video getting viral is edited version of the real version. In the clipped video, the word “daku” roughly means” goon” is changed with the name of CM Arvind Kejriwal. So that it is deliberately shown as Bhagwat Mann against his own party leader.Here you can see the real speech of Bhagwat Mann.Conclusion:This is a clipped and edited video of Bhagwat Mann and nothing like shown is said by him in any of his speeches.Claim Review: Truth behind Bhagwat Mann’s viral video.Claimed by: Social media users.Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is the Viral Video the last video of Lata Mangeshkar? As we all know the demise of Lata Mangeshkar has left a feeling of sorrow in the heart of our Nation. Lata Ji left us on 6th February 2022 at the age of 92, she will be known among the best singers of India also called ‘Swar Kokila’. People around the nation mourned her death on social media and a video is getting viral claiming that it was the last video of Lata Mangeshkar before her death. In the video, Lata Ji is greeting the audience and sharing her sweet journey with RD Burman.JiMangeshkarhttps://twitter.com/DrUgrabhatah/status/1490200128602324993?s=20&t=9OHkja6cii0NC-g527M53Qhttps://youtu.be/oYxCxuGFBfkFact CheckAfter searching the video on Lata Ji’s Facebook profile we didn’t find any such videos on 4th February 2022 as claimed. However, we found a post where she went live on the death anniversary of RD Burman and there you can see the same clip of viral video. The live video was posted from her Facebook account on 4th January 2017.Conclusion- Hence claiming that the video going viral is fake and misleading.Claim Review: Is the Viral Video the last video of Lata MangeshkarClaim By: Dr KANA KANTA BHARAT BOSEFact Check: Misleading .JiMangeshkar
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Fact-checking on Instagram over the demise of Lata Mangeshkar true or not? Lata Mangeshkar was a well-known and most famous playback singer of all time. She was also considered as the “NIGHTINGALE OF BOLLYWOOD”. The news of her demise got viral all over India so in order to show one’s grievance, all the celebrities and famous people forwarded their condolences to her and her family.In between this Sachin Tendulkar, a famous cricketer too posted a story on Instagram over the demise of Lata Mangeshkar , to which Instagram imposed a flag on post warning their users of fake news.Fact Check:Through our research, We got to know that fake news on the demise of lata Mangeshkar was earlier too spread by people on social media platforms on 24th of Jan 2022.This fake news was covered by many media houses . our website was also one of them to consider it as fake news.https://newsmobile.in/articles/2022/01/24/fact-check-fake-news-about-demise-of-legendary-singer-lata-mangeshkar-goes-viral/Our website was also one of them to consider it as fake news.This time when it was a true piece of information, Instagram again put it in the false news parameters, to warn their users. People have tweeted it all over the internet thrashing Instagram for treating the news of the demise of famous singer Lata Mangeshkar as a piece of fake news.Conclusion:Instagram falsely claimed the news of the demise of Lata Mangeshkar as fake news, when in actuality she left us all yesterday i.e. 6th of February 2022. Hence, it was a false claim by Instagram.Claim Review: Fact-checking on Instagram over the demise of Lata Mangeshkar true or notClaimed by: InstagramFact Check: false.
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Shahrukh Khan Spits On The Mortal Remains Of Lata Mangeshkar. Claimed By Society Media Users. Bharat Ratna Lata Mangeshkar left us forever on February 6. Various people including many top celebrities attended her funeral held at Shivaji Park. Meanwhile, when everyone was busy in mourning, some people shared a video of her funeral on social media sites. The video clip is of Shahrukh Khan offering her prayers to Lata Ji. Further, sharing the clip people claim he was spiting in front of her dead body. Furthermore, Arun Yadav, the State In-Charge of @BJP4Haryana, as written in his Twitter account posted the video with the caption, ” kya isne thooka?”(has he spit).In the same vein, a user @neeraj_jain75 describes this act as Thook Jihad.Further, another user Hardik wrote in the caption, “what’s the obsession of M with spitting? Was Srk spitting?” Apparently, The letter M here in the tweet is to target a certain community.What's the obsession of M with spitting? Was Srk spitting ! pic.twitter.com/DXSXjQd57j — Hardik (Modi Ka Parivar) (@Humor_Silly) February 6, 2022Similarly, thousands of people shared this video clip with many disgusting comments. Above all, many media houses started the debate on this very topic.FactCheckFirstly, these types of news tweets give rise to a very serious question what is wrong in our society? It is debatable what is more insensitive, spreading this news on very emotional occasions like deaths where everyone is busy in mourning or believing in this news.Looking at the video it is quite clear that Shahrukh was offering prayers for late Lata Ji. And, after that, he just blew air on her mortal remains as a sign of love and respect.Also Read Zakir Naik Absconded But His Mission ContinuesConclusionThat is to say, people are sharing the viral video of Shahrukh Khan with fake and misleading claims. Hence, the viral video is heavily misinterpreted. And, the main concern with such news is that they have the potential to develop hate between different communities. Therefore, we must condemn those who try to spread misleading news that can disturb the peace and harmony of our country.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Fact Check: Is Ajit Anjum quitting journalism if CM Yogi returned to power? A screenshot of an alleged tweet by journalist Ajit Anjum is going viral on social media. It was stated that if CM Yogi Adityanath returns to power in 2022, he will leave journalism.Fact CheckOn checking the viral screenshot, we found it to be fake.Actually, in the screenshot, Ajit Anjum’s Twitter account was said to be verified with a blue tick. Whereas in reality, it is not so.Along with this, Ajit Anjum also tweeted and informed about this screenshot being fake. He wrote, मेरे बारे में दुष्प्रचार का नया फोटोशॉप. मेरे नाम से कुछ भी लिखकर वायरल किया जा रहा है. इसी से पता चलता है कि भक्तों की जमात मुझ पर कितनी बौखलाई हुई है. मेरा ट्वीटर हैंडल वेरिफाइड नहीं है लेकिन ब्लू टिक वाला फोटोशॉप करके खेल चालू है. ये फर्जी लोग हैं.Which roughly states “new propaganda about me. Anything written in my name is going viral. This shows how furious the community of devotees is on me. My twitter handle is not verified but the game is on by photoshopping the blue tick. This is a fake tweet.”ConclusionWith the research and Ajit Anjum himself coming forward it is clear that the viral screenshot is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Gori Khan is seen paying tribute to Lata Mangeshkar with Shah Rukh Khan.  ‘Swar Kokila’ Lata Mangeshkar passed away on Sunday at the age of 92 at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai. There is a wave of mourning in the whole country due to her demise. Many celebrities mourned her death. The news of Lata Ji’s death has been shocking for Bollywood. Many film stars reached Shivaji Park to pay tribute to Lata Ji. A picture of Shahrukh Khan paying tribute to Lata is going viral on social media. In which he is seen standing with a woman with folded hands.Here’s ⁦@iamsrk⁩ and his wife ⁦@gaurikhan⁩ bidding adieu to Lataji. What a picture of amity and respect this makes #Faith #Humanity pic.twitter.com/fT2M9ThviO — Vinod Sharma (@VinodSharmaView) February 6, 2022A user named Vinod Sharma tweeted this picture saying that ‘Shah Rukh Khan with his wife Gori Khan bidding farewell to Lataji, a picture of friendship and respect, it instils faith in humanity.Conclusion: On checking the viral picture, we found that the woman praying with Shah Rukh Khan is not his wife Gauri Khan but his manager Pooja Dadlani. Therefore, the claim of the woman seen in the viral picture being a Gori Khan is false.Claim Review: Gori Khan is seen paying tribute to Lata Mangeshkar with Shah Rukh Khan.Claimed by: Social media users.Fact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Congress leader trolled over her slip of tongue. Video of the Former MLA and Congress leader of Vidhan Sabha Mahalka Kalan, Bibi Harchand Kaur Ghanauri was campaigning for candidate Kewal Singh Dhillon from Lok Sabha constituency Sangrur in Chhichiwalkalan. During this, her tongue slipped and instead of asking for votes only for Dhillon, she was asked to vote for Bhagwant Mann.For this she is trolled all over the social media. The supporters from the opposition party have that video in many social sites.Fact Checkwhen we researched the video we find out that the video that is spreading all over the internet is actually the cropped part of that video , this is true that her tongue slipped , but now and then she corrected her mistake and asked people to vote for Singh Dhillon and not Bhagwat Mann.Later Bibi Harchand Kaur Ghanouri also apologized to people in a video that was made to explain her slippery tongue on social media and appealed to vote only in favor of Dhillon. As written in AMAR UJALA newsapaper.https://www.amarujala.com/punjab/ludhiana/151558111520-ludhiana-newsConclusion Hence, the video was partly correct ,but no full video is getting circulated over the internet.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did South Indian Actor Suman donate 117 Acres of Land for the Army? Actor Suman is a well-known actor in Telugu and Tamil film industries. Recently he has worked with Akshay Kumar in the movie Gabbar is Back. He played an antagonist in the movie Gabbar and the role got several appreciations from around the nation. A claim that concerns him is getting viral on Social Media. Users are saying that he has donated 117 acres of land to the Indian Army.Actor SUMAN garu Donated 117 Acres Land to Indian Army 🙏 https://t.co/pBikeNVG3l — 𝑨𝒂𝒌𝒂𝒔𝒉 ♡︎ ᴷᵃˡᵏᶦ2８９８ᴬᴰ💥 O+ 🩸 (@HailForTheRebel) January 31, 2022Actor #Suman garu donates 117 acres land to Indian army 🪖 Huge respect to you sir 🙏 — Movies4u Official (@Movies4u_Officl) January 31, 2022The claim of donating land to the Indian Army has recently caught fire on social media.The news which says Actor Suman has donated 117 acres of land to the Indian Army has created a heroic impact on viewers. People are praising him for his thoughtful deeds.Fact CheckAn article of News 18 says that the Actor has declared the news is false as soon as he got to know about it and further adds that the case regarding the 117 acres of land is still going on in court. After he gets the land out of controversy, he will inform it on social media. He carried different plans for the land, like opening an Ayurveda Resort, Open Studio and later he also thought of donating the land for the welfare of the Army. Hence proving the claim is misleading.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Are The Streets Of Charminar Close In A Protest Over The Attack On Owaisi? These days, many news are coming related to the recent attack on AIMIM chief Asad Owaisi. In the same vein, an image of empty streets is getting viral on the internet. Sharing the image Hi Hyderabad wrote in the caption, “Deserted Streets of Charminar in Hyderabad Today Morning. Shops have been closed voluntarily in protest of the attack on @asadowaisi.”Deserted Streets of Charminar in Hyderabad Today Morning. Shops have been closed voluntarily in protest of attack on @asadowaisi. pic.twitter.com/EdhwYq95Q1 — Hi Hyderabad (@HiHyderabad) February 4, 2022Similarly, many other users share this image on their social media handles. No doubt the attack on Owaisi is condemning. Also, these type of act spread hate in the society.FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, our team found a report from flower aura. Moreover, we also found that this image was a part of the Janta curfew in the wake of Covid 19. In the report, there were many other images of deserted streets of different areas also.Therefore, from the above image, it is clear that the viral image is two years old. But, some users are sharing it with the wrong intentions of misleading people.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Rahul Gandhi say demonetization was beneficial? A video of former Congress President Rahul Gandhi is going viral on social media with the claim that he praised the demonetization brought by the Modi government at the Centre.In the viral video, Rahul Gandhi can be heard saying, “Ask any youth who can do the work of note ban, what is the benefit or harm of the note ban. Ask the eight-year-old children, son, whether the note ban has benefited or harmed, he will say that it is beneficial.Fact checkOn checking the viral video, we found that this video is of Yuva Aakrosh rally of Congress held at Albert Hall in Jaipur. This video has been edited. The part of the video in which Rahul Gandhi’s tongue slipped and he was seen handling his words. That part was edited.The video of the rally uploaded on the official YouTube channel of the Indian National Congress on January 28, 2020 at the time 34:21 shows the part which has been edited and removed from the viral clip.Apart from this, we also got a report of Rajasthan Patrika related to the rally. In which it was told that during the speech, Rahul Gandhi’s tongue slipped twice. However, he immediately tried to correct his point. The tongue slipped for the first time when Rahul was speaking about the power of youth.Rahul said, the whole world believes that the youth of India can not only change India but the country. After this, he immediately apologized and said that not the country, they can change the world. For the second time, the tongue slipped during a sarcasm on demonetization. He said, “Ask an eight-year-old child whether the son has benefited or suffered due to demonetization, then the child will say that there is profit. Then he immediately handled it and said that where is the profit or the loss.Conclusion: Hence, Rahul Gandhi’s claim of demonetization as beneficial is fake.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Truth Behind Viral Video of Gopal Chaudhary. In the midst of UP Elections every now and then any video or picture makes its spot in the viral column. This time too a video is getting viral on social media sites. This video is of an independent candidate from Agra, Gopal Chaudhary.In this video, he is claiming to enter into politics because he wants to earn money . In his interview he stated, “I have no motive to enter in politics besides earning money”. He also stated that he will dupe the public as any other minister does. His video went viral as people are considering him the most honest politician, as he said what was in his mind.Meet India’s most honest politician Gopal Chaudhary- who has only agenda, to win elections and make lots of money ! 😂😂#Election2022 pic.twitter.com/leitRDlUBj — Sumit Agarwal 🇮🇳 (@sumitagarwal_IN) February 4, 2022Fact Check: through our research on this video we got to know that this video is of course of Gopal Chaudhary, an independent candidate from Agra, but not from these recent elections, but from the year 2017. As we find is only news covered in newspaper like The Indian Express.That time too this was a big hit as many newspapers and media channels covered his speech .Conclusion: As the video that is getting viral is actually of Gopal Chaudhary , but not of these elections but from the year 2017.Claim review: Gopal Chaudhary claiming to enter into politics because he wants to earn money.Claimed by : social media usersFact Check : misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: OPIndia ran a false news of SP workers raising pro-Pakistan slogans at Kanpur rally Right wing website opindia.com ran a false news of Samajwadi Party workers raising pro-Pakistan and anti-national slogans to polarize Uttar Pradesh elections.The website claimed in its report that in a video related to the Kanpur rally, SP workers can be heard saying “Pakistan has to be made, cycle button has to be pressed”.Quoting this report, several YouTube channels also accused SP workers of indulging in anti-national activities.Fact Check:On checking the above claim, we found that the news of SP workers raising pro-Pakistan slogans is false. In this regard, we found a tweet from News24. In which the above claim was denied by quoting the Kanpur administration.In the video posted along with the tweet, the Kanpur administration said that the original video was examined by the FST team to know the truth behind the viral video. In which the use of the word Pakistan was not found. Legal action is being taken in the matter.Conclusion: Hence, the news of SP workers raising pro-Pakistan slogans by OPIndia at the Kanpur rally is completely false. The Kanpur administration found it wrong in its investigation.Claim Review : OPIndia ran a false news of SP workers raising pro-Pakistan slogans at Kanpur rallyClaim by: OP IndiaFact check: Fake and Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Whole Truth behind “Freedom Convoy 2022” claiming to have 50,000 trucks. Freedom convoy 2022 protests against Covid -19 in Canada, in this protest the truck convoys covered on Ottawa on January 29, 2022, and is still continued i.e. in February. This demonstration was against Prime Minister Justin Trudeau’s mandates for vaccines.Now the news is all over the internet that the convoy now is bigger than the Canadian Army.https://www.facebook.com/search/top/?q=Convoy%202022%20is%20larger%20than%20the%20Canadian%20ArmyFact Check:Canadian armed forces are the largest of the three elements. Canada is ranked 23 of 140 out of the countries considered for the annual GFP review.Through research, we landed on a piece of information from the National Post where they proved it through the maths to simplify this news and make their readers understand the ongoing situation of the protest.They say “ a look at math shows that 50,000 trucks would be so unprecedentedly, massive that it would be currently be lined up bumper to bumper across swaths of Ontario and Quebec.”https://nationalpost.com/news/canada/theres-a-lot-of-trucks-in-freedom-convoy-2022-but-not-nearly-50000On the other hand a tweet by David Akin, a chief political correspondent. Twitted on Twitter about the number of vehicles. which are 113 commercial vehicles and 276 personal vehicles (SUV pickups, and cars).https://twitter.com/davidakin/status/1486699830147756032?s=20&t=NNztvSHM702-5GGhJLiOVgConclusion:-The news of 50,000 convoy trucks is misleading as there are a lot of trucks in freedom convoy 2022 but not as many as 50,000.Claim Review: “Freedom Convoy 2022” claiming to have 50,000 trucks.Claimed by: social media users.Fact check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did the Female Constable of Mahoba Police Station get raped? Mahoba is a district in Uttar Pradesh, well known for Sun Temple which was made in the 9th century. Recently the news is getting viral regarding a Female Constable of Mahoba Police station who got raped and admitted to district hospital for taking poison. As per the report of Hindustan, The Upper Superintendent of Police RK Gautam also mentioned his relationship with Female Constable. The guilty Constable Abhishek got arrested for committing the crime.Aditya News has posted the same story of how a Female Constable of Mahoba Police got raped in the Panwadi area of the District.Fact CheckAfter cross-checking the tweet we got a tweet by Mahoba Police about denying the claims made by the media houses like Dainik Jagran and Hindustan. They clearly said that the woman who got raped was not a Female Constable in Mahoba Police Station and attached an official note to rectify the news made on Mahoba Police. The woman Indeed went through sexual harassment but her identity is not of a Female Constable.Furthermore, UP Police Fact check also republished the post and refuted the news that victim is a Female Constable at Mahoba Police Station.Conclusion: Therefore, the news is fake and misleading as the victim is not a female constable at Mahoba District.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is Yogi threatening the Jats in the UP election speech? A picture is getting viral on Twitter and other social media sites where it is clearly written under the name of UP’s chief minister Yogi Aditya Nath, ‘’ केराना, मुजफ्फरनगर बागपत और मथुरा के जतो का इलाज कर दूंगा 10 मार्च कोवोट भजपा को दे” which roughly states that,’ I will see to the people of Kerana, Muzaffarnagar, Baghpat, and Mathura on March 10. Vote for BJP.”https://twitter.com/aimim_moradabad/status/1489446316417576961?s=20&t=VLypaW5q5fOKaJ77bMxzQgOn this statement to Yogi, there is a lot of agitation in jats and they are spreading this image under the caption likeIf any jat gave the vote to him he shall have his DNA test.Fact Check:Through reverse image search, we got to know that this viral picture is a photo shopped image of the real tweet of yogi in which he tweeted something like this “कैराना से तमंचावादी पार्टी का प्रत्याशी धमकी दे रहा है, यानी गर्मी अभी शांत नहीं हुई है! 10 मार्च के बाद गर्मी शांत हो जाएगी.” This roughly translates to “The candidate of the Tamanchawadi Party from Kairana is threatening, that is, and the heat has not calmed down yet! After 10th March the heat will cool down”कैराना से तमंचावादी पार्टी का प्रत्याशी धमकी दे रहा है, यानी गर्मी अभी शांत नहीं हुई है! 10 मार्च के बाद गर्मी शांत हो जाएगी… — Yogi Adityanath (मोदी का परिवार) (@myogiadityanath) January 29, 2022Basically, it was a war between two parties i.e. Samajwadi party and BJP. Both the parties were hitting on one another in the trace of UP elections where BJP narrate the” garmi chadh gae hai” to which the Samajwadi party replied with “zayada charbi aa gae hai kha kha ke”.https://www.abplive.com/elections/up-election-yogi-adityanath-and-jayant-chaudhary-giving-garmi-nikal-denge-charbi-nikal-denge-remarks-2053282Conclusion:This is a fight between two parties hitting on each other and nothing like this is said about the jats. Hence this viral picture is misleading.Claim Review: Yogi threatening the Jats in the UP election speech.Claimed by: social media usersFact check: misleading
label: rumor

content: Aren’t the Culprits of the 2018 Varanasi bridge collapse got arrested? Varanasi is the spiritual capital of India. The major attraction of the city is Ghats, ancient temples, and boating near the banks of the holy river Ganga. In 2018 an under-constructed bridge near Varanasi railway station got collapsed because of a lack of engineering efforts and fault in construction procedures.A piece of news is getting viral on social media platforms where users are claiming that the contractor who made the bridge has not got arrested yet. Nineteen people were killed in the collapse and the rest were severely injured. Many users are reviving the 2018 Bridge Collapse Case.15 मई 2018 वाराणसी पुल हादसा याद हैवो ठेकेदार योगी को आज तक नही मिल पाया pic.twitter.com/aQ5DS68qNO — MIRZA AZEEM BEG मिर्ज़ा अज़ीम बेग़ میرزا عظیم بیگ (@MIRZAAZEEMBEG) January 31, 202215 मई 2018 वाराणसी पुल हादसा याद है… वो ठेकेदार योगी को आज तक नही मिल पाया… pic.twitter.com/kXbYsKACFG — True Indian🏹🚜 (@TrueIndian8397) February 2, 202215 मई 2018 वाराणसी पुल हादसा याद हैवो ठेकेदार योगी को आज तक नही मिल पाया pic.twitter.com/NmleVrXdEV — Mohammad Akbar Jafri (@Akbarjafri786) February 1, 2022Fact checkAfter doing the research we found a tweet by the POLICE COMMISSIONERATE VARANASI of July 2018, they have informed us that 8 accused behind the collapse of a bridge near Cantt Railway Station got arrested by Varanasi Police.In the report of Times of India, seven engineers of (UPBC) UP Bridge Corporation along with a contractor got arrested by Varanasi Police. The accused one included the project manager, chief project manager, junior civil engineer and assistant civil engineer etc.Conclusion: The claim is misleading and fake as the contractor along with the 7 other guilty got arrested after 10-13 days of the accident.
label: truth

content: Fact Check:- Complete Truth behind  Mayawati’s viral video. Internet is all flooded with a clip of viral video of Mayawati, former CM of UP.Where in an interview she is saying to vote for BJP (Bharatiya Janta Party) instead of voting to Radicals (kattarwadi Muslims). In that 35 sec video, Mayawati is also claiming that because of her the SC (Schedule Caste) and OBC (other backward classes) gave the vote to BJP.“Do not vote for radicals, rather transfer your vote to BJP” ~ BSP Supremo Mayawati #UPElections2022 pic.twitter.com/muQmfRbdLg — Ashish Jaggi (@AshishJaggi) January 29, 2022“Do not vote for radicals, rather transfer your vote to BJP” ~ BSP Supremo Mayawati #UPElections2022 pic.twitter.com/l1735B4Edi — Virat Hindu 28 🇮🇳 🔱 🕉 ⚔ 🔥 ⚡(Modi ka Parivar) (@ViratHindu24) February 2, 2022Many people retweeted this viral video on Twitter supporting Mayawati under the caption and hashtags like “Do not vote to radicals rather transfer your vote to BJP – BSP supremo Mayawati. #UPelections2022.“Do not vote for radicals, rather transfer your vote to BJP” ~ BSP Supremo Mayawati #UPElections2022 pic.twitter.com/l1735B4Edi — Virat Hindu 28 🇮🇳 🔱 🕉 ⚔ 🔥 ⚡(Modi ka Parivar) (@ViratHindu24) February 2, 2022Fact Check:-Through our research of this viral video we get to know that, the viral video is from the year 2006 and not from the year 2022, hence not at all from the recent UP elections.We also found old news covered by the Times of India (TOI) under the headline “Mayawati remarks trigger protests in UP.”https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/mayawati-remarks-trigger-protests-in-up/articleshow/410048.cmsMoreover, the same news from November 10, 2006, was covered by a famous newspaper like Hindustan Times under the headline “I never called Muslims Fundamental.”https://www.hindustantimes.com/india/i-never-called-muslims-fundamentalists/story-EL2gs87bCDwiHgpUHfBGGN.htmlNews channels like ABP News also covered this video their famous show “viral sach”ConclusionIt was an old video of Mayawati from former UP elections and not the recent one, hence the viral video is misleading.Claim Review: Mayawati asked people to vote for BJP instead of radicals.Claimed By: ASHISH JAGGI, ASH ROKZZFact Check: Misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Images of Priyanka Gandhi visiting Temple, at Times of UP Elections went viral. Every day in the race of UP Elections, one or the other image gets viral. This time a picture of Priyanka Gandhi Vadra , general Secretary of All Indian Congress Party (INC) wearing a sari and worshiping in the temple goes viral.People all over the internet are mocking her to wear a sari when UP elections are just around the corner.Various accounts on Twitter are mocking her under the caption “ UP el has have started and grandmother sari has also come out from the cupboard, but you will get what’s hanging ##आएंगे_तो_योगी_ही”Fact Check:Through Reverse Image Search, we find out that this image of Priyanka Gandhi was not of recent times, but from the year 2009, of Durga Mandir, during an election campaign of her brother Rahul Gandhi and not of the recent times of UP elections.https://www.gettyimages.in/detail/news-photo/priyanka-gandhi-vadra-smiles-as-she-leaves-a-durga-temple-news-photo/85970322ConclusionTherefore, the image getting viral on Twitter of Priyanka Gandhi wearing a Sari is totally misleading as it is not of recent times.Claim Review: Images of Priyanka Gandhi visiting Temple, at Times of UP Elections went viralClaimed by: Mukesh Rishi , Vinod SharmaFact Check: Misleading
label: rumor

content: FactCheck : Did PM Modi Say That He Use To Bring Lassi From Jats? A picture of the news plate of INDIA TV is going viral on social media platforms. The picture contains a pic of PM Modi with “Me jato k ghar se lassi mang kar lata tha” meaning “I used to bring lassi from the jats” written on the breaking plate.” Furthermore, I lived in Jatland for 20 years.” Meanwhile, sharing the picture users wrote in the caption which can be nearly translated into English, “He remembered the lassi when the Jats made him learn a good lesson.”https://twitter.com/Khushi9595/status/1488539106351194121Similarly, many other social media users posted this image on their handles.FactcheckFirst of all, our team tried to find out the actual source of the viral image. Consequently, we got a video on the YouTube channel of IndiaTV. The caption of the video was, ” Prime Minister Modi said in NCC rally – the country is celebrating the elixir of freedom.”After, watching the whole video we found nowhere the claimed remark. Further, using the Fotoforensic tool for the image viral image we got to know that this is an edited image.Hence, from our fact check analysis it is clear that the viral picture is fake.Also Read:Sushant Singh Rajput Dead But Trending Everyday On TwitterConclusionThat is to say, users are sharing an edited picture with false claims. PM Modi made no such remark.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Trudeau advise to make no communication with the unvaccinated? Justin Trudeau is the Prime Minister of Canada and currently, he is criticized by people for making vaccination mandatory. Trudeau added the point where every truck driver crossing the US-Canada border unvaccinated has to quarantine themselves as soon as they reach home. Truck drivers started a protest first after hearing the new rule regarding Truckers and later people from many groups joined the protest at capital city Ottawa in Canada. People are finding Trudeau guilty of making the vaccine mandatory and showing their aggression on many other controversies that involved the Canadian Prime Minister Trudeau. Meanwhile, the entire protest influenced social media platforms too.Many memes, tweets are going viral and one of them has a claim that Justin Trudeau passes an advisory of not coming in contact with the unvaccinated family member of the house. Not calling them to the dinner table, avoiding phone calls or even texting with them. In short compelling them to feel guilty being unvaccinated so that they make take vaccination seriously.https://twitter.com/shane_mcminn/status/1488321140531494913?s=20&t=ORuRILuMvAA8GQqfKMkI9QFact CheckAfter reading the tweet, it was evident why a prime minister would make such rules. We found no such tweets affirming viral advisory on Justin Trudeau’s official Twitter handle.Hence proving the claim is misleading and fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: CM Yogi falsely claimed that 60 Hindus were killed in the Muzaffarnagar riots. The first phase of voting is to be held on February 10 for the Legislative Assembly elections in Uttar Pradesh. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is busy campaigning in full swing for the return of BJP to power in the state. Recently, he held a rally in Ghaziabad, in which he accused the Samajwadi Party of instigating the Muzaffarnagar riots.मुजफ्फरनगर दंगे में हिंदुओं को बंदूकों से भूना गया था। 60 से अधिक हिंदू मारे गए थे और 1,500 से अधिक जेल में बंद किए गए थे। गांव के गांव खाली हो गए थे। सपा की यही 'पहचान' है। — Yogi Adityanath (मोदी का परिवार) (@myogiadityanath) January 29, 2022In the rally, he targeted the former Akhilesh government and said that Hindus were Shot with guns in the Muzaffarnagar riots. More than 60 Hindus were killed and over 1,500 were jailed. CM Yogi also posted this allegation on Twitter and Facebook.ages got empty. This is the ‘identity’ of SP (Samajwadi party) Yogi claimed.CM Yogi also posted this allegation on Twitter and Facebook.Fact CheckOn checking the above claim of CM Yogi Adityanath, we found reports of Times of India, The Economic Times, and the Hindustan Times, Which was told that a total of 62 people died in the Muzaffarnagar riots. Among the dead, 42 were Muslims and 20 were from the Hindu community.ConclusionThe claim of CM Yogi Adityanath that 60 Hindus were killed in the Muzaffarnagar riots is false.Claim Review:- 60 Hindus were killed during Muzaffarnagar riotsClaimed by:- Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath (Facebook and Twitter)Fact check:- Misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did NDTV make a misleading headline regarding Corporate Tax reduction? Budget 2022 has come out on 1st February 2022. Regarding a budget, a headline is made by NDTV on 1st February 2022. In the live coverage of Budget session 2022, while Nirmala Sitharaman was presenting the budget in the parliament a headline came to the screen where NDTV states that corporate tax has been reduced from 18% to 15%.If you will click on the YouTube link given below, exactly at 3 minutes 52 seconds to 3:40 seconds you will see the headline popping, ‘Corporate Tax got reduced from 18% to 15%.Fact checkAccording to the official account of Income Tax, there’s a tweet on 1st February 2022 where Income Tax has clearly written, ‘A FAKE news is being spread reg reduction of Corporate Tax in the Budget. The correct position is that AMT for co-op societies is being reduced to 15% from 18.5% to bring parity bet co-op societies & companies. Refer to the tweet below @PIBFactCheck @FinMinIndia’A FAKE news is being spread reg reduction of Corporate Tax in the Budget.The correct position is that AMT for co-op societies is being reduced to 15% from 18.5% to bring parity bet co-op societies & companies. Refer tweet below@PIBFactCheck @FinMinIndiahttps://t.co/ufHnXHppjv — Income Tax India (@IncomeTaxIndia) February 1, 2022Income Tax official also added a thread with the tweet mentioning that Corporate Tax has got reduced from 12% to 7%.In short, there’s a reduction of tax from 18% to 15% in the Alternative Minimum Tax of Co-operative societies and not in Corporative tax.Conclusion: A headline spread by NDTV is fake and misleading as Finance Minister reduced tax in ATM co-operative societies in spite of Corporate Tax.Claim Review: Did NDTV make a misleading headline regarding Corporate Tax reduction?Claim by: NDTVFact check: Fake
label: truth

content: FactChek: Snaps of Islamic prayers from the Congress office inauguration in Karnataka got viral. A picture of men performing Islamic prayer is going viral on the social media platform. Further, sharing the pics users claim that this picture is from the Youth Congress office inauguration in Karnataka. Sharing the picture Anand Srivastava wrote which can be nearly translated into English, ” Modi and Yogi Ji’s sanskaras inspire us to give the vote to BJP. But, the opposition’s sanskaras compel us to vote for the BJP.Similarly, many other social media users shared this picture with mocking comments.FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, we found that netizens are sharing this picture with misleading claims. We found a tweet on the official page of @IYCKarnataka. In the tweet, we can see the collage of many pictures, one of which is the viral picture. Also, the English translation of the caption of the tweet is, “The new President @nalapad of the Karnataka Region Youth Congress office at the Congress House today worshiped and prayed. The legislator Shri @mlanaharis and senior leader Shri N.A. Several Congress leaders, including Mohammed, were present.”Moreover, Nalapad also uploaded the same picture on his handle. Along with the picture, he wrote, “Prayers and prayers were held today at the Karnataka Region Youth Congress office at the Congress House. @mlanaharis legislator Mr. Several Congress leaders, including Mohammed, were present.The viral picture does show the visual of Nalapad attending the Islamic prayer. But, from the above snaps, we can also see that he attended a Havan also. Therefore, it is clear that he is not promoting any religion over another. Hence, Anand Srivastava’s and other users’ claim regarding the picture is misleading.Also Read: Sushant Singh Rajput Dead But Trending Everyday On TwitterConclusionReligion is a matter of faith. Moreover, in every religion rituals and sacraments are done to thank God. Methods may be different but the motto is the same. Sadly, some people try to do politics in the name of religion. DFRAC, request our readers not to believe in such misleading claims to fulfill their propaganda.
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Fake News Given By The Indian Express. Know The reality A piece of news by Indian Express is going viral on the internet. The report claims that “the DGPs of the BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITB, AND SSB were not invited to the Republic Day parade. The omission is perceived as a snub to the one odd million personnel of the central forces.”Similarly, many other media houses and social media users posted this news on their handles.FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, our team found this information is false. Firstly, we found a tweet on the official Twitter handles of the CRPF that, “The information published in @IndianExpress that DG CRPF was not invited to Republic Day Parade is not just incorrect but also ill intended and insulting to the Force. Shri Kuldiep Singh, DG CRPF, was invited to the Republic Day Parade which he attended.”The information published in @IndianExpress that DG CRPF was not invited to Republic Day Parade is not just incorrect but also ill intended and insulting to the Force. Shri Kuldiep Singh, DG CRPF, was invited to the Republic Day Parade which he attended. pic.twitter.com/KzDeKR7dYj — 🇮🇳CRPF🇮🇳 (@crpfindia) January 30, 2022After that, we also found the tweet of CISF, along with the caption, “DG #CISF Sh. Sheel Vardhan Singh was invited & attended the 73rd #RepublicDay parade at Rajpath, New Delhi. The information published in news paper stating that DsG of CAPF were not invited at the Republic Day Parade 2022 is incorrect.”DG #CISF Sh. Sheel Vardhan Singh was invited & attended the 73rd #RepublicDay parade at Rajpath, New Delhi. The information published in news paper stating that DsG of CAPF were not invited at the Republic Day Parade 2022 is incorrect.@HMOIndia @PIBHomeAffairs @SpokespersonMoD pic.twitter.com/R8CCHQIg29 — CISF (@CISFHQrs) January 30, 2022Moreover, ITBP also to its official Twitter handle to refute this news. They wrote, “A newspaper published today a piece that DsG of CAPFs were not invited at the Republic Day Parade 2022. It is clarified that the DG ITBP was invited & attended the Parade. It was for the 1st time that the ‘Janbaz’ bikers of ITBP displayed a brave show at the parade.”A newspaper published today a piece that DsG of CAPFs were not invited at the Republic Day Parade 2022.It is clarified that the DG ITBP was invited & attended the Parade.It was for the 1st time that the 'Janbaz' bikers of ITBP displayed a brave show at the parade.#Himveers pic.twitter.com/pY3sYkI7i9 — ITBP (@ITBP_official) January 30, 2022Hence, seeing all the above tweet it’s clear that all CISF, CRPF and ITBP quashed the Indian Express news.Also Read: Sushant Singh Rajput Dead But Trending Everyday On Twitter.ConclusionTherefore, it is clear that the news of Indian express is fake and misleading. That is to say, providing credible information to the readers is the paramount responsibility of all the media houses. But, these days many media houses are spreading fake news without proper investigation.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Farhat Naqvi’s picture being used with news of Nida Khan joining BJP. As the dates for the assembly elections in Uttar Pradesh are approaching, the scope of spreading rumors is also increasing. Meanwhile, a big news came out. In which it was claimed that Maulana Tauqir Raza’s daughter-in-law Nida Khan has joined BJP.Many big media houses covered this news and wrote that Maulana Tauqir Raza’s daughter-in-law Nida Khan joined BJP in Lucknow. However, the picture used in the news is not of Nida Khan.Fact CheckFarhat NaqviOn checking the above picture, we found that the picture attached with the news is of Farhat Naqvi, sister of Union Minority Affairs Minister Mukhtar Abbas Naqvi. Who is the president of an organization named Mera Haq Foundation. She helps Muslim women in matters related to triple talaq.Nida KhanOn the other hand, Nida Khan is not the daughter-in-law of Maulana Tauqeer Raza but the daughter-in-law of his brother Maulana Anjum Mian. She was married to Sheeran Raza Khan, the son of Maulana Anjum Mian. Nida’s husband Sheeran divorced her on 5 February 2016.ConclusionIt is concluded that the viral image is fake as this picture is not of Nida Khan but of Farhat Naqvi.Claimed Review: Farhat Naqvi’s picture being used with news of Nida Khan joining BJP.Claimed by:many media houses.Fact Check : fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is BJP again tampering the EVM machines? On the time of election once again a video is getting viral. In this video a clip is shown of ABP news , which states about the MP’s EVM controversy . the whole controversy resolves on the matter that BJP has tampered the EVM machines, as no matter what botton one presses the vote automatically is going for BJP.AAP (Aam Admi Party) and congress showed their anger against this issue. Due to which SP collector of Bhind was removed from his position also as many as 19 more employees were removed.https://www.facebook.com/watch/?v=247902564045607https://www.facebook.com/100076615065632/videos/318311816907790/Fact CheckGoing through this viral video with the caption ‘BJP again started playing the games to tamper the EVM machines and hashtags like #election2022. we find out that though the video is true but this is not from the recent elections that are on the onset , but is 4 years old news , and nothing like this happened in the year 2022.https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/madhya-pradesh-government-shunts-out-bhind-dm-sp-after-evm-row/articleshow/57968571.cmsConclusionThis is a misleading news as a four year old video is getting viral under the hashtag of election 2022, and no such tampering of machine is done by BJP in these election.Claimed Review : BJP tempering the EVM machines.Claimed by : facebook users.Fact Check : Misleading.

content: Fact check: A fake picture from the protest of Railway students got viral   The news of Khan Sir Conspiracy during the protest of railway results is in the air. Many claims and fake news are getting viral on social media platforms. In between all the things, there is a picture of a man who got beaten up badly and is lying on his bed injured is getting viral. Users are claiming that the man was tormented by UP police during the protest of Railway students. Users are also criticizing UP CM Yogi and PM Modi for the cause. The tweet embedding picture of an injured man has been seen on 27th January 2022.A verified account on Twitter and a renowned personality like Jitendra Kumar Rai (MLA from Marhaura) has also posted the same picture by addressing UP CM Yogi and PM Modi, “Thanks to your Chief Minister and Prime Minister that the student who had gone before the government to demand his rights has returned alive. The day he returns as an officer and cleans the system and takes account of everyone, then don’t say anything! #RRB_NTPC”अपने मुख्यमंत्री और प्रधानमंत्री को धन्यवाद कह देना कि वो छात्र जिंदा लौट आया, जो अपने हक की मांग करने सरकार के समक्ष गया हुआ था। जिस दिन वह ऑफिसर बनकर लौटेगा ना और सिस्टम की सफाई करेगा और सबका हिसाब लेगा तब कुछ मत कहना! #RRB_NTPC pic.twitter.com/rKugGaRR51 — Jitendra Kumar Rai (@JitendraRaiMLA) January 27, 2022In short- A picture of a brutally beaten up man is getting viral on social claiming that he has injured during the Lathi charge.Fact checkThe picture has been used by different users at different allegations. A Bengali account on Facebook posted the same picture claiming that the man has been persecuted by an Islamic father for the sin of loving her daughter. The post was done on 17th July 2019.Another use of injured crowInterestingly, West Bengal Police has posted the same picture claiming that fake news is getting viral in Lockdown against West Bengal Administration on 27 March 2020.Final thesis of the viral pictureA well-known news website like Malaysia Daily News has posted the claim that the picture of an injured man is from Malaysia and the viral photograph belongs to the year 2019. The website has posted this article regarding how people are punished for the offence like spreading fake news got published on March 31st 2020.Conclusion- The viral picture came into existence in the year 2019 and different claims are made on the same picture before the Railway recruitment protest in January 2022.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did CM Yogi Adityanath accept that he is a pro-Rajput leader? A video of Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi AdityaNath is getting viral on social media. Moreover, the video claims that CM Yogi accepted that he does pro- Rajput politics.
