You should be the leader of 24 crore people, Adityanath Ji. Is the slogan of Sabka Saath Sabka Vikas a mere sham?”ये देखिये आदित्यनाथ जी ने साफ़ कर दिया की कोई भी इनको कहे की “ये सिर्फ़ क्षत्रियों के नेता हैं तो इनको बुरा नही लगता”आपको तो 24 करोड़ लोगों का नेता होना चाहिये आदित्यनाथ जी।क्या सबका साथ सबका विकास का नारा दिखावा मात्र है? pic.twitter.com/pqky6jR8pi — Sanjay Singh AAP (@SanjayAzadSln) January 29, 2022Consequently, many other social media users shared this post on their handles.Also Read: Was There A Tableau Of ‘Muslim’ in Akhilesh Government And ‘Hindu Culture’ In Yogi Government?FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, we found that this video is a clip of Yogi Adityanath’s interview with Hindustan Times’ Sr Resident Editor Sunita Aron. After the whole interview, we come to know that the viral video is presented misleadingly.Further, we found the above video of the same interview on the Hindustan Times Youtube channel with the caption, “How CM Yogi rebutted 80:20 remark row, divisive politics, and pro-Rajput charge.” In the interview, CM Yogi refused to say that, he and his Government have worked for the benefit of people without any discrimination.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Was There A Tableau Of ‘Muslim’ in Akhilesh Government And ‘Hindu Culture’ In Yogi Government? All kinds of fake news are going viral on social media for communal polarization in the assembly elections of Uttar Pradesh. In this fake news, things are written in such a way that spread hatred between different sects. Further, this news influence any community or sect.The whole country celebrated Republic Day on 26 January. Tableau of different states were taken out in the parade on Rajpath. The cultures and civilizations of the states are displayed in the tableaux.However, social media users are making comparisons between the previous Akhilesh government and the present Yogi government by making a collage of two photos on social media regarding the tableau of Uttar Pradesh.Moreover, in this viral collage, it is seen that there is a tomb or a dargah in a photo. An effigy looking like a Muslim is shown on the front, asking for prayers. On the other hand, an effigy of a sage Mahatma is seen in the second photo. Social media users are claiming that the tableau containing the dargah or the tomb belongs to the Akhilesh government, while the tableau with the sage Mahatma belongs to the Yogi government.A user named Swaraj Bharat wrote – “During the socialist rule, Deoband was presented on the Rajpath as the tableau of Uttar Pradesh. The Deoband which represents the Hanafi ideology of Saudi Arabia, Akhilesh Yadav kept presenting that Hanafi ideology as the ideology of Uttar Pradesh on the Rajpath. On the other hand, see what was the tableau of Uttar Pradesh on the Rajpath in Yogiraj on Republic Day. All we want is that this change should continue, now again jihadi people should not come to power in UP.This collage has been posted by multiple accounts on Facebook with the same claims.Fact CheckFirstly, our team tried to know the truth of the Muslim photo. On reverse image search of this photo on Google, we found an article by News18, which was published on 26 February 2015. According to this report, this tableau is not from UP but Bihar. Above all, “A tableau from the state of Bihar shows a Muslim man praying. The Sufi temple of Maner in Patna was depicted in the tableau of Bihar, which is better known for its Buddhist pilgrimage sites. As the melody of Amir Khusrau’s Sufi verse,’ Chhap Tilak Sab Chhini Re ‘ played in the background. The float showed the tomb of the 17th-century saint Makhdoom Shah Daulat.”Hence, this fact check proves that this tableau is not from UP but Bihar. Let us also tell our readers that at the time when this tableau was displayed, the BJP-led NDA government in Bihar was headed by Nitish Kumar, who is still the CM of Bihar in the NDA alliance.Meanwhile, on reverse-searching the second photo, we found a link to Dainik Bhaskar’s news. According to this news, the tableau of the Ram temple model of Ayodhya was taken out in the parade held on Rajpath on Republic Day 2021 and it also got first place.Earlier in 2021, the collage of these two photos was viral and presented comparatively between Akhilesh Yadav and Yogi Adityanath. Even at that time, the tableau of Bihar was described as that of UP, while calling Akhilesh Yadav a pro-Muslim. This collage was termed as misleading and false by all the fact-checking websites.Also Read: Sushant Singh Rajput Dead But Trending Everyday On TwitterConclusionMany facts come out from the fact check-1- The tableau looking like a Muslim belonged to the Nitish government, which was shown on the Rajpath in 2011. BJP has an alliance with Nitish. It has nothing to do with Akhilesh Yadav’s SP government.2- The second photo is from UP itself, in which the Ram temple of Ayodhya has been shown. It was introduced by the UP government.3- The tableau of the second photo is not of Republic Day this year but Republic Day of 2021.
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did UP Police Lathi-Charge on Students of Allahabad? Recently, there was a tremendous demonstration in Bihar after the results of railway recruitment. Students protested in many districts by stopping the rail. During this, the police also lathi-charged the students fiercely. At the same time, the flame of this demonstration reached Allahabad in UP. Here also the students demonstrated at many places. The students also tried to stop the train. After which the police lathi-charged the students. During this several videos surfaced, in which it was claimed that the policemen entered the hostel and beaten up the students.Since the assembly elections are going on in UP, it has become an election issue. People reacted strongly to the lathi charge on the students on different social media. After which many policemen of UP Police were suspended. Although people are expressing their anger by sharing videos and photos of Allahabad lathi-charge on social media.During this, many such photos are also going viral which are not of Allahabad lathi charge. Those who made these photos viral are targeting Yogi Adityanath. One user wrote – “Thanks to Baba Chief Minister… the children who went to study could return home alive.” Several other users shared the same post with the same caption. Looks like a copy-paste of the photo and caption was going on.Fact Check:To know the truth of the photo going viral, we did research edge. During this, we found a link to an article published by the news website ‘The Print’ on 20 December 2019. According to this report, this photo was taken during the CAA movement in Lucknow. When the police lathi-charged the agitators.Conclusion: Our investigation revealed that this photo is not of the lathi-charge on students in Allahabad. This photo is of the lathi charge on the protest against the CAA movement in Lucknow in 2019. Hence the claim being made by social media users is false and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Is Jai Bheem the first Indian film that got featured at Oscar? South Indian movies like Jai bheem has created their charm in Indian cinema. The film is produced by Jyothika and Suriya under 2D entertainment and directed by T. J. Gnanavel. Jai Bheem was released on 2nd November 2021 on Amazon Prime and gained enough success because of the storyline which was based on a true story, a case fought by Justice K Chandru in 1995. Recently on the official page of Oscar, a short clip capturing scenes of the movie and verdicts of the director Gnanvel has got featured on 18 January 2022.So, some users on Twitter are claiming that Jai Bheem becomes the first Indian movie to be featured on Oscar YouTube Channel. They are Congratulating Suriya Sivakumar for his impeccable performance in the movie.In short- Users are claiming that Jai Bheem is the first Indian movie that got featured by Oscar in their official YouTube handle.Fact CheckIndeed Jai bheem is a great movie but India has also produced significant movies in the past, so we cross-checked the claim and then we got a flashing headline coming in of Satyajit Ray’s ‘Two’ which got released in 1964. Esso world Theatre asked the very Talented and famous Bengali director to create a short film. Thus the movie was based on the encounter between a boy coming from a slum area and a rich boy who lives in Bungalow. The movie created an impact as the concept of the movie was new and unseen. ‘Two’ was featured on Oscar, YouTube channel on May 3, 2016. Logically Two was featured earlier than Jai Bheem, Therefore, Jai Bheem is not the first Indian movie that got a place at Oscar’s YouTube handle.Conclusion – The claim is misleading and fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Wrong claim made by BJP Leader Sambit Patra By sharing a clipped video of Rahul Gandhi. The ruling party Congress is working hard for the Punjab Assembly elections. Senior Congress leader Rahul Gandhi launched the election campaign in Punjab and participated in a virtual rally in Jalandhar on Thursday. During this, Rahul Gandhi visited Amritsar where he paid his obeisance at Harmandir Sahib. Where after Rahul Gandhi also ate langar. Along with Rahul Gandhi, there were many workers including Punjab CM Charanjit Singh Channi and Punjab Congress President Navjot Singh Sidhu.While sharing a video of Rahul Gandhi, Bharatiya Janata Party leader Sambit Patra has made fun of Rahul Gandhi. Actually, this video is from the time of Rahul Gandhi eating langar in Harmandir Sahib. In this video posted by news agency ANI, Rahul Gandhi is seen wearing a mask. Sambit Patra tweeted “wearing a mask and having langar , this could be only the 8th wonder.”मास्क पहन कर लंगर? ये तो आठवां अजूबा ही हो सकता है! https://t.co/ugYOdenALE — Sambit Patra (Modi Ka Parivar) (@sambitswaraj) January 27, 2022Fact CheckThe viral video posted by Sambit Patra and its claim was investigated. On investigation, we found that this video was posted by news agency ANI. However, at the time when the video was posted, Rahul Gandhi had already eaten the langar. On the other hand, a video has been posted by Rahul Gandhi’s official Twitter account. In which Rahul Gandhi can be clearly seen eating langar.The photo of eating the same langar has also been published on Dainik Bhaskar’s web portal. Which has been captioned- “Langar Chhakte Rahul Gandhi with CM Charanjit Channi at Sri Darbar Sahib”https://www.bhaskar.com/local/punjab/news/punjab-elections-vs-rahul-gandhi-punjab-amritsar-jalandhar-visit-congress-rally-punjab-navjot-sidhu-charanjit-channi-129341082.htmlAccording to the page of Wikipedia, Harmandir Sahib is called Shri Darbar Sahib or Golden Temple.https://hi.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E0%A4%B9%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%AE%E0%A4%A8%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%B0_%E0%A4%B8%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B9%E0%A4%BF%E0%A4%ACConclusionBJP leader Sambit Patra’s claim of Rahul Gandhi eating ‘langar’ wearing a mask is misleading. Rahul Gandhi wore a mask before eating langar and immediately after eating langar. But Sambit Patra shared the video making fun of Rahul Gandhi.Claim review:- Wrong claim by BJP Leader Sambit Patra By sharing video of Rahul Gandhi’s incomplete statement.Claimed by:- @sambitswaraj (congress leader)Fact Check: misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check:- Did the police lathi-charge on the students protesting against RBB- NTPC exams? Some pictures of people getting beatings by policemen and showing up their scars are getting viral on social media platforms. It is claimed that the students who were opposing the railway’s decision of holding RRB-NTPC exams in two-stage faced these atrocities.The students are protesting because they think it is injustice for those who have appeared and cleared the first stage of RRB- NTPC exams for the computer-based test which was released on January 15. Various Protesters squatted on rail tracks at several places, hampering the train movement of the state to show their dissent.https://twitter.com/aaasocialworker/status/1486213994981752833?s=20&t=38E1WqVHZl4HPURC8IowaAhttps://twitter.com/BRshahjahan/status/1486770174996926471?s=20&t=Vzpy4VjtW0d8udGK2Nnv1gFact CheckOn analysis of the different pictures getting viral on social media under the hashtag #justiceForStudents AND #NTPC_SCAM we found out that all the pictures were from very different scenarios and not from the protest against RRB-NTPC exams.First ImageIn this, a women’s leg is shown with lots of scars on it, this picture was basically of a model whose skirt was pulled by 2 men in Indore. she posted this picture on social media with the caption “these scars will fade, but not the ones on my soul.https://www.news18.com/news/india/2-held-for-pulling-models-skirt-in-indore-they-deny-the-charge-1728549.htmlsecond ImageIn the second picture, the police are seen lathi charging on people, this picture too is of a different scenario, these pictures are from the protests of deaf people in Pune, where they were fighting the government for education and accessibility for deaf individuals.Third ImageThe picture is of a student from likhimpur where she got beaten up by her lover which was one-sided, and this news is from the year 2017.Forth ImageIt is of Hindu University, Banaras where the girls were protesting against the harassment on the campus, during which the police did a lathi-charge on them. This news too is from the year 2021.Fifth ImageThe picture is of 68500 Shikshak Bharti protest where police did lathi charge on lot many student protesting there at Lucknow.ConclusionThrough this research, we got to know that all these pictures getting viral on social media are not from the RBB-NTPC exam protest but are taken from different scenarios.Claim Review : lathi charge on the students protesting against RBB- NTPC.Claimed by : @aaasocialworker @BRahahjahan twitter accountsFact Check : misleading
label: rumor

content: Fact check: Did BJP distribute money to cast votes in the UP election 2022 Campaign? Elections are coming so is the tactics of elections. On 22nd January a video got viral which was posted by a user named Kamlesh Jain Jain on Facebook. He captioned the video claiming that Government in UP has started bribing people for votes. Distribution of money has begun in UP for casting votes. In the video, a man is holding an envelope embedded by BJP’s party sign.In simpler words- People are claiming that BJP is distributing money in UP for casting votes.Fact check:The video which is getting viral is not of this election. BJP has distributed money but in the previous election. The case of bribery is of Huzurabad Bypoll where TRS and BJP gave cash during election campaigns for casting votes. According to the report of India Today, per person, 5000rs were given to cast a vote in the family. On 28 October, 2021.Few videos got viral during the time of the Huzurabad Assembly Election in Telangana.We got another video of the same day, 28th October 2021 in which the same red-Sandow guy is distributing money.Conclusion: The claim in the video is misleading as bribery for votes were done in Huzurabad Bypoll elections and not in UP elections
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi launch a book named “Aaege toh Yogi hi”? A picture of congress leader Priyanka Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi is spreading throughout the social media in which they both are shown holding a book with the name “aaege to yogi hi” on it.The supporters of BJP are spreading this picture on all the social media sites in the quest for UP elections, starting from 10th February. Both of them are also shown with a tikka on the forehead symbolizing Hindutva.You can find the tweets here , here , here , and hereFact CheckThrough the research on various sites, it was found out that the picture getting viral is of BJP Leaders Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi are basically photoshopped . This is taken from the picture of the Manifesto of congress for the UP elections, Congress is claiming to provide 20 lakhs jobs , out of which 8 lakh posts will be for women. A Hashtag is also provided for the manifesto under #कांग्रेस_का_भर्ती_विधान to bring back the smiles on the faces of youth of UP.ConclusionOn researching it was found out that the picture getting viral is of manifesto of Congress party and, no book named “aaege toh Yogi hi” has been launched by congress leaders Priyanka Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi.Claim Review :- Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi launch a book named “ Aaege toh Yogi hi”Claimed by:- @AdvKhushHTF @kunalshukla @Callmevillian3 @Jpsharma717Fact check:- Fake
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did AAP MP Bhagwant Mann Pledged To Quit Drinking On 1 Jan, 2022? A tweet is getting viral on social media platforms. Sharing the tweet users are claiming the “Bhagwant Mann pledges not to touch liquor on 1 January 2022.”Along with the post, P. Rahim Basha wrote, “Bhagwant Mann has given the biggest sacrifice in political history for people of #Punjab. He has promised not to touch liquor for 1st Jan-2022.”Similarly, another user shared the pic along with the caption,” Forget about Punjab & from 1st January 2022 #BhagwantMann has promised several times to his Mother than again taken liquor This admission of #ArvindKejriwal that Bhagwat Maan won’t take liquor from 1st Jan 2022 that before that as MP he was taking it.”Forget about Punjab & from 1st January 2022 #BhagwantMann has promised number of times to his Mother than again taken liquorThis admission of #ArvindKejriwal that Bhagwat Maan won't take liquor from 1st Jan 2022 that before that as MP he was taking it 😂🤣#PunjabElections pic.twitter.com/QvK2AyT0YI — Nandini Idnani 🚩🇮🇳 (@nandiniidnani69) January 23, 2022Likewise, several other social media users shared this video.FactCheckIn our fact check analysis our team found that this post is misleading. Further, we found a video on YouTube regarding the same. OneIndia uploaded this post on 21 January 2019. In the video, Mann pledged to give up drinking on his mother’s advice. Also, Delhi CM praised Mann for this sacrifice.Moreover, the we found a report of Times Of India dated 21st January 2019 regarding the same.Also Read: Zakir Naik Absconded But His Mission ContinuesConclusionHence, from our analysis, it is clear that the Therefore, the news is false and misleading..
label: rumor

content: Fact Check:- Did people of Janpad Baghpat attack BJP Leaders? A video is getting viral, all over the internet claiming it of the Janpad baghpat, a tehsil in Meerut district where many people are seen in aggression and using sticks to break the glass of many vehicles present there.This is claimed that the people are angry with the BJP government and hence showing their anger and agitation through this act of violence when the BJP Leader’s Jeeps entered the village and is also claimed of recent times i.e. of January 2022.Fact CheckThrough research on various social media platforms it was found that this video is not of Janpad Baghpat , but is from Agra and also this is no agitation against The BJP Leaders, but between the supporters of two leaders from the same BJP party on 8th August 2021. On one side was chief of east block Sugreev Singh Chauhan and on the other side was minister Aridaman Singh . it is said that earlier both the BJP Leaders were said to have a great bounding but then because of the quest to get the ticket they both part their ways , and now their supporters are fighting against each other in Agra, UP .https://www.aajtak.in/elections/up-assembly-elections/story/fight-between-two-bjp-leaders-supporters-to-get-election-tickets-in-agra-bah-assembly-constituency-ntc-1369732-2021-12-07https://www.livehindustan.com/uttar-pradesh/story-agra-bjp-leaders-clashed-during-bike-rally-of-former-cabinet-minister-stampede-with-stone-pelting-broke-glass-of-vehicles-5268328.htmlConclusionFrom the research, we got to know that the video was not about the agitation against BJP Leader in Meerut, but is from Agra, where the supporters of the leaders from the same party are fighting against each other. Also the video is not of recent times , but of the year 2021, hence making it a misleading news.Claimed Review:- people of Janpad Baghpat attack BJP Leaders?Claimed by:- @kumarpr27304602 , @hariomhjcsnp1 on TwitterFact Check : misleadinghttps://twitter.com/hariomhjcsnp1/status/1485259894651764750
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did SP Leader Atul Pradhan Distributed Money In The Upcoming UP Elections? A picture is getting viral on social media platforms. The viral picture is of an envelope with the symbol of Samajwadi Party containing Rs 500 notes. Sharing the picture many users are claiming that SP is distributing money to tempt voters for the upcoming. Along with the picture, Shashi Kumar Social Media Co-Convenor of @BJP4UP wrote, “Samajwadi Vote Buy Scheme”.Similarly, another user Thakur Vishu Rajput shared the picture with a caption which nearly translates in English, “see how much the Samajwadi Party can fall, don’t sell Hindutva for some money.”In the same vein, many other users have posted this picture on their social media handles. And, users this time share the image with “Mission 2020″ and ” the name of SP leader Atul Pradhan” on it.Also Read: Zakir Naik Absconded But His Mission ContinuesFact CheckOn our fact check analysis our team found that this post is false and misleading. Further, on reverse searching the mage we found that the viral image is old.We can see the same image was posted by a user on March 7, 2017. Above all, in our analysis, we found that this picture is edited. “Mission 2020″ and ” SP leader Atul Pradhan’s name” were added to the real image. This was done to mislead people.Hence, on our Fact check analysis, we found that the viral picture is fake. Also, it is not related to the 2022 elections.
label: truth

content: Fact Check : Do the Telengana Government remove the Maximum Working Hour Limit? A tweet is getting viral on Twitter account from a person named Vijay Gopal in which he seems to thrash Telangana Govt. for removing the maximum working hours limit in an organization (IT and ITES Company). He claimed that this way the Telangana government is forcing the people to work for more than 100 hours, where other states have 50-60 hours limit in a week.He also claimed about the other problems like the companies removing lunch breaks and other breaks from the calculations and underpaying the employees, and do not even pay for their overtime.Did you know; TS Govt. in 2019 removed maximum working hours limit (to work in an organization) in IT &ITES companies, essentially allowing companies to make you work for 100+ hours also a week? while other states have 54-60 hours limit/week, we hv nothing. @KTRTRS @jayesh_ranjan — Vijay Gopal (@VijayGopal_) January 24, 2022Fact Check :In his tweet, a statement was issued by Dileep Konatham, director of the government of Telangana asking him not to spread the fake news and mislead the people for the same. He further explained that the government has given certain exceptions to IT and ITES companies in the year 2002 (GO and MS no dated 30/05/2002)Further in his statement he also informed about the renewing of GO every 5 years to ensure smooth functioning of the companies of the states.Dear Vijay Gopal, Pls refrain from spreading Fake news. This is the 2nd time I am calling you out for posting misleading info. The GO giving certain exemptions to IT & ITES sector was first introduced in 2002, by the then Andhra Pradesh Govt! (GO MS No 16 dated 30/05/2002) 1/n https://t.co/IlIoHz7kbW — Konatham Dileep (@KonathamDileep) January 24, 2022ConclusionWith Konatham Dileep, director of the government of Telangana coming forward and claiming this as a false acquisition by confirming through his tweet, proves that the tweet was misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Nigeria destroy 1 million doses of Vaccines? A piece of news is getting viral on different social media platforms. In the time of Covid-19, many rumours were getting viral to defame a country, political leader or authorities. News from Nigeria (a country in West Africa) is in the air. Many users on social media are uploading a video where cartons are being dumped in vacant land. Users are claiming that the Nigerian Government has destroyed 1 million vaccines. Pieter Niblett on Twitter tweets, “BREAKING: Nigeria destroys over 1 million vaccines, these people are not stupid. Power to the people.”🚨BREAKING: Nigeria destroys over 1 million vaccines, these people are not stupid. Power to the people. 💯 ✊🏽 pic.twitter.com/je1J0j7grg — Peter Niblett (@Peteuk001) January 20, 2022Other users share the common claimhttps://twitter.com/ChaChaC87311797/status/1485764074361487363?s=20Fact CheckA country will never destroy 1 million vaccines in crucial times like this. For clearing our doubts we cross-checked the report and saw a mere example of how a misunderstood news looks like. We got a tweet by Bloomberg Quicktake, who posted the tweet on 25th December 2021. The tweet says, “Nigerian authorities destroyed 1,066,214 expired doses of the AstraZeneca vaccine. The country says it will no longer accept donated Covid vaccines with short shelf lives from Western nations”Nigerian authorities destroyed 1,066,214 expired doses of the AstraZeneca vaccine. The country says it will no longer accept donated Covid vaccines with short shelf lives from Western nations pic.twitter.com/OfR3y1vGnd — Bloomberg Originals (@bbgoriginals) December 25, 2021A report of Barron’s explains the same how Nigeria destroyed 1 million Jabs due to the expiry of the AstraZeneca vaccine.Hence proving the claim is misleading and fake as the Nigerian Government destroyed expired dosses of AstraZeneca Vaccine.Claim Review: Did Nigeria destroy 1 million doses of VaccineClaim by: @Peteuk001 (Twitter users), @ChaChaC87311797 (Twitter user)Fact check: fake and misleading
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Russia write “Let’s Go Brandon” on the borders of Ukraine? On the borders of Russia and Ukraine, the tension between both the countries is potentially leading to a full-blown war. Russia is again doing the same movement against Ukraine. Initially, it was against Georgia in the year 2008. Ukraine is having a fear of invasion anytime soon, and the situation is getting worst on the borders.In the midst of this, a picture is getting viral on social media platforms in which it is claimed that the Russians wrote “LET’S GO BRANDON” on the borders of Ukraine with their vehicles placed in the same manner. Moreover, it was claimed that the picture was posted by New York Post official Twitter handle.Now Putin is just mocking us… pic.twitter.com/nvRmp9QwZj — Prison Mitch (@MidnightMitch) January 20, 2022“LET’S GO BRANDON” is a phrase that is directed at democratic President Joe Biden and a way for conservatives to thumb their noses at what they see as liberal bias in the mainstream media.It all started at the end of a televised Nascar stock car race in Talladega, Alabama, on 2 October. Obscene chants directed at the president have been a recurring theme at conservative gatherings and sporting events in recent months, so the “Brandon” line became a tongue-in-cheek way of evading media censorship and public sensibilities – while still getting the point across to those in the know. BBC has also covered a report on itFact CheckAfter our fact-check analysis, we got to know that the actual satellite image shows nothing like this. The image that got viral is a photoshopped image. Along with it, no such image was posted by the New York Post.Below is the real tweet of @nypostNew satellite images show extent of Russia buildup along Ukraine border https://t.co/u5fQAqULHP pic.twitter.com/MpHPif3ruI — New York Post (@nypost) January 20, 2022Many media houses like Reuters, Insider News, NBC News, etc. posted videos showing the satellite images of Russian forces near Ukraine border.ConclusionThe viral satellite image is photoshopped and is not shared by the New York Post’s official Twitter handle, the real image does not show “let’s go Brandon”. This can be seen in the image below, where the image on the left is the true satellite picture whereas the one on the right is fake.
label: truth

content: FactCheck : Video Of Smriti Irani’s Welcome In UP Before Elections Goes Viral. Know The Truth. A video has gone viral on social media platforms regarding Smriti Irani. Users are claiming that this video is of welcome to Smriti Irani. Users were trying to convey how the Union minister was welcomed in Uttar Pradesh before elections.Sharing the video users wrote which nearly translate in English, “Smriti Irani has received a wonderful welcome in Uttar Pradesh, it’s a disgrace, why any Godi media show this news.” Similarly, many other users posted this video on their social media handle.FactCheckOn our fact check analysis our team found that this video is misleading. This is an old video. Further, we found that a YouTube channel named NYOOOZ TV uploaded this video on October 3, 2020. The title of the video is, “Congress raises Smriti Irani Murdabad slogans, stop her convoy in protest against Hathras case”.Above all, from the video, we found out that this incident was in Varanasi. Moreover, some Congress workers protest over the Hathras gang-rape case that stopped Irani’s car. And, they also demanded her resignation.Also, the incident was covered by many media houses which include, Navbharat Times, New18, New India Express, and The Times Of India.Also Read: Zakir Naik Absconded But His Mission ContinuesConclusionTherefore, on our analysis, it’s evident that, amid the high-octane campaigning for the upcoming elections in Uttar Pradesh, an old video of Irani is being disseminated with false accusations.
label: rumor

content: #FactCheck: Did Emirates launch a Diamond-encrusted Airplane? Emirates is a Dubai-based company that comes under the subsidiary of Emirates Group and it is owned by the Government of Dubai. Emirates has its headquarters in Garhoud, Dubai, UAE. The company serves 82 countries and recently a dazzling claim is going viral that Emirates has launched a new “Dimond encrusted Airplane”.Another account named Kengist tweeted on 14th December, “The UAE has been known for its riches and flaunting of wealth. Some viral photos of a ‘diamond-encrusted airplane’ which emerged online, has turned into an internet sensation, as many wonder how Emirate airline will make a whole plane filled with diamonds.United Arab Emirates has been known for its riches and flaunting of wealth.Some viral photos of a ‘diamond encrusted airplane’ which emerged online, has turned into an internet sensation, as many wonder how Emirate airline will make a whole plane filled with diamonds. pic.twitter.com/yzSKCqYiup — kengist (@kengist1) December 14, 2018In short- Emirates launched a Diamond encrusted Airplane that is getting viral on social media platforms.Fact Check. After cross-checking the news, we got a tweet by Emirates Airline on 4th December 2021 which resolves our doubts about the picture. Emirates Airlines tweeted, “Presenting the Emirates ‘Bling’ 777. Image created by Sara Shakeel”.Presenting the Emirates ‘Bling’ 777. Image created by Sara Shakeel 💎💎💎 pic.twitter.com/zDYnUZtIOS — Emirates (@emirates) December 4, 2018Sara Shakeel is a Pakistani artist who fills glittery filters on any image and in the same she did with the ‘Bling’ 777. She posted the same picture on her Instagram account and the image also got featured by the official account of Emirates on Twitter.The sparkling image of Emirates Airplane also got in the headline by Architectural Design.AD wrote about the background of Sara Shakeel and how wonderfully she is creating these sparkling images.Conclusion – The news is fake and misleading as Emirates didn’t launch the diamond-encrusted airplane, it is Sara Shakeel’s filter that made it look glittery.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Will The CBSE Announce Class 12th Result Today? Lakhs of students who appeared in the class term 1 examination for class 10 and class 12 are eagerly waiting for their results. Further, many reports are making speculations that CBSE will declare the results this week itself. In the same vein, a circular is getting viral on the internet. The circular claims that it will announce the class 12th result will be today only. Also, this circular has a sign of Anurag Tripathi, secretary of CBSE.Consequently, this news has created a lot of confusion and embranglement among the students and their family members who are long waiting for the results.Also Read: Zakir Naik Absconded But His Mission ContinuesFactCheckOn our fact check analysis we found that this circular is fake and baseless. Further, we also found that CBSE has not yet announced an official date for the declaration of the result of class 12th boards.Moreover, we found a tweet on its official handle.Therefore, from the above tweet, it is clear that the class 12th result will not be announced today.ConclusionHence, our fact checks analysis proved that the circular is fake and misleading. Therefore, DFRAC request student only to check updates regarding the result or curriculum on the official website of CBSE.
label: truth

content: Fact Check- Did the Indian Soldiers beat up the Muslim men in Kashmir while they were travelling? A Video is spreading all over social media that some Muslim men who came from Rajasthan to travel to Kashmir got a good beating from the Indian soldiers. It was claimed that the men were shouting the slogans of “Pakistan zindabad” which was a trigger point for the soldiers.https://twitter.com/praveenarya1967/status/1484139122046291971A social media user Praveen Arya wrote on his tweet ,” राजस्थान से कई मुसलमान लङके कश्मीर घूमने गये। वहां ये लोग जोर शोर से नारे लगाने लगे पाकिस्तान जिंदाबाद! भारत को हिंदू राष्ट्र नहीं बनने देंगे! नारा लगाने वाल लफंगेे देशद्रोहियों को भारतीय सैनिकों ने ऐसे ठोका कि हालत खराब कर दी। अब लुच्चे लफंगे ऐसे नारें लगाने से पहले सौ बार सोचेंगे।Which roughly states that the Muslim guys were who shouting for Pakistan saying “Pakistan zindabad” are terrorists and shall be treated like this only, so in the future nothing like such happens.https://www.facebook.com/rajiv.bhatia.758399/posts/4443170742459938This video was spread all over the internet claiming the same.Fact Checkhttps://twitter.com/TOIPlus/status/1233768889600876544When we reframed this news image on social media, we find out the truth of this picture being viral. The viral video is from Feburary 2020 , which was of community riots at Delhi, where of of many injured persons one was found dead.Also we got a report from HW English when the dead person was claimed as Faizan from Kadampuri, Delhi. Apart from this the person who beat up the guy found dead was a head constable in police.CONCLUSIONThis viral video is misleading .
label: rumor

content: Fact  Check:- Are The French People Protesting Against Pension Cuts? These days a picture is getting viral on twitter under the caption, “ If the television media was not owned by billionaires, you would have seen coverage of yesterday’s massive strike in France against pension cuts.” The image is of Paris with a large number of people on the roads for the protest.https://twitter.com/fah451bks/status/1483233271727017985?s=20https://twitter.com/patriach2051/status/1483555029063802883https://twitter.com/JeanJjeany/status/1483329642186612736Also check https://dfrac.org/en/2022/01/06/2021-the-bygone-year-that-was-filled-with-fake-narratives/FACT CHECK:-This picture is not from the protest against pension cuts from the recent year, but is from pension cuts from the year 2019-2020.In Paris, 56,000 people demonstrated, according to the Ministry of the Interior, 370,000 according to the CGT. Demonstrators smashed several shop windows and bus shelters in a street leading to Place Saint-Augustin. The store of a MAAF brand was also ransacked and emptied of its furniture. content: Factcheck: Do Tamil Nadu tableaus carry M. Karunanidhi for Republic Day?   Republic day is on the verge and the major attraction of the day is the parade. Different states of India come to present their tableaus which define the beauty of the individual state. A fake poster is getting viral on different social media platforms. On the name of Karti Chidambaram, Member of Parliament for Sivaganga in the Lok Sabha a poster is getting viral that states DMK government has avoided the information of Tamil Nadu’s decorative vehicle got rejected as the statue of Karunanidhi and his consort Rasathiammal was placed in the vehicle sent on behalf of the Tamil Nadu government in the Republic Day decorative vehicle.In short– Chidambaram says that the Tableaus which is carrying M. Karunanidhi (former Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu) got rejected from the state for the showcase of Republic day celebration.Translation of the ImageUsers are on circulating the poster with a caption of “Karti Chidambaram’s advice to Tamil Nadu government”.Fact checkAfter doing the reverse research we got a tweet from a verified account, Niranjan Kumar (Delhi-based Journalist) we got an original picture of Tamil Nadu’s Tableaus which does not include M. Karunanidhi in the vehicle. Additionally Telegraph Online has posted the picture of Tamil Nadu’s Tableaus which has the man in yellow Kurta and not M. Karunanidhi. Users have edited the picture of a man in a yellow kurta to M. Karunanidhi hence spreading the fake news.Conclusion: The claim of having a statue of M. Karunanidhi in Tamil Nadu’s tableaus is fake and the image is photoshopped as the tableau embedded only freedom fighters of Tamil Nadu.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Is Shivpal Yadav All Set To Join BJP? As the election comes, the trend of making misleading statements on the opposition parties and their members start. Also, the stories of individual members or groups of some MLAs and MPs changing their party are very common to hear. One such piece of news is getting viral on social media platforms these days. Linking a video along with the tweet, the users are claiming that Shivpal Yadav is unhappy with his nephew Akhilesh Yadav’s behavior. Further, they also claim that he is all set to join BJP.Along with the tweet, the user wrote in the caption which nearly translate into English, “There is pain on ABP News of uncle Shivpal, Akhilesh does not want to talk even on the phone and Yogi Ji talks on the phone in one go.” Similarly, hundreds of users post this news on the social media handle.FactCheckOn our FactCheck analysis, we found that the video is a clip from the program named Shikhar Sammelan aired on ABP News. Above all, this is an old video uploaded on YouTube on August 12, 2021. Although, in the interview, he expressed his unhappiness towards his Nephew Akhilesh he never made any statement regarding joining the BJP. However, He did say that if given respect, he can join Samajwadi Party again.Moreover, we found a tweet of 19 an, 2021 on the official handle of Shivpal Singh Yadav. In the post, he squashed the rumors spread about him. He stated,” there is no truth in Laxmikant’s claim that I can join Bharatiya Janata Party, this claim is completely untrue and baseless. I am with the Samajwadi Party alliance led by Akhilesh Yadav and call on my supporters to overthrow the BJP government of the state. Also, I appeal to the supporters to ensure the Samajwadi Party forms the government in the Uttar Pradesh.”Hence, on our fact check analysis, we found that the news of Shivpal Yadav joining BJP is completely false. DFRAC request their readers not to make any conclusion from any misleading statements or tweets.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check : Are Images Spreading Over The Verdict of R Sakkarapani Real? Two images of food minister R Sakkarapani are spreading all over the internet which are said to be circulated through NEWS 7. In which the picture on the left states, “”People are not thankful. The Pongal gift was first and foremost created but not thanked by the people”And the right picture states, “”The Pongal gift package given in rations is sacred. The government should not be criticized for providing it for free. Don’t but those who don’t like it.”Also Read: News of death of Lata Mangeshkar goes viral on social media. Know the reality.Fact CheckR Sakkarapani himself came out and said these pictures are not of his statements, and neither he will say anything like that ever.As the pictures were claimed to be spread by NEWS 7, the news agency also cleared that no pictures like these has been circulated through their media house.ConclusionThat is to say, food minister, R Sakkarapani and media house, NEWS 7 themselves said that no such news is being forwarded by then, hence making it fake.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Fake Headline of CNN got viral Cable News Network (CNN) is a multinational news-based pay television channel headquartered in Atlanta, United States. A picture is going viral of CNN’s coverage of a mass firing at King Snooper supermarket in Boulder, Colorado United States where a man shooted 10 people on the spot. Users on Twitter are posting the picture whose headline states that the shooter was factually Arabic but morally white. People are cribbing about the headline on social media platforms.https://twitter.com/ItsHammerTimeII/status/1483481543700062213?s=20What does that even mean cnn? pic.twitter.com/zH9FjO28gK — Wayne Kasper (@k3enteprises) January 19, 2022Fact checkAfter looking at the picture we were sure there was something black in the dish, therefore we examined the viral picture of CNN and got to know that header was edited through Photoshop. As in the original, you cannot find the viral headline. After digging more, we found that the video was uploaded on YouTube on 24th March 2021 by CNN.Hence proving the claim is fake and misleading.
