content: Do Indian soldiers have built a Gurudwara on China border? A claim is getting viral on Twitter where an account named @nandiniidnani69 having 10.2K followers tweeted, “The Sikh Regiment built a Gurdwara on the China border and placed a mark on the post”.As you can see in the video soldiers are celebrating and tweet was posted on 18th January 2022.Other accounts on Facebook has also posted the same video claiming that a gurudwara is built at China border.Fact CheckAfter seeing the claim going is viral on various social media platforms, we searched for the truth behind the claim, we found an article on Sher-E-Punjab where we found that the gurudwara is known as Gurudwara Pathar Sahib which is situated at Leh. The video was recorded on the installation of 80 Feet Nishan Sahib.Manjinder Singh Sirsa, Indian Politian and a verified account on Twitter posted the same video on 25th October 2021. Manjinder Singh tweets, “A blessed feeling Folded hands to see 80 feet Nishan sahib installed at Gurudwara Pathar sahib, Leh #pathersahib #nishansahib”A blessed feeling 🙏🏻 to see 80 feet Nishan sahib installed at Gurudwara Pathar sahib, Leh#pathersahib #nishansahib pic.twitter.com/mZ0PRZedwJ — Manjinder Singh Sirsa (मोदी का परिवार) (@mssirsa) October 25, 2021Conclusion: Hence proving that the video posted was of 25th October 2021 on the occasion of installation Nishan Saheb. The claim is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did a plane catch fire at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport? News of a plane catching fire at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport is getting viral on social media.Meanwhile, sharing this video, the user wrote,” After the launch, the plane caught fire and Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport caught fire.”. We found this video here, here and similarly many other users have posted this video.FactCheckOn our Fact check analysis, we found that all these claims are misleading. We found no such incident of any plane catching fire at HSI Airport. The video is of a mock drill at the Airport on Friday. On doing keyword research we found reports of this mock drill. Banglatribune, jagonews24, Bangladesh post, and many others.Moreover, A dummy aircraft parked next to the airport taxiway was set on fire for the drill. At 1:17 am, the Air Traffic Control Tower reported the fire on the dummy plane. Four minutes later, at 1:21 am, a fire service vehicle arrived at the airport to put out the fire. At the same time, the fire service vehicles of the air force also came. At that moment, an armed force of the Air Force surrounded the plane. The health department ambulance rescued the injured passengers and took them to the hospital. An Air Force helicopter arrived at the scene to rush the critically injured to the hospital. The drill ended at 1:43 am.Hence, we found that the claims of the social media users are misleading and fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Narendra Modi make false promises about Tuda Township Project? These days a news is getting viral all over the internet that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has made false promises to the people of Tripura under TUDA (Tripura Urban Planning and Development Authority) Township Project, which emphasis to provide pucca houses to the people of Tripura by the year 2022.TUDA was created under the chairmanship of honorable chief minister as per the provisions on Urban Planning and Development act 2018.All about TUDA project’s key features is provided in the link below .All about TUDA project’s key features is provided in the link below .Fact CheckWith the research on various platforms it was found out that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has made no such promises under TUDA Township project, but under Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojna . It is a move that will benefit about 1.47 lakh people of Tripura living in ‘kuccha’ houses to construct ‘pucca’ dwelling units, Prime Minister Narendra Modi transferred the fund on 14th November 2021, at about 1p.m and directly transferred Rs 700 crore to their accounts for the purpose.CONCLUSIONIt was seen that the information about TUDA township project and Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojna was highly misinterpreted with each other, hence making this picture untrue.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: A Misleading Claim Is Shared By UP CM Yogi Adityanath’s Twitter Account Yogi Ji determined on the development in ‘Har Ghar Nal Yojna’, the scheme was introduced by PM Narendra Modi on November 2020, this scheme comes under Jal Jeevan Mission, launched in two districts of Uttar Pradesh Mirzapur and Sonbhadra. Yogi Ji claimed that under the surveillance of Har Ghar Nal Yojna, pure water is supplied to 30k Gram Panchayat villages.Fact CheckThe spin in the story comes here if you have noticed the scheme is only prevailed in 2 districts of UP Mirzapur has 1971 villages and Sonbhadra has 1450 villages which make a lump sum of 3500 villages. Then how come this scheme has served the people of 30k villages.Another proof where Police Result posted about Har Ghar Nal Yojna, as you can see the article was posted on 29th December 2021. They have specifically mentioned that the scheme has been launched in only two districts of Uttar Pradesh, Mirzapur and Sonbhadra.Conclusion- Serving 30k villages is a fake and misleading Tweet by UP CM Yogi Adityanath.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Acid Attack Which took place in Pakistan claimed to be happen in Gorakhpur According to a Facebook user Seema Singh, a piece of news is getting viral from UP CM’s hometown Gorakhpur. Two goons attacked a Muslim woman with acid and the victim died in the hospital itself. According to Seema’s tweet, no action was taken against the culprit. The tweet was posted on January 19 2022.Fact CheckWhen our team researched the authenticity of the tweet, we got to know that the case is of 2014. UP Police clarified that the claim is fake as the accident took place in Pakistan. UP Police Fact Check tweeted, “The spreading of rumours by misleadingly describing the incident in Pakistan of 2014 as Gorakhpur has been denied by @gorakhpurpolice, and necessary legal action is being taken by registering an FIR against the rumour mongers.”Gorakhpur Police also clarified the claim as fake and misleading. Gorakhpur Police tweeted, “The above incident is of 2014 from Pakistan which has been used to spread rumours, legal action is being taken against them.” On January 19, 2022.Hence proving the tweet is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: FACTCHECK: Did Indian Satellite Collide With International Space Station and caused death of Astronaut Michael Collins A video is getting massively viral on social media platforms. Sharing the video users are claiming that an Indian satellite under maintenance collided with the International space station. Moreover, this collision caused a lot of damage and the death of an astronaut Michael Collins.https://twitter.com/gulzarosc/status/1483747948722896899An Indian satellite collided with the International Space Station during its maintenance, which led to great material losses and the death of American astronaut Michael Collins. pic.twitter.com/PHUHPqGYz0 — الاستشاره القانونية (@mahmmoud26458) January 19, 2022Sharing this video users wrote, “An Indian satellite collided with the International Space Station during its maintenance, which led to great material losses and the death of American astronaut Michael Collins”. Similarly, many other social media users also have shared this video.Also Read: Did Taliban Smashed The Phones Of The Afghans?FactCheckOn our Fact check analysis, our team found that this video is an animated video. Further, we found a video on the Instagram page of CGI artist Aleksey Patrev from Ukraine.Aleksey had uploaded the same video on his YouTube channel and Twitter handle.https://twitter.com/AlekseyN11/status/1420379361270800386?t=UocTxNPG15Pdr-mC3exRRQ&s=08Then, we got to know that the viral video is a clip taken from this video. Above all, no astronaut died in this incident. Astronaut Michael Collins, died from cancer, on April 28, 2021,Hence, this viral video is fake and misleading. DFRAC requests our readers not to believe in any such viral videos without knowing their reality.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did Dimple Yadav give statement that Yogi’s government will be formed in UP election 2022? Political parties are spreading election campaign on social media. Lies, propaganda and misleading facts are being heavily used in this election campaign. Our team has exposed many lies spread on social media regarding UP elections. Our team has been providing continuous analysis on Fake News and Hate News.The alleged statement of Dimple Yadav, wife of Samajwadi Party national president and former UP CM Akhilesh Yadav, is going viral on all social media platforms including Facebook. The claim states that “Dimple Yadav said that only Yogi will become the Chief Minister and even Akhilesh Yadav knows it”.Claim 1Claim 2Social media users are sharing this statement claiming that Samajwadi Party has accepted that once again Yogi Adityanath’s government is going to be formed in UP.Fact Check:On looking at the breaking plate, it appears that it is fake, as its words have not been properly aligned, which is usually done in fake breaking plates. Still, we searched on Google to check the veracity of this news. We could not find any news or link regarding this post.After this, we looked on this braking plate and found that the logo of “K News” was on its corner. The news was allegedly claimed to be broadcast by “K News”. After which we searched on the Twitter and YouTube channel of “K News”. But we did not get any such news. After this, our team contacted the officials of “K News”. He told that no such news has been run by our channel. This is completely fake.Let us tell you that such rumors have been raised about Dimple Yadav in the past that she is a relative of Yogi Adityanath or that Dimple Yadav seems to be Yogi Adityanath’s sister from a distant relation. Fact check of this rumour has already been done by Jansatta.Conclusion: It is clear from our conclusion that Dimple Yadav has not given a statement about Yogi Adityanath becoming CM again. A fake breaking plate in his name is going viral.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Akhilesh Yadav said, “Yogi government will be formed in UP”. Know The Reality Of The Statement A video of Samajwadi Party president and former Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Akhilesh Yadav is getting viral on social media. By sharing this video users are claiming that Akhilesh Yadav made a statement that, this year Yogi will form the Government in Uttar Pradesh. Moreover, they are also claiming that Akhilesh Yadav gave this statement while addressing a public meeting.A channel named ‘Kattar Hindu’ on YouTube posted a video. Along with the video wrote the caption, “Akal Less chacha Ne Bhi Yogi ko Maan Liya Jai ho #Kattar_Hindu “. In this video, Akhilesh Yadav is addressing a public meeting from his chariot.Meanwhile, Social media users are sharing this video fiercely on Facebook and Twitter. Further, they are also claiming that Akhilesh Yadav has accepted that this time Yogi will form the government in UP.Fact Check:Firstly, we listened carefully to the video posted on YouTube. Akhilesh Yadav is saying in this video “Want to request that if Uttar Pradesh is to be taken on the path of prosperity, then a qualified government need be formed. Only then Uttar Pradesh will go on the path of prosperity.It is clear from Akhilesh’s statement that he is talking about forming a “worthy government” in Uttar Pradesh. And, he never talked of forming a “Yogi government”.At the same time, we saw the logo of the YouTube channel Headlines India on this video. After which we went to the YouTube channel of Headlines India and searched for this particular video. We found a video posted on Jan 2, 2022. In this video, they have not told the place at which Akhilesh is holding this public meeting. But, at 00:55 seconds of this video, we can hear that Akhilesh Yadav is talking about forming a qualified government, not a Yogi government.Conclusion:Hence, our fact analysis proves that Akhilesh Yadav is talking about forming a competent government in Uttar Pradesh. Above all, he never said that the Yogi government will be formed in UP. Therefore, these claims on Akhilesh Yadav are false and misleading.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did Taliban Smashed The Phones Of The Afghans? An era of terror has started after the Taliban takeover of Afghanistan. The rule comes up with many types of restrictions on the lifestyle of Afghans. One such claim is getting viral on social media platforms these days. By posting a video users are claiming that the Taliban have destroyed the cellphones of Afghans.https://twitter.com/Toba_Olalekan/status/1481403596008828933Similarly, many other users have posted this video on their social media handles.Also Read: Did the Pakistani drone kill two Indians in a drone attack?Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis our team found that the Soldiers in the video are neither Taliban soldiers nor Afghan soldiers. However, these are Pakistani soldiers.Further, on doing our keyword search we found that these officers are of Pakistan Customs. Likewise, we also found a report of VICE World News. According to the report the viral video is of destructions of alcohol, drugs, and phones Worth $13.9 Million in an Official Burning Ceremony by Pakistan Custom Officers.In addition, we also found a video on YouTube of this official destruction ceremony of smuggled items.Hence, the claims done by social media users regarding the viral video are fake and misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did the Pakistani drone kill two Indians in a drone attack? A picture went viral on various social media platforms claiming a drone attack on the Abu Dhabi International airports which killed 2 Indians out of the 3 present there. It was further stated that the Drone technology was created by China which was later transferred to Pakistan, to which these Pakistani terrorists have transferred to Houthi.This picture claims a threat to Indian citizen and their lives and is circulated all over the internet.2 Indians among 3 killed in #DroneAttack on #AbuDhabi International Airport.This #Drone technology was developed by China, It was later transferred to #Pakistan and now these #Pakistani terrorists have given this technology to #HouthiPray for speedy recovery of those injured. pic.twitter.com/4Cf3mXkQy1 — 🇮🇳 RajKumar 🇮🇳 (@Rajkumar_scb) January 17, 20222 Indians among 3 killed in #DroneAttack on #AbuDhabi International Airport.This #Drone technology was developed by China, It was later transferred to #Pakistan and now these #Pakistani terrorists have given this technology to #HouthiPray for speedy recovery of those injured🙏 pic.twitter.com/pftqvVavzA — Diganta Hazarika (@Diganta701) January 17, 2022FACT CHECKAfter our fact check analysis we found out that this picture is actually of an Emirates flight, onboarding 300 people, crash landing in Dubai main airport this Wednesday. It was further found that as many as 226 people out of 300 were Indians who on boarded the flight. The report claims no casualties of any of the passengers in the flight and all of them has been safe evacuated.The time of the incident was also further provided by the Emirates which was 3rd of August 2016 at time 12:45. The Times of India and Arab News also made a report on this.CONCLUSIONWith digging into the resources and different news sources this is clear that the picture is of Emirates airplane crash and not of a drone from Pakistan, hence proving this picture getting viral on social media a total fake.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Jayant Singh Chaudhary give the statement of holding no responsibility towards the Jaat Community? Having half information can give the sight of misleads? Yes, it can we have a video that is getting viral on social media platforms. The video is of Jayant Singh Chaudhary Chief of RLD, Rashtriya Lok Dal. In the video, Jayant Singh has been captured giving a statement about how he does not care about Jaats and he holds no responsibility towards them even after coming from the Jaat hereditary. Many users got offended by his statement and showed their aggression on social media!Users gave it an angle where Mr. Chadhaury was not supporting the Jaat community but Muslims as the caption of Ajay Sehrawat states, “हाँ ठेका तो मियां जी का ले रखा है @jayantrld”.Fact CheckAfter digging deep into the story, we got the whole video which was covered by IndiaTv in March 2019. Only if one will see the whole video would get to know what Jayant Singh actually meant. Jayant Singh Chaudhary did say that he holds no responsibility towards Jaat as he is more concerned for the farmers of India. Users only recorded and posted one part of his statement. The other one describes his meaning clearly. Jayant Singh Chaudhary gave this statement in the time when he has fighting elections from the side of Mayawati and Akhilesh Yadav back in 2019 at Shamli.Conclusion: The claims are misleading
label: truth

content: Fact check: Did Mohan Bhagwat and Asaduddin Owaisi make an alliance? A picture is going viral on different platforms of social media where we can see Mohan Bhagwat (6th Sarsanghchalak of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh) and Asaduddin Owaisi (the President of the All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen) sharing seats together in a party. A user on Twitter a picture where Mohan Bhagwat, Asaduddin Owaisi with other BJP members can be seen. Ismail Sayyed tweeted, “Owaisi reached Mohan Bhagwat’s place to make Hyderabadi khichdi… Is there B team of BJP somewhere Red question mark ornamented question mark ornament Aye is right? @asadowaisi sir @MohanBhagwat123 sir”https://twitter.com/kripalram01/status/1483087820138770435?s=20The viral image was posted on 17th-18th January 2022.Fact CheckAfter researching about the authentication of the picture, we got to know that the picture was from Mohan Bhagwat’s birthday party. Arjun Ram Meghawal posted a picture from Mr. Bhagwat’s birthday party on 20 December 2021, Mr. Meghawal wrote, “राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ के परम पूज्य सरसंघचालक मा. @DrMohanBhagwat जी से आज जन्मदिवस के अवसर पर आत्मीय भेंट करके आशीर्वाद लिया।आपका स्नेह, सहयोग, मार्गदर्शन, सदैव कर्तव्य पथ पर चलते हुए माँ भारती की निरंतर सेवा करने की प्रेरणा देता है।“The tweet roughly translates in English that Mr. Meghawal took blessings from Mohan Bhagwat.राष्ट्रीय स्वयंसेवक संघ के परम पूज्य सरसंघचालक मा. @DrMohanBhagwat जी से आज जन्मदिवस के अवसर पर आत्मीय भेंट करके आशीर्वाद लिया।आपका स्नेह, सहयोग, मार्गदर्शन, सदैव कर्तव्य पथ पर चलते हुए माँ भारती की निरंतर सेवा करने की प्रेरणा देता है। pic.twitter.com/Df01oETcKM — Arjun Ram Meghwal (Modi Ka Parivar) (@arjunrammeghwal) December 20, 2021In the actual tweet, you can see Mulayam Singh Yadav (Member of Lok Sabha and founder of the Samajwadi Party) is sitting. The viral image was photoshopped as on the place of Mulayam Singh editor placed Asaduddin Owaisi.On the other hand UP Congress posted the same picture on 20th December 2021. UP Congress added a comment, “The ‘S’ in “New SP” stands for ‘Federalism’?Conclusion: Hence proving the image is photoshopped and fake.
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Misleading video got viral claiming it to be of tsunami in Tonga. A fake video of a man punching the banana tree went viral all over the internet, showing the wrath of Mother Nature in the form of tsunami. It is shown as the tsunami from the volcanic explosion in Tonga. Many people posted about this incident on social media platforms claiming it to be from Tonga.https://twitter.com/FayazAhmedDar/status/1482600796839624712FACT CHECKAfter our analysis, we found out that this video was not of the tsunami from the volcanic explosion in Tonga, Scotland but is of Indonesia, a month before the tsunami in tongue. This video is of a tidal bore which is a regular natural occurrence in the river system. Here is the actual footage which was shot and uploaded on YouTube in Dec 2021, showing us that the incident did not took place in Tonga, but in Indonesia.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QehiwX4VrbUTherefore, proving that the video misleading and is not of tsunami in Tonga but of tidal bore in Indonesia.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Is the world’s longest LPG Pipeline coming in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh? A piece of News is in the air where a Facebook user named Debasish Banik has posted a poster that states in UP’s Gorakhpur world longest LPG pipeline are coming whose net worth is 10,000 crore. The poster was posted on 17th January 2022.Another Page name ‘Modi Once More’ posted the same.Fact CheckSite pictures under the posters are false and misleading as the picture of the pipeline, crane, and construction site is from Germany and not Gorakhpur, UP. GettyImages is a British-American media-visual company that supplies stock images, editorial photography, etc. The picture posted was taken from this website. The image is of 8th April 2010 near Lumbin, Germany.Hence proving the image of the construction site is from Germany and not from Gorakhpur.
label: truth

content: Fake Image of Arvind Kejriwal and Bhagwant Mann Setting outside the Liquor Shop Went Viral Photoshop has fastened the source of fake news by editing content. A picture of Delhi CM Arvind Kejriwal got viral, where he is sitting with Bhagwant Mann (who is the party’s Punjab unit chief) outside a liquor shop. The image is going viral and getting nasty comments on it.Fact CheckThe image is fake as Delhi CM Kejriwal and Bhagwant Mann Singh paid a visit to farmers in Chamkaur Sahib. The Tribune has covered the visit and it says that “In a short video of the meeting released by the party on Friday, Kejriwal and Mann are seen sitting on a cot placed in the mustard fields and interacting with some farmers”Hence proving the viral image is fake and misleading.
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did a combat took place in Loikaw Fake news is spreading worldwide. Fake news of war in Loikaw is going viral on social media. An account, Ei Myat Shwe Sin on Facebook posted a picture on 8th January, 2022 with a caption, “This is Loikaw city. It’s not your city. Just pass by #kayahstate crd”.Loikaw is the capital of Kayah state in Mynamar. According to the claim the user’s claim, there’s combat in Loikaw.Another user on Facebook posted the same picture claiming, “You guys won’t be hurt since it’s not Minyo city. If there is no wound, there is no data. You are so disgusted. This is Loikaw city. It’s not your city. Just pass by? #kayahstate?”Fact checkThe viral picture is of the Russian-Mongolian military exercise in Buryatia. The picture was posted on 30th August, 2016 in Infpol. A joint exercise of Russian and Mongolian troops known as ‘Selenga-2016’ took place in Buryatia. Around 1000 troops and up to 200 military units were involved in this annual event Selenga. The Selenga started in 2008 and the event involves tactical exercise and live fire known as “Dharkhan” meaning a “builder” in Mongolian up until 2011.Hence proving the claim is false and misleading as the picture is of Buryatia and not of Loikaw.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Can You Earn 10 lakh By Selling Coins Of Rs10 and 5 With Mata Vaishno Devi ? A piece of news is getting massively viral on the internet. The news is claiming that if you have Coins Of Rs10 and 5 With Mata Vaishno Devi, currency which is hardly found in circulation these days. Then, you can win as much as Rs 10 lakh. Many websites like Indian Coin Mill DNA Indiatimes and many more have posted this news regarding the exchange of old coins.Also Read: Can A Camel Live With Only Two Legs?Fact CheckOn our fact check analysis our team found that these claims are misleading. There is no such authentic source that claims to sell Coins Of Rs10 and 5 With Mata Vaishno Devi.Further, our team found an RBI press release. In which, it stated, ” It has come to the notice of Reserve Bank of India that certain elements are fraudulently using the name/ logo of Reserve Bank of India. And seeking charges/ commission/ tax from the public, in transactions related to buying and selling of old banknotes and coins through various online/ offline platforms.It is clarified that the Reserve Bank of India does not deal in such matters and never seeks charges/ commissions of any sort. Reserve Bank of India has also not authorized any institution/ firm/ person etc. to collect charges/ commission on its behalf in such transactions.Reserve Bank of India advises members of the public to remain cautious and not to fall prey to elements. They are using the name of the Reserve Bank of India to extract money through such fictitious/ fraudulent offers.Hence, the claims of these websites are fake and misleading. That is to say, everyone wants to earn easy money
label: truth

content: Did a Muslim guy trick a girl and theft her vehicle? Content creations are often made to aware people around us but some users on social media make fake claims out of the video. A video is going viral on Twitter wherein users are tweeting that a Muslim boy tricked a girl and theft her scooty.https://twitter.com/UmaShankar2054/status/1478737825759514626?s=20https://twitter.com/Sourab_Singh_/status/1481620482017603589?s=20Fact CheckThe video was uploaded by a user, Sanjjanaa Galrani who has 3.5 Million followers on Facebook. She posts several videos every day for entertainment purposes.On 23rd December 2021, she posted the viral video where she captioned, “BE AWARE OF THISThank you for watching! Please be aware that this page features scripted dramas and parodies as well. These short films are for entertainment & educational purposes only!”https://fb.watch/aALZev_OsJ/Hence proving she clearly wrote that this is a scripted short film and is made to spread awareness and entertain audience.
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: Can A Camel Live With Only Two Legs? Recently, an image of a came got viral on social media platforms. The camel in the picture has two legs only. Many social media users shared this picture hundreds of times with different captions.Along with the post, a user wrote a caption that nearly translates in English, “Everything is possible if God wants. The picture is proof of that. Subhan Allah.”Similarly, many other users also have posted this image.Fact CheckOn our Fact check analysis, our team found that this image is fake. On doing keyword search we found no such news of any two legged camel. Meanwhile, on doing the image reverse search we found that this is not a real picture.We found that this, the social media users are posting a morphed image of the camel. There is no camel in this world with anly two legs. It was uploaded by Dr. Abdul Raziq Kakar, who describes himself as an animal scientist on his LinkedIn profile. Further, the original photo was published in a blog post on March 23, 2012.Hence, the claims of social media users are fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact check: Is Rahul Gandhi going to settle in London? Misleading and fake news about Rahul Gandhi often goes viral on social media. In the same way a video of Rahul Gandhi is constantly going viral on social media by users. Accounts who shared the video are claiming that he is leaving India and moving to London.A Facebook user wrote: ““अब बनाओ प्रधानमंत्री। राहुल गांधी बाल बच्चों को लेकर लंदन में बसेंगे।” वहीं कई अन्य यूजर्स भी राहुल गांधी पर तंज कसते हुए इस वीडियो को शेयर कर रहे हैं।The caption roughly translates in English that now make Rahul Gandhi as the Prime Minister of India as he is going to settle down in London and make a family out there.Fact CheckWe found a video of Rahul Gandhi’s rally after a reverse search of some frames of the video to investigate the video going viral. The video was uploaded on the official YouTube channel of the Indian National Congress on October 13, 2019, where he is addressing a rally in Latur, Maharashtra.Rahul Gandhi’s statement can be heard between 15 minutes 19 seconds to 15 minutes 40 seconds of this video when he is saying, “I will go to London, and my children will go and read in America. I have nothing to do with India. I have billions of cores of rupees, I will go anytime. ”It may be noted that Rahul Gandhi was criticizing the Narendra Modi government for fleeing abroad with money from Indian banks by businessmen including Nirav Modi, Mehul Choksi. After listening to Rahul Gandhi’s speech from 14 minutes 50 seconds, the entire sentence is as follows: The farmer is afraid. He stays awake all night, how to repay the loan. But Nirav Modi, Mehul Choksi get a good sleep. Without fear, nothing is going to happen. I’ll go to London, my children will go and study in America. I have nothing to do with India. I have a friend like Narendra Modi. I have billions of rupees, I’ll go anytime.Conclusions: This investigation proves that Rahul Gandhi has not spoken of settling down in London. He was commenting on traders fleeing abroad with the country’s money while hitting out at Narendra Modi but social media users have tried to prove that Rahul Gandhi is talking about his London settlement by making half of his video viral. This fact check proves that the claim on Rahul Gandhi is false and misleading.
label: truth

content: Did China launch artificial sun in space? A video is going viral on social media including YouTube, Twitter and other platforms. The video claims that China has launched an artificial sun in space.https://twitter.com/CryptoWhale/status/1480408259618123778?s=20China's "artificial sun" set a new world record after superheating a loop of plasma to temperatures five times hotter than the sun for more than 17 minshttps://t.co/5rd9mCPDKY — AuxGod (@AuxGod_) January 9, 2022The video shows a large fireball going from the ground to the sky. A large number of people are recording this view from their mobile phones.Fact Checkthis is a rocket launch, not an "artificial sun" — what are you talking about? nuclear reactors look like huge steel donut-shaped washing machines and absolutely do NOT release massive, slowly rising clouds of plasma for example, here's China's EAST reactor: pic.twitter.com/qW983EjATX — SDL (@SocDoneLeft) January 10, 2022When our team reverse searched its key frame on Google to check for the above video, many tweets were found regarding the video. A report from a tweet revealed the truth of the video. The video was captured during the launch of a rocket. It was also said that nuclear reactors look like huge steel doughnut-shaped washing machines and while it was leaving a plasma of cloud were made in the sky.In addition, China’s Global Times has also denied the claim with a viral tweet. Giving details related to the video, he wrote that people are saying that “the rocket was launched from the land of Putonghua.”. But domestic news outlet CN reported late on Tuesday that the video was probably recorded during the launch of China’s Long March-7A at the Wenchang Launch Centre in South China’s Hainan Province on December 23, 2021.China’s claim to launch the artificial sun is also true. We get to know about this from a report by the Independent. In which full information has been given in this regard.Hence, the claim made with viral video is fake and misleading.
label: rumor

content: Did no riot take place after 2017 in Uttar Pradesh? UP elections are on the way and we hear new promises, facts, claims every day. A claim got viral on social media which says that fear of goons were terrifying before 2017 and now the gangster are being punished on time. An account on Twitter name Manoj Kumar having 60k plus followers has posted a comparison between BJP and Samajwadi Party.Manoj Kumar tweet:https://twitter.com/manoj_begu/status/1481588614773751809?s=20Another account name Ashish Singh posted the same picture.#योगी_बाबा_UP_का_राजाNo doubt cykal outAgain yogi 🚩🚩🚩🚩 pic.twitter.com/gPkejy0dv2 — ASHISH SINGH (@ASHISHS84090856) January 13, 2022Fact CheckThe claim is misleading as users have read the half story of the man in the picture. The man in the picture is a criminal Politician of Uttar Pradesh, Atiq Ahmad. In the article of Hindustan Times , Atiq Ahmad was accused of keeping Lucknow based realtor a hostage. They tortured Mohit Jaiswal (hostage) for several hours in Deoria jail and transferred Jaiswal’s 4 firms worth 45 crore on their names.The riot in the picture has taken place after 2017 says the article in The Asian Age. The communal clashes took place in many places of Uttar Pradesh including Kanpur. The article got published on 2nd October 2017. Hence proving the article is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did security personnel of Rajiv Gandhi kill a beggar?  Recently, a lot of controversies were seen in Punjab over Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s security threat. PM Modi on his way to a rally in Ferozepur, stranded for more than 20 minutes. The reason was the farmers protesting there on the flyover. After the incident, there was a lot of controversy over PM Modi’s alleged threat. Consequently, several videos of former Prime Ministers India Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi also got viral on social media.Users while sharing Rajiv-Indira’s video were claiming that Indira-Rajiv stood firm even in life-threatening situations. Moreover, the users also said that PM Modi should have faced the situation in the same way. Also, he should have spoken to the farmers. However, the Supreme Court ordered an inquiry on this matter and constituted a committee for the same.Meanwhile, several videos of Rajiv Gandhi got viral on social media. One such video was from Sri Lanka, while the other was from Rajghat, India. Rajiv Gandhi was paying homage to the Father of the Nation Mahatma Gandhi in the Rajghat. Suddenly someone attacked Rajiv Gandhi. But, immediately his security personnel took action. Users who posted this video on social media claim that Rajiv Gandhi’s bodyguards killed a beggar who lived at Rajghat in the firing.Claim No.180s. PM Rajiv Gandhi had gone to Rajghat. Some movement was seen in bushes nearby. SPG took position and shot down a person. It was later found that the man who died was a beggar who used to sleep there in the night. ⁦@Shivamtyagibjp⁩ pic.twitter.com/ano1D8hCYR — jain kishore (@jaime65254594) January 10, 2022Claim No.280s. PM Rajiv Gandhi had gone to Rajghat. Some movement was seen in bushes nearby. SPG took position and shot down a person. It was later found that the man who died was a beggar who used to sleep there in the night. Today Congress mocks a serious security lapse in PM's convoy pic.twitter.com/xlRwIEcz8H — satsangi मोदी परिवारजन (@satsangi) January 10, 2022Fact checkWe searched Google for “attempt to assassinate Rajiv Gandhi at Rajghat” to find out the truth behind the viral claim. We found an article on TV-9 Hindi. According to this article, Rajiv Gandhi was attacked at Rajghat on October 2, 1986, while paying homage to Mahatma Gandhi. The attacker Karamjit Singh was hiding on a tree and tried to target Rajiv with a pistol.Former President Giani Zail Singh and Union Minister Buta Singh were also present there. The accused Karamjit Singh was from Punjab. Police arrested him after the attack. Further, police reported that there was no causality in the incident. The incident was linked to the assassination of his mother and former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi two years ago. And the anti-Sikh riots that followed Indira Gandhi’s death by one of her Sikh guards.We searched for Karamjit Singh on YouTube after Karamjit Singh’s name come up. We got an interview with Karamjit Singh. Living India News posted the video on June 5, 2016, on its channel. In his interview, Karamjit said that he attacked Rajiv Gandhi over the anti-Sikh riots.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xlv_QeTMBLUConclusions:That is to say, our fact check revealed the fact that there was an attempt to assassinate Rajiv Gandhi at Rajghat. But, Police immediately arrested the murderer. There was no causality in the incident. However, some policemen got injured. Hence, the claim is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Did Congress Party share a poster on Unity? People often spread much fake news on social media to create influenza regarding their party. On 10th January 2022, a tweet got viral where people were sharing a picture of two men coming from different religions and they were holding a poster which promotes Congress party and gave it an angle of Hindu-Muslim, unity, peace among all the community of India.An account named UP East Youth Congress (@IYC_UPEast) on twitter having 45.1K followers tweeted, “गंगा जमुनी तहजीब की तस्वीर चंद ज़हरीले लोगो के जहर से खत्म नही होने वाली ।ये तस्वीर इस और भी इशारा कर रही है कि उत्तरप्रदेश के दिल मे इस बार सिर्फ कांग्रेस है ।हिन्दू मुस्लिम सिक्ख ईसाईआपस में हम भाई भाई!बोलता उत्तरप्रदेश आ रही है काँग्रेस! #AaRahiHaiCongress”The Hindi poem concludes that the picture is further indicating that this time only Congress is in the heart of Uttar Pradesh. Hindu Muslim Sikh Christian, we are brothers amongst ourselves! It also says Congress is coming to Uttar Pradesh!गंगा जमुनी तहजीब की तस्वीरचंद ज़हरीले लोगो के जहर सेखत्म नही होने वाली । ये तस्वीर इस और भी इशारा कर रही है कि उत्तरप्रदेश के दिल मे इस बार सिर्फ कांग्रेस है । हिन्दू मुस्लिम सिक्ख ईसाईआपस में हम भाई भाई! बोलता उत्तरप्रदेश आ रही है काँग्रेस!#AaRahiHaiCongress pic.twitter.com/IfXYI7JRWk — UP East Youth Congress (@IYC_UPEast) January 10, 2022Fact CheckThe picture in the tweet was photoshopped as Nusrat Jahan Ruhi, a human activist and an actor from Bengal posted the same picture having two men of different cultures and holding a poster promoting TMC Party’s founder Mamata Banerjee on 3rd March 2021. Nusrat tweets, “Shameless polarization coming from the party that understands nothing of unity or peace! FYI, Mr. @amitmalviya People across all religions, caste groups, genders are rallying behind @MamataOfficial owing to her good work. Would recommend having some grip on your politics of hate!”Shameless polarisation coming from the party that understands nothing of unity or peace! FYI, Mr @amitmalviya people across all religions, caste groups, genders are rallying behind @MamataOfficial owing to her good work. Would recommend having some grip on your politics of hate! https://t.co/kPHt6azW3m pic.twitter.com/fioJXWjZnK — Nussrat Jahan (@nusratchirps) March 3, 2021A Facebook page named, Didi ke Bolo also posted the same picture.“Social unity is giving verdict, Bangla wants its own daughter’Do you want development in Bengal in the future?So, take an oath to support the girl of Bengali by going to this website.https://banglanijermeyekeichay.in/#BanglaNijerMeyekeiChay #Didi #MamataBanerjee #DidiKeBolo” says Didi Ke bolo.From our two shreds of evidence, it is clear that the picture was posted in March 2021 and it was promoting Mamata Banerjee ; hence the viral claim is fake and misleading.
label: rumor

content: FactCheck: The Situation Of UP Before And After 2017,As Claimed By SP. Know The Truth. A post by the official Twitter handle of the Samajwadi party media cell is getting viral on social media. In the tweet, they compared the situation of Uttar Pradesh before 2017 and after 2017. Further, the Samajwadi Party Media cell explains the difference with the help of two pictures. The first picture is of a corporate office in which employees are working in a good environment. SP media cell is claiming that this was the situation of Uttar Pradesh before 2017. As a matter of fact, before 2017, SP was the ruling state party in UP. So this picture may be considered to glorify the SP rule. But, the second picture that is after 2017, shows the terrible condition of UP by showing Lathi charging by police on common people.Fact CheckOn our Fact Check analysis, our team tried to find the source of these two pictures. The first picture is not of Uttar Pradesh but is of Mumbai.The above picture is of Mofirst Solutions Pvt. office in Mumbai where software developers are working to develop an application.Also, the second picture is of Lucknow Uttar Pradesh.वादा था 2 करोड़ रोजगार का, मगर UP में 68,500 सहायक शिक्षकों की भर्ती सही से कराए जाने की माँग कर रहे युवाओं के साथ योगी सरकार का बर्ताव देखिए। जो बच्चों का भविष्य बनाते हैं उनके भविष्य पर ऐसी मार? कांग्रेस उत्तर प्रदेश के शिक्षक अभ्यर्थियों के साथ है। युवा इसका जल्द जवाब देंगे। pic.twitter.com/NSWpF7Agu5 — Rahul Gandhi (@RahulGandhi) November 3, 2018From the above tweet of Rahul Gandhi dated, Nov 3 , 2018.The third picture is the same picture which the Samajwadi party media cell posted. This is the snap of protest in Uttar Pradesh demanding proper recruitment of 68,500 assistant teachers in UP.Hence, The claim done by Samajwadi Party media cell is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Will Samajwadi Party Form The Government In UP This Year? This year is an election year in Uttar Pradesh. All the parties are busy endorsing their campaign. However, we can find many fake and misleading political claims on social media. One such post is getting viral on social media platforms claiming that during election year which ends with 2, the Samajwadi party forms the government. The post explains this trend through examples. It is written that SP came to power in 1992, 2002, and 2012. Therefore, they are also claiming that now in 2022 also, the SP will form the government in Uttar Pradesh. Because at the end of this year also, there is number ‘2’.Also Read: Is CM Yogi Going To Join Samajwadi Party?FactCheckOn our Fact Check analysis, our team found that these claims are completely false and misleading. The SP formed the government in Uttar Pradesh in 1992 and 2002 is false. However, it is true that in 2012, SP formed the government in UP. Further, from the website of the Election Commission, we came to know that in 1992 there were no assembly elections in Uttar Pradesh. After 1991, elections were held directly in 1993. Therefore, it is clear that the claim of the Samajwadi Party coming to power in 1992 is completely baseless and misleading.
label: truth

content: Did the Congress party avail free bus services to women? Election campaigns are the most prominent part of any election. Government introduces many schemes during an election. A viral claim has been driving social media nuts, Bihar Congress a well-known page on twitter has posted a tweet, “महिलाओं के लिए फ्री बस सेवा लाएंगे। महिलाओं को मुफ्त, सुलभ और सुरक्षित बस सेवा मुहैया करवाएंगे।। ये वादे नहीं प्रतिज्ञाएं हैं। #111CongressDubara #Ayegi_CongressTranslation in English: Women will be provided free buses; they will provide free, accessible and safe bus services to women. Nevertheless, these are not promises but pledge#111CongressDubara #Ayegi_CongressMany more accounts of congress supporters have also posted pictures of the same claim.Fact CheckThe claim is fake and misleading as Congress party have never introduced any such claims rather the CM of Assam, Shri Sarbananda Sonwal brought the scheme of free bus services for women and senior citizen to commute within Guwahati. The official page of Chief Minister of Assam tweeted, “CM Shri @sarbanandsonwal flagged off a fleet of 25 Pink Buses under Bhraman Sarathi scheme in presence of Industry & Transport Minister Shri @cmpatowary in Guwahati. Under this scheme, women & senior citizens can avail free bus services for their commute within Guwahati.”CM Shri @sarbanandsonwal flagged off a fleet of 25 Pink Buses under Bhraman Sarathi scheme in presence of Industry & Transport Minister Shri @cmpatowary in Guwahati. Under this scheme, women & senior citizens can avail free bus services for their commute within Guwahati. pic.twitter.com/YPUkS8tgqL — Chief Minister Assam (@CMOfficeAssam) January 9, 2021A website named India.com also posted the same news where CM of Guwahati is availing free bus services for women and senior citizens.
label: truth

content: Is Sonu Sood tying hands with the Congress party? Bollywood actor Sonu Sood, who helped send migrant labourers back home in masses in the lockdown, is going viral on social media. It claimed that he joined the Congress party. Noted actor and philanthropist Sonu Sud joins the congress party, one user tweeted. WelcomeCongress MLA Alka Lamba also tweeted that welcome to the Congress family. @SonuSood @INCIndia @RahulGandhi @INCPunjab #SonuSoodWithCongress @SonuSood @INCIndia @RahulGandhi @INCPunjab #SonuSoodWithCongresshttps://twitter.com/LambaAlka/status/1480499542227243009?s=20Many other users have also made similar claims:Fact Check:On examining the above claim, our team received a tweet from Sonu Sood. In which he congratulated his sister Malvika on joining the Congress.As my sister Malvika Sood embarks on her political journey, I wish her the best and can’t wait to see her flourish in this new chapter of her life. Good luck Malvika! My own work as an actor & humanitarian continues, without any political affiliations or distractions. pic.twitter.com/NCI0d4nUgC — sonu sood (@SonuSood) January 10, 2022Sonu tweets, “As my sister Malvika Sood embarks on her political journey, I wish her the best and can’t wait to see her flourish in this new chapter of her life. Good luck Malvika! My work as an actor & humanitarian continues, without any political affiliations or distractions.”https://twitter.com/INCPunjab/status/1480508885039415296?s=20Another Tweet of Punjab Congress was also received. In which the Punjab Congress wrote, “We welcome Ms Malvika Sood Sachar to Congress family who joined the party today, supported by her brother, actor & social worker @SonuSood, in the presence of CM @CHARANJITCHANNI & PPCC President S. Navjot Singh Sidhu.We wish her all the best in her journey in the service of people.Conclusion: Hence the news of Sonu Sood joining BJP is fake.

content: Did the maker of Red fort King Anangpal share ancestral relation with Prithviraj Chauhan? On 3rd January a Facebook user known as Vicky Mittal, who is a politician from Indore posted a picture stating a historical connection that says Raja Anangpal (founder of Lal Qila/Red Fort) is the maternal grandfather of Prithviraj Chauhan. The post is getting viral on social media platforms and hooked up with sarcastic comments on it.2024 m agr Gappu Seth wps aya to bhakto ka haal ye hoga….🤣🤣 pic.twitter.com/elG4PoWjom — Engineer 🇮🇳 💯% FB (@Jeet_0809) January 11, 2022Fact CheckThe claim is quite fake as Raja Anangpal Tomar belonged to Tomar Dynasty and had shared no relation with Prithviraj Chauhan. In the article of Indian Express, the history, legacy of King Anangpal Tomar is described.Conclusion: hence proven claim is fake and misleading.

content: FactCheck: Is CM Yogi Going To Join Samajwadi Party? A claim from the Twitter account named @_NDTV_ is going viral on the internet. The post claims that in a major jolt to BJP, the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh Yogi Aditya Nath joins Samajwadi Party.Further, other users like @NurulIs34643860, @Iambruce, @livemanis, @bharathbunny27 have retweeted this tweet.Also Read: Did the Bhakti movement heralded the freedom struggle in India?Also Read: Did the Modi government hold a cabinet meeting to expel Sikhs from the army?Fact CheckOn our FactCheck analysis, we found this claim is completely false. Firstly, @_NDTV_ is a fake Twitter account.Moreover, the official Twitter handle of NDTV is @ndtv.The official handle of NTDV made no such claims. Also, no other media house had posted any such news. Neither CM Yogi AdityaNath nor BJP headquarters said anything like that. In addition, there are no such claims from the Samajwadi party’s office. The only information we found out from some media reports is that Congress MLA Naresh Saini and Samajwadi Party MLA Hari Om Yadav, both from Uttar Pradesh, joined the BJP on Wednesday, a day after the ruling party suffered a jolt with the resignation of state government minister Swami Prasad Maurya.Hence, the news Chief Minister Yogi joining Samajwadi party is competely fake and baseless.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did the Bhakti movement heralded the freedom struggle in India? These days we can find a lot of misinformation regarding historical facts. Today, DFRAC has come up with one such news. PIB has posted the latest issue of the New India Samachar report. Along with the PIB wrote that there has been great participation of the common man in the freedom movement. But, people have forgotten many of them. With the purpose to shift the spotlight on these anonymous freedom fighters, #AmritMahotsav celebrations have been started.There has been great participation of the common man in freedom movement. But many of them have been forgotten. With the purpose to shift the spotlight on these anonymous freedom fighters, #AmritMahotsav celebrations have been started.#NewIndiaSamachar🔗https://t.co/z7JnQD3KO1 pic.twitter.com/BnmIiuYjiw — PIB India (@PIB_India) January 11, 2022Everything was good here until misinformation caught the eyes of trollers. The New India Samachar’s latest issue said the Bhakti movement heralded the freedom struggle in India. Further, it said Swami Vivekananda, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, and Ramanna Marishi served as precursor to the revolt.Consequently, many social media users replied with many mocking comments.Swami Vivekananda and Ramana Maharshi time-travelled to before 1857 to create a spiritual consciousness which acted as precursor for rebellion? Bravo 👏👏👏 — A Maliyam Ibrahim (@IbrahimMaliyam) January 11, 2022FactCheckAs a matter of fact, Swami Vivekananda was born in 1863 (6 years after 1857). Also, Ramana Maharishi was born in 1879 (22 years after 1857). Hence, they can not be precursors to the ‘revolt of 1857’. Moreover, The Bhakti movement was a religious movement in medieval Hinduism that sought to bring religious reforms to all strata of society. It adopted the method of devotion to achieve salvation. Hence, the information in The New India Samachar report was fake and misleading.ConclusionAfter getting roasted on the social media platforms PIB made some changes in their The New India Samachar report. At last, they removed the names of Swami Vivekanand, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu and Rmana Maharishi.a
label: truth

content: CM Yogi’s UP rally crowd tried to show as PM Modi’s Punjab program Political turmoil has been going on ever since Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s public rally was cancelled in Ferozepur, Punjab on January 5. The BJP accused the Congress government in the state of playing with the prime minister’s security citing protesters blocking the road in the Hussainiwala area of the district. The Congress also hit back saying PM Modi cancelled his program due to low attendance at the rally venue.Meanwhile, a picture is going viral on various platforms of social media and a huge crowd can be seen. The picture was accompanied by claims that it is a crowd of PM Modi’s rally venue.One user tweets on the picture which Google translates in English that “So much crowd that too when hundreds of buses coming to PM’s rally were stopped by the Punjab government on the way itself, If there was no crowd then why did the PM stop??”#PresidentRuleInPunjabFact CheckOn examining the viral picture, it was found that UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had a rally held at Deoband in the Saharanpur district. The photo was posted by CM Yogi on his official Twitter handle on January 4, 2021.According to TOI, CM Yogi had laid the foundation stone of the Commando Training Centre of the anti-terrorism squad (ATS) at Deoband during this period. Addressing a public meeting, he said, “A total of 56 commandos will be deployed permanently here. This is my message to terrorists: If you conspire against the nation, our commandos will destroy you, wherever you hide. ”Conclusion: Hence, the above viral picture has been shared with fake and misleading claim.
label: rumor

content: Does UP Police impose partial imprisonment for not wearing a mask? In the time of Covid-19, the Police, Government has taken many advisory steps to save the citizens of a country. Wearing a mask comes under major precautions taken during Covid-19. As per the viral tweet on Twitter, UP police will start a campaign for 30 days where they will keep a check on the public regarding wearing and charges will also be charged against people who are not wearing the mask.An account on twitter named Manoj Srivastava tweets, “माननीय यूपी पुलिस जिस तरह से कोरोना महामारी के चलते हैं आपने मास्क अभियान चलाने का निर्देश दिया है और जो लोग मांक्स लगाकर नहीं चलेंगे उनके ऊपर आपने जुर्माना या 10 घंटे जेल की सजा का ऐलान किया है। मै पूछना चाहता हूं यही कानून नेताओं के ऊपर आप लोग क्यों नहीं लागू करते। @Uppolice”The tweet roughly translates Honorable UP Police, the way the corona pandemic is causing, UP Police has instructed the citizen that they will run a mask campaign and announced a fine or 10 hours jail sentence on those who will not walk by wearing masks. I (Manoj) wants to ask why you people don’t apply this same law to politicians.The Tweet:माननीय यूपी पुलिस जिस तरह से कोरोना महामारी के चलते हैं आपने मास्क अभियान चलाने का निर्देश दिया है और जो लोग मांक्स लगाकर नहीं चलेंगे उनके ऊपर आपने जुर्माना या 10 घंटे जेल की सजा का ऐलान किया है। मै पूछना चाहता हूं यही कानून नेताओं के ऊपर आप लोग क्यों नहीं लागू करते। @Uppolice pic.twitter.com/qBpnRgBbqm — Manoj Kumar 🇮🇳 (@manoj581987) January 7, 2022Fact checkThe news of imprisonment of 10 hours for not wearing mask is fake and it is clarified by UP Police, itself.In the reply to Manoj Srivastava, UP police tweets, “ यूपी पुलिस द्वारा ऐसी कोई एडवाइजरी जारी नहीं की गई है पर सबको ये एडवाइज ज़रूर है कि मास्क ज़रूर पहने। मास्क एन्फ़ोर्स्मेंट 30 दिन ही नहीं बल्कि कोविड का प्रकोप रहने तक जारी रहेगा। मास्क न पहनने पर विधिक कार्यवाही की जायेगी। अस्थायी कारावास का प्रावधान नहीं है। #UPPViralCheck”The tweet roughly translates in English is that UP police has not started the Mask campaign for just 30 days instead it will remain till the last tiny existence of Corona Virus. Punishment shall be given to people who are wearing masks but imprisonment for 10 hours is a piece of fake news, Therefore, no such orders have prevailed.Conclusion: The news is fake and misleading as it is directly confronted by UP Police itself. Therefore, keep your guards up.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Is Indian Railway Protection Force (RPF)  recruiting through the RPF Constable? Some websites are posting news that the Indian Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF) are recruiting male and female police officers through the RPF Constable Recruitment 2022 Exam. One such website is https://dmerharyana.org/rpf-constable-recruitment/.Apart from this many other websites have posted articles with similar claims. Consequently, this news leads to a state of confusion in the minds of the aspiring students and their families.Also Read: EXCLUSIVE REPORT: “Communal Agenda” Revealed on Bully Bai App Controversy.FactCheck.On our fact check analysis our team found that the Indian Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Railway Protection Special Force (RPSF) posted no such vacancies. Moreover, the Indian Railways posted on its official Twitter account that, the Ministry of Railways had published no such advertisement/notice. So be alert and beware of these fake claims.Hence, the news of Indian Railways recruitments posted by these websites is totally false. Internet is the source of all the piece of information we want to acquire. But, sadly nowadays it is becoming very hard to distinguish between the genuine and fake information. We many times come up with such news. DFRAC team request our readers to verify every piece of information on internet.
label: truth

content: फैक्ट  चेक: प्रधानमंत्री की सुल्तानपुर रैली में कांग्रेस कार्यकर्ता रीता यादव की हत्या की झूठी खबर वायरल Have any recent heavy rainfall and hailstones damaged roads and cars in Dehradun? Read the Fact-Check.

content: False news of assassination of Congress worker Reeta Yadav at PM’s Sultanpur rally Congress leader Reeta Yadav got shot and killed at PM’s Sultanpur rally is the news that is getting viral on several social platforms. Reeta Yadav is one of Congress Leader; she has recently joined the Congress party. Reeta Yadav came in the headline as she showed the black flag to the PM at his Sultanpur rally.The tweet is done by a self-proclaimed Journalist who’s having 9K+ followers named @iamrani123. Rani claimed that Rita Yadav is shot dead.Rani’s ProfileFact CheckTo know the truth behind the viral tweet, we researched and found that Reeta Yadav did show the black flag to the PM Narendra Modi on his visit to Sultanpur to inaugurate Purvanchal Expressway. She was headed out of the ground and got arrested for her misbehaviour on November 16. On Monday while she was travelling to Lucknow-Vanarasi four-lane under the construction in Lambhua, Two unknown men showed up on a motorcycle and stopped her car at the side of the highway and started firing. She was shot in right her leg and got admitted to the hospital. As per the article in The Indian Express, Ritu Yadav is all fine and out of the danger zone.Conclusion: The news of Reeta Yadav’s assassination is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did the Modi government hold a cabinet meeting to expel Sikhs from the army? A video is going massively viral on social media platforms. Users are claiming that the Modi government called a security meeting of the cabinet. Moreover, in this cabinet meeting, they decided to remove Sikhs from the high ranks of the Indian Army. In the video, the officers said that to throw out every Punjabi. Once, we will remove them everything will be better. Throw out all the generals, all the soldiers, every Punjabi from top to bottom.In this video, we can see many big leaders including Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Home Minister Amit Shah, Defense Minister Rajnath Singh, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, and National Security Advisor Ajit Doval.Fact Check:After this video went viral, we found this video to be fake at first sight. As there are many cabinet meetings of the Modi government. These meetings were related to many issues including review of Corona, security lapse of Prime Minister in Punjab, green infrastructure. Above all, no such decision to expel Punjabis from the army was taken in any of these meetings.Still, we searched social media to verify the claims. After which we got a tweet from Delhi Police. In the Tweet, Delhi Police said that the video is fake.A morphed video of Cabinet Committee meeting after CDS Gen Rawat's demise has been circulated with the ill-intent to create social discord in Sikh community. Case has been registered against propagators of the said video on Social media. We urge you to exercise caution.@CPDelhi pic.twitter.com/5n9hej4h6A — Delhi Police (@DelhiPolice) January 7, 2022According to KPS Malhotra, DCP of Delhi Police Cyber Cell – “An morphed video of cabinet committee meeting after the death of CDS General Rawat was circulated to create social discord in the Sikh community. The police have registered FIR against those who circulated the video on social media. We urge you to exercise caution.”A tweet referring to a viral video claim that in a #Cabinet Committee meeting on Security, there was a call for the removal of Sikhs from the Indian Army.#PIBFactCheck ▶️ The claim is #Fake▶️ No such discussion/meeting has taken place pic.twitter.com/ESec0ALjr3 — PIB Fact Check (@PIBFactCheck) January 7, 2022Apart from this, this video has also been termed as fake from the official Twitter account of PIB FACT CHECK. According to PIB’s tweet- “A tweet referring to a viral video claimed that the Cabinet Committee meeting on Security had called for the removal of Sikhs from the Indian Army.” While checking its fact, PIB has called it fake.Video check:From this fact check, we found that this cabinet meeting took place after the death of CDS General of India Bipin Rawat in a helicopter crash. When we searched “cabinet meeting on CDS Bipin Rawat’s death” on YouTube. But, we found the same video of the cabinet meeting which is being viral on social media with false claims.The Tribune posted this video on 8 December 2021. Along with the video, they attached the caption as “CCS informs about helicopter crash leading to the death of CDS Gen Rawat: Official Source”. It is clear from this video that these officers are the CCS of the country. He did not brief the Punjabis about the army but the cabinet about the death of CDS Rawat.Conclusion:That is to say, This fact check proves that no such decisions were taken in the cabinet meeting. Hence, the claim is completely false and fake.
label: truth

content: फैक्ट चेकः क्या सिखों को सेना से निकालने के लिए मोदी सरकार ने की कैबिनेट बैठक? सोशल मीडिया पर एक वीडियो वायरल हो रहा है। इस वीडियो को वायरल करके दावा किया जा रहा है कि मोदी सरकार ने कैबिनेट की सुरक्षा बैठक बुलाई थी। इस कैबिनेट बैठक में फैसला लिया है कि सिखों को सेना और सेना के बड़े-बड़े पदों से हटा देना चाहिए। वीडियो में अधिकारियों को यह बोलते हुए सुना जा सकता है कि हर एक पंजाबी को निकाल दो। अगर एक बार ये पंजाबी निकाल दिए गए तो सबकुछ बेहतर हो जाएगा। सारे जनरल, सारे सैनिक, टॉप से लेकर बॉटम तक हर एक पंजाबी को निकाल दो।इस वीडियो में आप देख सकते हैं कि प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी, गृहमंत्री अमित शाह, रक्षामंत्री राजनाथ सिंह, विदेश मंत्री एस. जयशंकर, वित्तमंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण और राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार अजित डोवाल सहित तमाम बड़े नेता हैं।इस वीडियो के वायरल होने के बाद हमें पहली नजर में यह वीडियो फेक लगा, क्योंकि मोदी सरकार की कई कैबिनेट बैठकें हुई हैं। ये बैठकें कोरोना की समीक्षा, पंजाब में हुई प्रधानमंत्री की सुरक्षा में चूक, ग्रीन इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर सहित कई मुद्दों को लेकर थीं। किसी भी कैबिनेट बैठक में पंजाबियों को सेना से निकालने का फैसला नहीं लिया गया। फिर भी हमने दावों की पड़ताल के लिए सोशल मीडिया पर सर्च किया। जिसके बाद हमें दिल्ली पुलिस द्वारा इस वीडियो को एडिटेड किए जाने और इसे फेक करार दिए जाने का एक ट्वीट मिला।इस ट्वीट में दिल्ली पुलिस साइबर सेल के डीसीपी केपीएस मल्होत्रा के मुताबिक- “सीडीएस जनरल रावत के निधन के बाद कैबिनेट समिति की बैठक का एक एडिटेड वीडियो सिख समुदाय में सामाजिक कलह पैदा करने के इरादे से प्रसारित किया गया है। उक्त वीडियो को सोशल मीडिया पर प्रसारित करने वालों के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज किया गया है। हम आपसे सावधानी बरतने का आग्रह करते हैं।”A morphed video of Cabinet Committee meeting after CDS Gen Rawat's demise has been circulated with the ill-intent to create social discord in Sikh community. Case has been registered against propagators of the said video on Social media. We urge you to exercise caution. @CPDelhi pic.twitter.com/5n9hej4h6Aइसके अलावा PIB FACT CHECK के ऑफिशियल ट्विटर अकाउंट से भी इस वीडियो को फेक करार दिया गया है। पीआईबी के ट्वीट के मुताबिक- “एक वायरल वीडियो का जिक्र करते हुए एक ट्वीट में दावा किया गया कि सुरक्षा पर कैबिनेट कमेटी की बैठक में सिखों को भारतीय सेना से हटाने का आह्वान किया गया था।”इसकी फैक्ट चेक करते हुए पीआईबी ने इसे फेक बताया है।A tweet referring to a viral video claim that in a #Cabinet Committee meeting on Security, there was a call for the removal of Sikhs from the Indian Army.#PIBFactCheck▶️ The claim is #Fake▶️ No such discussion/meeting has taken place pic.twitter.com/ESec0ALjr3— PIB Fact Check (@PIBFactCheck) January 7, 2022
label: rumor

content: Fact Check: Did the riot take place in PM’s Meerut Rally? A video has got viral on almost every social media platform, accounts who have shared this video claims that in the Meerut rally of PM Narendra Modi, BJP members got into a fight on stage as in the video you can see the poster on the backdrop of the stage.The video is getting viral on Facebook and Twitter; people on social are making fun of the video by sarcastically mentioning that BJP leaders have shared much love on the stage with each other and on the other hand people are also having sorrow towards the BJP members as they feel disappointed and sad about this act.Fact CheckTo know the truth behind the viral video we did some research and found a video on YouTube. The video was uploaded on 10th October 2021 having the same scene as you saw in the viral video. The video was uploaded by Aakib Abbas and he gave a caption, “हरियाणा में किसान भाइयों ने खट्टर का जन कार्यक्रम तोड़ फोड़ करके रद किया।। – YouTube “ which roughly translate in English that the riot was created in Haryana CM, Manohar Lal Khattar’s party convection.After digging deep, we found much news on this riot which was published on 10th October 2021. The program was held to aware farmers of the benefits of 3 Farmer’s Law. Alas! The farmers arrived at the venue first and did the act of sabotage on stage.Conclusion: The article proves that the video is of Haryana CM Manohar Lal Khattar’s party convection and not of PM’s Meerut rally, hence proving the viral video is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: #फ़ैक्टचेक: क्या बिक्रम सिंह मजीठिया पर आज तक और ZeeNews का दावा सही है? Have any recent heavy rainfall and hailstones damaged roads and cars in Dehradun? Read the Fact-Check.

content: Fact Check: Did Taliban accept that India became powerful because of RSS and BJP? A video is being shared on Facebook. Social media users are claiming that Taliban has accepted that India is powerful because of Bharatiya Janata Party and Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh. We can see a man in the video. He makes a statement that when BJP is in India, no country can attack India. Firstly, The BJP has to be removed before attacking India.In this statement, the person narrates the stories of Aurangzeb. After this he also praises BJP and RSS. Those who shared this video are claiming that this person is the chief secretary of the Taliban. Which is assuming the iron of the power of BJP and RSS.Fact Check:After the video went viral, our team, after reverse searching some frames of this video, found that the person in the video is not the chief secretary of Taliban, but Khalid Mahmood Abbasi, a political analyst from Pakistan, who lives in Islamabad, Pakistan.We then found the same video on Khalid Mahmood Abbasi’s YouTube channel uploaded on August 3, 2021. Whose title was – Deteriorating situation in India – Khalid Mahmood Abbasi. In this video, the person is Khalid Abbasi.Conclusion:Our fact check proves that the person making the statement is not the chief secretary of Taliban but a political analyst of Pakistan. Hence this claim is false and misleading.
label: rumor

content: फैक्ट चेकः क्या तालिबान ने स्वीकारा कि RSS और BJP की वजह से भारत बना शक्तिशाली? Have any recent heavy rainfall and hailstones damaged roads and cars in Dehradun? Read the Fact-Check.

content: #Factcheck: Do the claim of AaJ Tak and ZeeNews on Bikram Singh Majitha is true? To a citizen of any country, media works as a bridge towards awareness of outer happenings around them but what if the media itself spread fake and misleading news? Whom shall be trusted in such a case?Leader of Shiromani Akali Dal Bikram Singh Majitha, former cabinet minister of Punjab has been involved in many controversies and recently he is charged under section 29 (abetment and criminal conspiracy) of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act. According to the article in The Indian Express. As per the current scenario, Bikram Singh Majitha’s failed to get a stay order against the drug case until the next hearing on 10th January. Says the article in Hindustan Times.Fake NewsThe Akali Dal leader has been found visiting the Golden Temple in Amritsar on the occasion of New Year as per the Zee News and AajTak on the 2nd of January, 2022Fact CheckThe pictures are of Bikram Majitha which got published on Zee News and AajTak are of last year, 1st January 2021. Through the shreds of evidence, we have collected on the Facebook official page of Shiromani Akali Dal Majitha the same pictures was posted on 1st January 2021.An account named Rozana Spokesman posted the same picture on 1st January 2021. Briefing about Mr. Bikram Majitha’s visit to the Gurudwara.The Punjabi news Channel, PTC News has also covered his visit to Gurudwara and captured Mr. Bikram’s byte on his expectations towards 2021.
label: truth

content: #Factcheck: Khalistan Supporters Share No Relation with PM’s Visit to Punjab On 5th of the January, PM Narendra Modi gave a visit to Punjab wherein lack of security caused an issue meanwhile a video got viral on social media, in which you can see bikers are heard raising slogans like, “Khalistan Zindabad”Why Did The Congress Government Not Arrest Those Who Raised Slogans Of Khalistan Zindabad Yesterday ? #PresidentRuleInPunjab pic.twitter.com/AxCcRtjRvh — Narendra Modi Fan (Modi Ka Parivar) (@narendramodi177) January 6, 2022The video was shared by many but one account named Narendra Modi Fan tweets,“Why Did The Congress Government Not Arrest Those Who Raised Slogans Of Khalistan Zindabad Yesterday?” #PresidentRuleInPunjabFact CheckAfter examining the case, our team (DFRAC) got to know that the video is on 26th December 2021. In the memory of “Chote Sahibzade”, the son of Guru Gobind Singh localities rallied out.https://twitter.com/WeNeverForget84/status/1478996863277678592?s=20After researching we found many videos of the rally on Facebook and Twitter that were posted near 26th December to 28th December. The video is related to the Kesari March which is celebrated in honor of Fatehgarh martyrs. The fair is held from 25 December to 27 December in memory of Guru Gobind Singh’s son Baba Zorawar Singh and Baba Fateh Singh.
label: truth

content: Fake Image From MP Congress Committee’s Twitter Account got Viral Communal hatred has become a common chapter in the book of politics. The Madhya Pradesh Congress Committee tweeted on 5th January 2022 “Punjab Nai Desh Ka Dil Jeet Liya”. The tweet was done right after the unsuccessful visit to Punjab of PM Narendra Modi.In reply to this tweet, an account named “India नही भारत Flag of India 13.7k” reverted to the tweet with a photoshopped image and misleading content. The picture depicts the death scene of Indira Gandhi where she is killed by her own bodyguards.Fact CheckThe image was photoshopped as MP Congress didn’t add a picture with the tweet. The tweet by India नही भारत Flag of India 13.7k is a mere case of an attempt at communal hatred. Many Anti-Congress party people have reposted the picture and have circulated it around the globe.Conclusion: The article clearly states how people spread misleading contents. Hence the picture is fake as well as misleading.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Did Akhilesh Yadav enter the Lord Parshuram’s Temple wearing shoes? Know the reality The story starts with Akhilesh Yadav posting a picture of his visit to the holy Parshuram Temple. Along with the post, he wrote which nearly translates in English, “ Jai Jai Shree Parshuram ho All good luck!!!”.However, Samajwadi Party President’s this post became a hot topic on social media platforms. Many users claim that ” Akhilesh Yadav had entered the temple wearing shoes.” Subsequently, people are saying this an act of insult to Hinduism and brahmins. Meanwhile, a user in his tweet wrote which nearly translate in English that, “This is an insult to Lord Parshuram. Why Akhilesh Yadav was not stopped from going to Lord Parshuram’s temple wearing shoes. This was politics done for Brahmin votes. But, Akhilesh never respected Brahmins”Similarly, another user wrote that “India will not tolerate the insult of Lord Parshuram.” Likewise, many users attacked Akhilesh Yadav with many of their mocking tweets.Also Read: Did 125 Passengers of Air India Flight Tested Covid Positive?Fact CheckMeanwhile, in our Fact Check analysis, we found that the claim made by these seemingly religious people is fake and misleading.So from the above photograph, we can see that Fromer UP chief Minister is wearing black socks, not shoes. Hence , the claims of social media users are false. That is to say, we live in an era where people say anything without any proper pieces of evidence and try to relate them with the sentiments of people.
label: rumor

content: The truth behind Sitaram Yechury’s tweet calling Mr. Xi his boss Photoshop has become a weapon to claim false allegations and prove them with a picture. You may have seen many forgery cases on social media done with the help of Photoshop. Sitaram Yechury, leader of the communist party, member of SFI,(Student Federation of India) has always taken active participation in politics. Recently a tweet has been ignited of Mr. Sitaram Yechury where he is found posting a picture shaking hands with China’s President Xi Jinping and tweeting, “It’s a pleasure for me to meet my boss” on Twitter.Also Read: Did 125 Passenger of Air India Flight Tested Covid PositiveFact CheckAs we can see in the post, the date of the tweet is 20 October 2015 however Sitaram Yechury joined Twitter on the 27th of October, 2015.CPI(M), Communist Party of India also gave an explanation regarding fake tweet and proved it wrong. They have also indirectly blamed the Modi government for spreading the forgery.Stop Lie ManufacturingAnother example of sanghi dirty tricks@SitaramYechury joined Twitter on Oct 27, 2015. This fake tweet is dated oct 20.Because CPI(M) has exposed Modi's doublespeak, sanghis have become desperate. Where is the order to do all these things coming from? pic.twitter.com/ZYCkq07dHv — CPI (M) (@cpimspeak) June 22, 2020The image is from 2015 when Mr. Yechury went to the Chinese capital to participate in an international conference of Asian political parties as per the article in The Hindu.Conclusion: The article is an example of how renowned personalities are defamed for the sin they have not even committed. Hence the news is fake and check before spreading any news.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: Did 125 Passengers of Air India Flight Tested Covid Positive? A piece of news is becoming massively viral. The news claims that 125 passengers of Air India flight from Italy to Rome tested Covid positive.Meanwhile, several media houses like NewsNation, Mirror Now, ANI, Bharat Times have posted this news.Fact CheckOn our research analysis, our team found that the flight was not of Air India. However, 179 passengers on the charter flight YU-661 landed at the Amritsar airport at around 1.30 PM on 5 January 2022. A Portuguese company Euro Atlantic Airways operated This charter flight between Milan in Italy and Amritsar in Punjab.Moreover, Air India has crushed media reports with a tweet, “#FlyAI : Several Media houses has reported that Passengers of Air India flight from Rome to Amritsar have been tested covid positive. This is wrong and baseless. We doesn’t operate any flight from Rome currently.”#FlyAI : Several Media houses has reported that Passengers of Air India flight from Rome to Amritsar have been tested covid positive. This is wrong and baseless. Air India doesn't operate any flight from Rome currently. — Air India (@airindia) January 6, 2022Furthermore, ANI has retweeted a corrected tweet, “Correction | 125 passengers of an international chartered flight from Italy have tested positive for Covid-19 on arrival at Amritsar airport. Subsequently, Total passengers on the flight were 179: VK Seth, Amritsar Airport Director.”Hence, the our team found this new is misleading. Though, several media houses has corrected or edited there tweet now. But it should be the paramount responsibility of any media house to properly investigate the credibility of any piece of information before posting is as a news.
label: truth

content: Fact Check: Truth behind Aryan Khan’s peeing video at the Airport. Nowadays, social media works as a warehouse of fake and misleading content. There is a video that is getting viral quickly where a man has been found drunk and caught peeing on the terminal of the airport. People claim that the man is Aryan Khan, son of Shahrukh Khan.In the caption of the video, it says that Aryan Khan is at America’s airport where he is found peeing on the terminal and he’s bringing shame on his father Shahrukh Khan’s name as well as on our Country.On the other hand, the video is getting viral on all the social media platforms, On Facebook, people are posting which roughly translates in English that “Aryan Khan brings shame on his Father’s name, Mr. Shahrukh Khan, as well as on our country’s name too. Shame on him.”Fact CheckThrough our research, we got to know that the video is from 2012, TMC report proved that the man who is peeing in the video is Twilight movie actor Bronson Pelletier and he has already been punished for it. Go through the link once and you will see the headline where it is clearly written, “Twilight Actor Punished for peeing in an airport”.Link of the article: https://www.tmz.com/2013/02/22/twilight-bronson-pelletier-airport-pee-urinate-video-sentenced-probation/Conclusion: It is clear that the video is fake and misleading.
label: truth

content: BBC gave place to misleading information In BBC’s article, the writer embedded the famous tweet by Mohit Benewal, where he mentioned about Asia’s biggest Airport is in Noida. Although BBC didn’t mention the airport in the article but displayed it on the wall of the article. Mohit Benewal is the BJP president of West UP. He has pinned the tweet where he is honored to receive PM Narendra Modi as a guest at the airport.“#पश्चिम उ०प्र० में नोएडा में एशिया का सबसे बड़ा #NoidaInternationalAirport की सौगात देने के लिए मा०प्रधानमंत्री जी का हार्दिक आभार!#नएयूपीकी_उड़ान” says Mr. Benewal.Fact Check:BJP West UP President mentioned Noida airport as the largest one in Asia, in reality, there is no airport built in Noida. Asia’s largest airport is in Beijing called Beijing Capital International Airport. The only airport we have in Delhi NCR is Indira Gandhi Airport. You can also find fake and misleading pictures on Google of this forgery airport.As per DFRAC’s last report that says, “Fact-Check: Hundreds of users including BJP leaders post pictures of Beijing Airport to show the new Jewar Airport”.Conclusion: BBC highlighting the entire tweet can be a sight of misleading or just an error. As we are aware of the fact that Ad campaigns in elections are a hub of fake and misleading news, so keep your guard up.
label: truth

content: FactCheck: The Truth Behind Viral Video Of A Burqa Woman Firing A Gun A video of a Burqa woman firing a gun is becoming viral on social media platforms. The video have more than a thousand views in December 2021. People are claiming that the woman firing a gun in Karachi, the largest city in Muslim-majority Pakistan. The video shared has misleading context; it has circulated in reports since November 2020 about a woman firing shots at a shop in Hindu-majority India.The video was shared here on Facebook on December 11, 2021. It has more than 4000 views. “This is Karachi my dear,” reads the post’s Urdu-language caption. Moreover, the footage was shared alongside a similar claim that it was filmed in Karachi here, here, here , and here on Facebook; and here and here on Twitter.The video shows a woman in a burqa — a traditional Islamic head-to-toe garment — shouting abuse in a narrow street. At the 17-second mark, she is pointing what appears to be a gun at a door before the sound of a gunshot. Seconds later, she gets on a motorbike before the clip ends. “I’m Nasir’s sister,” she says towards the end of the video.Also Read: Is The Information Shared By The Viral Audio Regarding Covid Vaccine Misleading?FactCheckSome people have shared the clip in a misleading context. It has previously circulated in reports about a woman firing a gun in the Indian capital of Delhi.
